title: World-Building Artistry for Fantasy/Historical Site
description:
I am looking for art to put on a web site that is a "historical" world-building creative project.  Think about a fantasy book having a setting, the "world" it is a part of.  That world has a history of peoples, animals, and plants.  The website is sorta like a history wikipedia with a graphical interface (maps and a time slider) of that world.

This is almost a sci-fi project in that this world runs on normal physical rules (with some exceptions for the "magic") and the species depicted have an evolutionary back story.  We are trying to avoid the typical fantasy tropes of what fantasy species might look like, and re-imagine species based upon the environment they evolved in.  We have some ideas already about some features of some species, but there is still a lot of open ground to think about what a species might look like under certain evolutionary constraints - hence, it is sort of a sci-fi project.  That said, many species have at least some rough cognate from the traditional tolkien-esque genre, we just are trying to re-imagine them.

So the project would include at least a dozen or two renderings to get a sample of the main new species of this world, but could include many more.  The level of detail and style are also still TBD; simple black and white sketches might suffice, but more detailed full color depictions are certainly a possibility.

The project so far is about 5 years in with thousands of pages of content and many hundreds of maps/layers.  It will take a few more years so this is not a rush job in any way with lots of time and flexibility.

**Requirements**

You must be experienced using JAWS and be comfortable shopping and navigating websites independently with a screen reader.

Please tell me about your experience using JAWS and, if possible, any previous website accessibility testing you have performed.

title: Houzez–Zoho MVP Configuration
description:
I need a working minimum-viable online property sales platform configured using my existing Houzez WordPress theme and Zoho CRM. Both are already set up and ready to use.

The objective is to create a simple property sales journey from property listing → enquiry → viewing → offer → offer accepted → Sale Agreed → booking deposit, using existing functionality and no bespoke development.

Houzez

Houzez will be the customer-facing property website.

Configure the existing Houzez templates and functionality to:

Allow sellers to register and submit their property.

Allow the Agent/Admin to review and approve listings before publication.

Display properties using the existing Houzez property listing and property detail templates.

Allow buyers to search and view properties.

Provide clear Enquire, Request Viewing and Make an Offer actions on each property.

Use the existing Houzez seller dashboard and property submission functionality.

Use Houzez property statuses including For Sale and Sale Agreed.

Use existing Houzez payment functionality for seller listing fees if required.

No custom Houzez templates or PHP development should be required.

Zoho CRM

Zoho CRM will be the main sales and transaction management system.

Configure Zoho to manage:

Buyers

Sellers

Properties

Enquiries

Viewing requests

Offers

Negotiations

Deals

Offer Accepted

Sale Agreed

Booking Deposit Requested

Booking Deposit Received

The required sales pipeline is:

Enquiry → Viewing Requested → Viewing Completed → Offer Received → Negotiation → Offer Accepted → Sale Agreed → Deposit Requested → Deposit Received

Zoho should be the main system staff use to manage the transaction.

Website to Zoho

Buyer actions from the Houzez property page should feed into Zoho CRM using existing no-code functionality wherever possible.

This includes:

Enquire

Buyer details and property details recorded in Zoho.

Request Viewing

Buyer, property and requested viewing details recorded in Zoho.

Make an Offer

Buyer submits:

Name

Email

Mobile

Property

Offer amount

Finance position

Message

The offer should be recorded in Zoho and associated with the relevant buyer and property.

Use existing functionality such as Zoho Webforms, Zoho Workflow, Zoho Flow, webhooks, Zapier or suitable standard WordPress plugins.

No bespoke API or PHP development.

Sale Agreed

When an offer is accepted, staff progress the transaction in Zoho.

Once the property reaches Sale Agreed:

Zoho Deal → Sale Agreed

and

Houzez Property Status → Sale Agreed

For the MVP, this Houzez status change can be completed manually by the Agent if automatic synchronisation requires custom development.

Booking Deposit

Booking deposit management should be recorded in Zoho rather than trying to create a bespoke payment system in Houzez.

Zoho should show:

Deposit Requested

and

Deposit Received

including:

Deposit amount

Date requested

Date received

Payment reference/status

The MVP transaction ends at Deposit Received.

Important Requirement

I do not need every piece of information duplicated in both Houzez and Zoho.

The systems have different purposes:

Houzez = Property Website & Seller Listing Platform

Zoho CRM = Buyer, Offer & Sales Transaction Management

The objective is a simple and reliable workflow between the two systems, not unnecessary two-way synchronisation.

No Custom Development

The project should use existing functionality wherever possible:

Houzez

Elementor

Zoho CRM

Zoho Webforms

Zoho Workflow

Zoho Blueprint

Zoho Flow

Zapier

Standard WordPress plugins

I do not want:

Custom PHP

Custom WordPress plugins

Custom databases

Custom APIs

Theme core-file modifications

Bespoke CRM development

If a function cannot reasonably be achieved using existing functionality, it should be identified before implementation rather than custom-coded.

Handover

On completion, provide simple handover instructions showing:

How sellers are managed

How properties are approved and published

How enquiries enter Zoho

How viewing requests are managed

How offers are recorded

How an offer progresses through Zoho

How a property is marked Sale Agreed

How booking deposits are recorded

How to add/edit the Zoho pipeline and forms

MVP Completion

The project is complete when I can successfully test:

Seller registers

→ Property submitted

→ Agent approves listing

→ Property published

→ Buyer enquires

→ Buyer requests viewing

→ Buyer submits offer

→ Offer recorded in Zoho

→ Offer accepted

→ Sale Agreed

→ Houzez property marked Sale Agreed

→ Deposit requested

→ Deposit received

The final result should allow me to launch the MVP immediately and manage the complete property sales process through to booking deposit without writing or modifying code.

title: One-Site Text Scraper Automation
description:

• Deliver ready-to-run code (Python with BeautifulSoup/Scrapy + requests, or a similar stack you’re comfortable with) along with brief setup instructions.

2. Output file contains 100% of the target text elements for a sample run.  
3. No captchas triggered or IP blocks after three consecutive runs.  

If you have questions about the site or want to suggest optimizations, let me know—speed of execution and clarity of the harvested data are the main priorities.

title: Startup Funding Data Collection in Python
description:
### Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced Web Scraping Developer to collect and organize data on recently funded companies across the **USA, Europe, and Australia**.

The objective is to build a structured, accurate, and regularly updatable database of companies that have recently raised funding, including their company details, funding information, website, and key decision-makers where publicly available.

### Scope of Work

The freelancer will be responsible for:

- Identifying recently funded startups and companies across the target regions.
- Extracting data from publicly accessible websites, funding announcements, startup databases, and news sources.
- Collecting and cleaning the extracted data.
- Removing duplicate company records.
- Organizing the information into a structured Excel or CSV file.
- Ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
- Developing a reusable scraping script or automated workflow for future updates, if feasible.

### Target Geographies

- United States
- Europe (including the UK)
- Australia

### Required Data Fields

For each company, collect the following information wherever publicly available:

1. Company Name
2. Company Website
3. Company LinkedIn Profile
4. Country
5. City / Headquarters
6. Industry / Sector
7. Funding Round (Pre-Seed, Seed, Series A, Series B, etc.)
8. Amount Raised
9. Funding Announcement Date
10. Total Funding Raised (if available)
11. Investors / Venture Capital Firms
12. Company Description
13. Company Size / Employee Count (if available)
14. Founder / CEO Name
15. Founder / CEO LinkedIn Profile (if publicly available)
16. Source URL for Verification

### Preferred Technical Skills

- Python
- BeautifulSoup
- Scrapy
- Selenium or Playwright
- API integration
- Data cleaning using Pandas
- Web scraping and automation
- Experience handling structured and semi-structured data

### Deliverables

- Clean and deduplicated Excel/CSV database.
- Source URLs for validating the collected information.
- Python scraping script or automation workflow, if included in the agreed scope.
- Brief documentation explaining the data collection process.
- Clear reporting of coverage, limitations, and any unavailable fields.

### Additional Requirements

- Data should focus on recent funding announcements, preferably from the last 30–90 days, with the exact period agreed before starting.
- Data should be reliable, verifiable, and free from unnecessary duplicates.
- Scraping must comply with applicable website terms, access restrictions, and privacy requirements.
- Please mention your proposed data sources, estimated number of records, delivery timeline, and relevant previous experience in your proposal.

### To Apply

Please include:

1. Your experience with web scraping and startup funding data.
2. Tools and technologies you intend to use.
3. Proposed sources for identifying recently funded companies.
4. Estimated number of companies you can deliver.
5. Estimated project cost and completion timeline.
6. A sample of similar work, if available.

I am looking for someone who can deliver accurate, well-structured data and potentially support recurring data collection in the future.

title: Complete Website Design & Development for Premium Australian Outdoor Living Brand – POD KING -- 2
description:
We are looking for an experienced website designer/developer or small web design team to design and build a complete new website for POD KING, an Australian premium outdoor-living and modular product brand.
Our three main product categories are:
- Premium Outdoor Kitchen Pods
- Modular Outdoor Kitchens & BBQs
- Modular & Foldable Housing Options
We already have our brand, logo, product concepts, product imagery and a clear direction for the business. We now need someone to bring everything together into a professional, high-end website ready for launch in the Australian market.
Our products are higher-value purchases, so the website will initially focus primarily on showcasing our products, building trust in the POD KING brand and generating qualified customer enquiries, rather than being a traditional e-commerce store.
IMPORTANT – Homepage Live Within 5 Days
We want to move quickly.
Our first priority is to have a professionally designed, fully functional and launch-ready homepage live within approximately 5 days of commencing the project.
The homepage needs to establish the overall POD KING brand and clearly introduce our three main product categories:
Outdoor Kitchen Pods | Modular Outdoor Kitchens & BBQs | Housing Options
It should include strong product imagery, key brand messaging, calls to action, enquiry functionality and full mobile responsiveness.
Once the homepage is approved and launched, development of the remaining website can continue immediately afterward.
Please only apply if you have the availability to begin promptly and can realistically deliver a high-quality homepage within this timeframe.
Initial Website Scope
For the initial launch, we expect approximately 6–10 main pages, likely including:
- Home
- Outdoor Kitchen Pods
- Modular Outdoor Kitchens & BBQs
- Modular & Foldable Housing
- How It Works / Customisation
- About POD KING
- Gallery
- FAQ
- Contact / Get a Quote
Individual product/model pages may also sit underneath the main product categories.
The exact sitemap can be finalized with the successful freelancer.
The website will continue to grow as we introduce additional products and models.
Website Style & Design
The website needs to look and feel premium, modern, clean and high-end.
We want a design similar in quality and presentation to a premium architectural, luxury outdoor-living, high-end kitchen or home-improvement brand.
The website must be designed specifically for Australian customers.
We do not want a generic WordPress/template website with our logo and photographs simply dropped into it.
We are looking for someone with strong UI/UX and graphic design skills who can develop a distinctive visual identity for POD KING online.
The website should be highly visual, with:
- Large premium product imagery
- Clean modern typography
- Simple navigation
- Strong product presentation
- Premium page layouts
- Excellent mobile presentation
- Clear calls to action throughout the website
The overall impression should be that POD KING is an established, premium Australian brand.
Product Presentation
The website will initially focus on three main POD KING product categories.
1. Outdoor Kitchen Pods
Premium self-contained outdoor kitchen and entertainment pods designed for Australian backyards and outdoor living.
These products may include premium BBQs, rangehoods, refrigeration, sinks, storage, TVs, audio, lighting and other integrated appliances and features.
2. Modular Outdoor Kitchens & BBQs
Premium modular outdoor kitchen systems, BBQs, cabinetry, appliances and customizable configurations that customers can tailor to suit their outdoor space.
Customers should be able to clearly understand the available layouts, options, finishes and configurations.
3. Modular & Foldable Housing
Innovative modular and foldable housing solutions with different layouts, sizes, finishes and configurations available.
These will form an important additional product category within the POD KING brand.
The website needs to make it easy for customers to understand the differences between these three categories while maintaining a consistent premium POD KING brand identity.
Product pages should showcase:
- High-quality imagery
- Product features
- Specifications
- Dimensions
- Available configurations
- Colors and finishes
- Appliances/options where applicable
- Galleries/video
- Downloadable information where appropriate
- Strong enquiry and quote calls to action
Some products may display "Starting from $XX,XXX + delivery", while others will be enquiry-only.
Website Functionality
The website should include:
- Fully responsive desktop, tablet and mobile design
- Fast loading and strong technical performance
- Professional enquiry and quote forms
- Get a Quote / Enquire Now / Secure Your Install calls to action
- Product image galleries
- Video capability
- Product specifications and features
- Downloadable brochures/specification sheets
- Customer lead capture
- Social-media integration
- Google Analytics/tracking setup
- Meta Pixel capability
- Basic on-page SEO
- SEO-friendly page structure and URLs
- Google Search Console setup
- Easy-to-use CMS
- SSL/security
- Anti-spam protection
- Reliable delivery of enquiries to our Australian business email
The website should also be structured so that additional products, pages and categories can easily be added in the future.
Content We Can Supply
POD KING can provide:
- Logo and branding
- Product photos and renders
- Product specifications
- Product and factory videos
- Existing advertising graphics
- Product information
- Business information
We would also like the successful freelancer to assist with:
- Page structure and layout
- UI/UX
- Image selection
- Image optimization
- Website presentation
- Professional English website copy
- Calls to action and customer enquiry flow
We are happy to work closely with the successful freelancer and provide additional information throughout the project.
Website Platform
We are open to recommendations regarding WordPress, Webflow or another suitable mainstream CMS.
Please explain which platform you recommend for POD KING and why.
We want a website that is easy to manage, scalable and capable of growing with the business.
Ownership – Important
The finished website and associated digital assets must be 100% owned and controlled by POD KING.
This includes, where applicable:
- Website files
- Source code
- Design/source files
- Domain
- Hosting account
- CMS administrator access
- Google Analytics
- Google Search Console
- Advertising/tracking accounts
- Graphics and website assets
- Any custom code developed for the project
We do not want to be locked into a proprietary system that can only be controlled by the developer.
Who We're Looking For
We would prefer an experienced individual or small, capable web design team rather than a large expensive agency.
The successful applicant should:
- Have excellent UI/UX and graphic design skills
- Be capable of creating a genuinely premium website
- Have experience with premium product, home or lifestyle brands
- Understand Western/Australian website design
- Communicate clearly in English
- Be available to begin promptly
- Be capable of delivering the initial homepage within approximately 5 days
- Offer competitive international pricing
- Be interested in a longer-term relationship
- Be available for future website updates and development
Experience with outdoor living, kitchens, BBQs, architecture, construction, modular homes, furniture or other premium physical products would be particularly valuable.
When Applying – Please Read Carefully

Start your proposal with the words:
POD KING

Budget

description:
The project scope has been fully expanded to include the layout updates for your two existing live applications. The master Project Proposal & Scope of Work (SOW) now spans a grand total of five (5) featured image listings alongside your master developer banner profile setup and the four (4) Wix routing engines.
You can copy and paste this complete, finalized contract document straight into your [Freelancer.com](https://www.freelancer.com/) project panel.
------------------------------
##  Project Proposal & Scope of Work (SOW)## 1. Project Summary
Deployment of three (3) brand-new production Android application bundles (.aab files) to the client's Google Play Console, simultaneous storefront visual asset updates for two (2) existing live applications, master developer profile banner optimization, and custom programmatic front-end updates using Wix Velo to handle conditional role-based redirects for four (4) distinct membership tiers.
------------------------------
## 2. Detailed Task Breakdown & Deliverables## Task 1: Google Play Console Deployment & Storefront Updates (5 Apps Total + Profile Header)

* Developer Profile Header Banner Update: Update the master Developer Page Profile Header banner graphic using the provided custom 4096 × 2304 pixel image (Opaque/Solid Background). Ensure text safe-zones render correctly without breaking layouts on both mobile and desktop viewports.
* Storefront Image Updates for Existing Apps (2 Apps):
* Access the storefront listings for the two (2) applications currently live on the Google Play Store.
   * Remove the legacy background graphics and upload the updated custom 1024 × 500 pixel Feature Graphics provided by the client.
* New App Asset Upload & Configuration (3 New Apps): Set up, configure, and launch the store listing layouts using the provided production .aab bundles generated via WebToAPK.
* Compliance Setup: Link the official corporate privacy policy page: gritz.id.
* Mandatory Review Provision: Input active tester user credentials inside the "App Access" portal fields so Google's manual testing engineers can bypass the login walls to review page functionality.
* Listing Graphics Management (Per New App Verification):
* New App 1 (Gritz Grosir): Upload the 512x512 App Icon (with alpha transparency), the 1024x500 Feature Graphic, and a minimum of 2 to 8 mandatory 16:9/9:16 portrait phone screenshots. Tablet assets are completely excluded.
   * New App 2 (Gritz Production): Upload the 512x512 App Icon (with alpha transparency), the 1024x500 Feature Graphic, and a minimum of 2 to 8 mandatory 16:9/9:16 portrait phone screenshots. Tablet assets are completely excluded.
   * New App 3 (Gritz Food Delivery): Upload the 512x512 App Icon (with alpha transparency), the 1024x500 Feature Graphic, a minimum of 2 to 8 portrait phone screenshots, 2 to 8 landscape 7-inch tablet screenshots (1920x1200 pixels), and 2 to 8 landscape 10-inch tablet screenshots (1920x1200 pixels) to optimize algorithmic search indexes and tablet store formatting views.
* Metadata & Store Descriptions: Copy, paste, and publish the specific mixed-language text strings detailed below:

## App 1: Gritz Grosir

* App Title: Gritz Grosir
* Short Description: Online ordering application for hotels and restaurant supplies.
* Full Description: Gritz Grosir is an online ordering application for Hotels. Perlengkapan hotel, makanan & perlengkapan restoran, produk kebersihan, dan banyak lagi—semuanya dari satu aplikasi

## Google Play Data Safety Declaration Profile (Applies to all 3 new builds):

* Nature of the Application: Native web-wrapper framing a secure online website portal supporting standard Google OAuth social logins.
* Financial Details / In-App Payments: NO. The application features no integrated checkout engines, in-app purchases, or credit card collection forms.
* Permissions Profile: NO phone camera usage, NO media storage permissions requested, and NO foreground/background GPS tracking mechanisms utilized inside these specific wrapper configurations.
* User Account Security: Collects only fundamental account credentials (Username/Password/Email) strictly for system authentication. All data traffic is securely encrypted in transit.

------------------------------
## Task 2: Wix Velo Redirection Debugging & Multi-Role Expansion

* Role 1 Code Audit & Fix (Automated Sign-up Tier):
* Debug the pre-existing logic string tracking the case-sensitive dashboard role Menyewa Dan Mengoperasikan.

* Role 2 Code Expansion (Manual Service Staff Tier):

* Web-Wrapper Execution Check: Ensure all Velo location statements (wixLocation.to) evaluate smoothly within a standard mobile web-wrapper environment (WebToAPK), implementing necessary viewport exceptions if required to completely prevent infinite page reload loops.

------------------------------
## 3. Project Milestones & Release Conditions

* Milestone 2 ($60.00 USD) — Google Play Store Submission: Released the moment all three (3) independent application packages clear pre-upload processing errors inside the console dashboard, the master profile header updates cleanly, both live apps display their new feature graphics, and all tracks transition into the official "Under Review" standing within production tracks.

title: Full E-Commerce Website Build
description:
Project: Full WordPress & Elementor Direct Booking Platform for "Chaukhamba Homestay & Trek Basecamp"
Website: chaukhambagroup.com
Hosting: Hostinger (WordPress & Elementor Pro active)
Location: Ransi, Ukhimath, Rudraprayag, Uttarakhand 246439


Project Overview:
Build a fast-loading, mobile-friendly direct booking engine and local authority landing platform for Chaukhamba Homestay & Trek Basecamp (Roadhead basecamp for Shri Madhyamaheshwar Dham Yatra). The primary goal is capturing direct guest bookings with 2-way OTA calendar synchronization (Booking.com / Airbnb style), dynamic owner-controlled pricing, rich local SEO/AEO schema, and zero hardcoded rates.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. GLOBAL BRANDING, HEADER & FOOTER
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Header Navigation:
  * Brand Identity: Chaukhamba Group Emblem / Chaukhamba Homestay.
  * Menu Items: Stays & Camps (#stays), About Basecamp, Trek Guide, Amenities, Yatra Desk, Location, Contact.
  * Call-to-Action: "Book Room" | "Yatra Facilitation Desk" | Floating WhatsApp Widget (+91 70171 34242).
- 4-Column Statutory Footer:
  * Column 1: Brand Intro (Chaukhamba Group & Homestay overview).
  * Column 2: Quick Links & Trek Navigation.
  * Column 3: Direct Base Desk Address: Vill & PO Ransi, Ukhimath, Rudraprayag, Uttarakhand, 246439 | Helpline: +91 70171 34242.
  * Column 4: Statutory Legal Copy:
    "© 2026 Chaukhamba Group. All rights reserved. Chaukhamba Homestay, Alpine Glamping, Pahadi Mart, and Chaukhamba Digital Services are proprietary units of Chaukhamba Group™. FSSAI Basic Regd. | UTDB Regd. | Listed on Ministry of Tourism NIDHI 2.0 Portal."

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. MASTER HOMEPAGE STRUCTURE (ELEMENTOR)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Hero Section:
  * High-resolution mountain visual with Tagline: "ROOTED IN THE HIMALAYAS — Gateway to Shri Madhyamaheshwar | Motorable Roadhead Basecamp, Ransi".
  * Direct Date-picker Quick Search Bar (Check-in Date, Check-out Date, Guests, Check Availability).
- Direct Booking Benefit Banner:
  * "Book Directly on chaukhambagroup.com & Save Platform Fees (Guaranteed Best Mountain Rates)".
- About Homestay & Basecamp Amenities:
  * Garhwali hospitality highlights.
  * Amenity Badges: 24/7 Hot Water, Fresh Satvik Meals, Safe Roadhead Parking, Bonfire & Camps, Guided Mule/Porter Support, Clean Attached Washrooms.
- Stay Categories Display (Anchor: #stays):
  * Deluxe Mountain View Rooms, Standard Rooms, Alpine Meadow Dome Camps.
  * Clean cards displaying dynamic pricing tags, image gallery, room size/capacity, amenities list, and "Book Now / WhatsApp Inquiry" triggers.
- Madhyamaheshwar 16 KM Interactive Trek Guide:
  * Milestones: Ransi (Base) -> Gaundhar -> Bantoli -> Khatara -> Nanu -> Madhyamaheshwar Temple -> Buda Madhyamaheshwar.
- Guest Reviews & Social Proof Wall:
  * Verified Google Reviews embed & photo stream.
- Interactive Map & Valley Navigation:
  * Google Map embed pinpointing Ransi Basecamp with 1-tap route directions.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. NATIVE BOOKING ENGINE & DYNAMIC PRICING ARCHITECTURE (NO FIXED RATES)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Underlying Plugin: MotoPress Hotel Booking / WP Hotel Booking (or equivalent native engine).
- Owner-Controlled Dynamic Pricing Rules:
  * NO hardcoded prices. All tariffs must be 100% editable from the WordPress admin dashboard by the owner.
  * Support for Dynamic Rates: Normal weekday rate, Weekend rate, Peak pilgrimage season rate, Off-season rate, and Special discount codes.
  * Manual Date Block & Price Override: Owner must be able to change any date's price or block room availability manually in under 60 seconds from a phone browser.
- Configurable Check-out Add-ons (Prices managed in dashboard):
  * [ ] Pre-Heated Electric Blanket
  * [ ] Pahadi Organic Thali Dinner
  * [ ] Early Summit Express Breakfast Pack
  * [ ] Covered Basecamp Parking Bay
  * [ ] Luggage Cloakroom Locker
  * [ ] Mountain Trekking Pole Rental
- Payment & Ledger Workflow:
  * Razorpay / Direct UPI QR integration for advance token payment or full tariff checkout.
  * Transparent Ledger: Total Amount, Advance Token Paid, Balance Due at Basecamp Check-in.
- 2-Way OTA Calendar Sync (iCal Engine):
  * Configure 2-way iCal synchronization with external platforms (Booking.com, Airbnb, MakeMyTrip) to automatically block dates and eliminate double-booking.
- Automated Digital PDF Stay Voucher:
  * Instant voucher generation on confirmation with Booking ID, Check-in/Check-out timestamps, Google Maps coordinates, and offline trail advisory notice.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. PILGRIM YATRA FACILITATION & INQUIRY FORM (ASSISTED DESK)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Dedicated Registration / Inquiry Desk Page:
  * Captures Yatri Name, WhatsApp Number, Group Count, Planned Trek Dates, and requirements (Stay, Parking, Porter/Mule assistance).
  * Submissions trigger direct notification to owner's WhatsApp (+91 70171 34242).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. LOCAL SEO, AEO (VOICE/AI SEARCH) & PERFORMANCE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Schema Markup: JSON-LD for 'Hotel', 'LodgingBusiness', and 'LocalBusiness' with exact geographic coordinates for Ransi village.
- AEO FAQ Section: Voice search optimization targeting high-intent queries ("Best homestay in Ransi", "Madhyamaheshwar trek basecamp stay", "Parking at Ransi").
- Performance Standards: Fast loading speed on 4G/5G mobile connections, WebP images, clean Elementor DOM structure.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DELIVERABLES & VERIFICATION:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. 100% responsive on Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop.
2. Complete test booking executed with dynamic pricing, UPI token payment, and PDF voucher generation.
3. 2-way iCal sync tested and verified.
4. Rich Schema verified via Google Rich Results Test tool.
5. 2-minute video walkthrough showing how the owner can update room prices and block calendar dates independently.

title: Taxi App Developer - Bug Fixes & Publishing
description:
Senior Mobile / Full-Stack Developer – Taxi App Bug Fixes, MapTiler, GPS, Location Search & App Publishing

We have an existing taxi/private-hire platform with:

* Customer mobile app
* Driver mobile app
* Dispatcher system
* Operator/Admin portal
* Backend/API
* Real-time booking and dispatch
* GPS/live tracking
* Pricing
* Notifications
* Scheduled and ASAP bookings

We already have 2 developers working on the project. We need an additional experienced developer to review the existing codebase, fix current bugs, improve stability, resolve location/map issues, test the full booking flow and help publish the mobile apps to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

This is NOT a new project and NOT a rebuild from scratch.

We have an existing bug list which will be provided.

Main Responsibilities

You will be required to:

* Review existing source code and architecture
* Work alongside our current developers
* Reproduce and fix existing bugs
* Identify root cause rather than temporary patching
* Test fixes across connected modules
* Improve mobile app stability and performance
* Fix GPS/location problems
* Review backend/API issues where required
* Complete production builds
* Assist with Apple App Store publishing
* Assist with Google Play publishing
* Provide evidence for every completed task

IMPORTANT – MapTiler / MapLibre

We are using MapTiler / MapLibre, not Google Maps wherever technically possible.

You should have experience with:

* MapTiler
* MapLibre
* OpenStreetMap
* Geocoding
* Reverse geocoding
* Address autocomplete
* GPS coordinates
* Map markers
* Routes
* Live location
* Pickup/drop-off selection
* Distance calculations

Do not replace MapTiler with Google Maps without prior approval.

We want to keep third-party mapping/API costs under control.

VERY IMPORTANT – Intelligent Local Location Suggestions

Our location search must understand where the customer is.

Example:

Customer is in Chesterfield and types:

Tesco

The system should show nearby Chesterfield Tesco locations first.

It should NOT show Tesco London, Glasgow or other distant locations before relevant local results.

If customer types:

Train Station

Chesterfield Railway Station and nearby stations should appear first.

If customer searches:

McDonald’s

Nearby branches should appear first.

However, the customer must still be able to search for a distant specific destination.

Example:

Customer in Chesterfield types:

Heathrow Terminal 5

The system must correctly return Heathrow Airport Terminal 5 even though it is far away.

The search system therefore needs:

LOCAL RELEVANCE + SEARCH INTENT

not simply global search results.

Suggested Location Ranking

Search results should consider:

1. Customer GPS location
2. Pickup location
3. Current town/city
4. Operator service area
5. Distance
6. Exact text match
7. Place category
8. Search relevance
9. Previous searches/bookings
10. Frequently selected destinations
11. Operator-defined preferred locations

Example scoring concept:

Location Score = Text Match + Proximity + Local Relevance + User History + Popularity

Developer may propose a better technical approach.

Search Radius Logic

Search should expand intelligently.

Example:

* First search nearby area
* Then wider local area
* Then regional
* Then national if required

But a specific search such as Heathrow Airport must still work immediately.

Location Types

Search should properly support:

* Residential addresses
* Postcodes
* Streets
* Airports
* Airport terminals
* Railway stations
* Bus stations
* Hotels
* Hospitals
* Universities
* Schools
* Supermarkets
* Restaurants
* Shopping centres
* Businesses
* Car parks
* Tourist attractions
* Stadiums
* Event venues
* Landmarks

Search result display should ideally include:

Place name
Street/area
Town/city
Postcode
Distance where available

Search Performance

Autocomplete should be fast and cost-efficient.

Requirements:

* Debounce API requests
* Avoid unnecessary API calls
* Cache repeated searches where appropriate
* Remove duplicate results
* Prioritise relevant results
* Handle weak GPS
* Handle denied location permissions
* Handle internet failure
* Allow manual address entry
* Prevent blank/loading screens

Saved / Recent Locations

Where applicable support:

* Home
* Work
* Favourite places
* Recent searches
* Previous destinations
* Previous pickup locations
* Frequently used addresses

These may also improve search ranking.

Pickup / Destination Map

Review and fix:

* Current location detection
* Pickup pin
* Destination pin
* Map dragging
* Address after moving pin
* GPS accuracy
* Search result to map coordinates
* Coordinates to address
* Map zoom
* Map centring
* Route display
* Distance calculation
* Postcode searching

The latitude/longitude stored in each booking must match the selected address.

Driver Live Tracking

Review:

* Driver GPS updates
* Customer driver tracking
* Dispatcher tracking
* Background location
* Battery usage
* GPS reconnect
* Location permissions
* Incorrect/jumping markers
* Loss of signal handling

Bug Fixing Process

For every bug:

1. Reproduce issue
2. Identify root cause
3. Fix issue
4. Test locally
5. Test API interaction
6. Test connected modules
7. Regression test
8. Provide screenshot/video evidence
9. Commit through Git
10. Only mark complete after successful testing

A task is NOT complete just because code has been changed.

API / Backend

Review relevant issues involving:

* Authentication
* Booking
* Driver
* Customer
* Dispatch
* Pricing
* Location
* Notifications
* Payments
* Operator/Admin

Check for:

* Failed APIs
* Incorrect payloads
* Duplicate requests
* Timeouts
* Authentication issues
* Incorrect database updates
* Duplicate bookings
* Validation problems

Mobile App Testing

Check:

* Crashes
* Freezing
* Slow loading
* Blank screens
* Infinite loaders
* Navigation
* Login/logout
* Push notifications
* Location permissions
* GPS
* Camera/uploads
* Background behaviour
* Different Android/iPhone screen sizes

Real-World Test Example

Customer in Chesterfield:

1. Opens app
2. GPS detects location
3. Searches Tesco
4. Nearby Chesterfield Tesco appears first
5. Customer selects destination
6. Fare calculated
7. Booking created
8. Dispatcher receives booking
9. Driver receives booking
10. Customer sees driver tracking

Also test:

* Heathrow Terminal 5 search
* GPS denied
* Poor internet
* Driver losing GPS
* Duplicate booking prevention

Apple App Store

Developer must be able to assist with:

* Xcode
* Certificates
* Provisioning
* Signing
* App Store Connect
* TestFlight
* Version/build numbers
* Privacy declarations
* Location permission descriptions
* Background location
* Push notifications
* Production submission
* Resolving App Review technical issues

All company accounts and applications remain under our ownership.

Google Play

Must be able to assist with:

* Android signing
* AAB build
* Play Console
* Internal/closed testing
* Data Safety
* Location/background permissions
* Target API requirements
* Production submission
* Resolving Play Console errors

Teamwork

We already have 2 developers.

You must:

* Work professionally with existing team
* Use Git branches
* Avoid conflicting changes
* Document your work
* Coordinate major changes
* Not unnecessarily rebuild working systems

Git / Documentation

Expected:

* Feature/fix branches
* Meaningful commits
* Pull requests
* Code review
* No uncontrolled production changes

For each task provide:

Task ID
Problem
Root cause
Files changed
API/database changes
Solution
Testing performed
Evidence
Git commit/PR
Status

Security

You must:

* Keep source code confidential
* Never share API keys
* Never publish our code publicly
* Never create unauthorised access
* Never copy our code to another project
* Keep credentials secure
* Report security vulnerabilities immediately

All intellectual property belongs to our company.

Required Skills

Strong experience required in:

* Mobile development
* Android/iOS
* Existing codebase debugging
* REST APIs
* Git
* Databases
* GPS/location
* MapTiler
* MapLibre
* OpenStreetMap
* Geocoding
* Address autocomplete
* Live tracking
* Push notifications
* Apple App Store
* Google Play

title: Sophisticated Health & Wellness Website Upgrade
description:
Website Redesign – Chiropractic, Functional Medicine & Wellness Clinic

Fixed Price Budget: $400–$750 USD

Current website: MoeBodyworks.com

PROJECT OVERVIEW

I am looking for a talented, creative and budget-conscious web designer/developer to completely redesign and modernize the website for Moe Bodyworks, an established multidisciplinary healthcare and wellness clinic in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

We have been in practice for more than 20 years and already have an existing website, domain, content, photos, service information and online scheduling.

This is NOT a website being created completely from scratch.

The current website should be reviewed and useful content migrated/reorganized into a much more modern, professional, high-end website.

I want the finished website to look significantly more expensive and professional than the current site while remaining fast, simple and easy for our staff to maintain.

DESIGN STYLE

I want:

* Modern, clean and high-end
* Professional but approachable
* Energetic/athletic health & wellness feel
* Excellent photography and typography
* Strong calls to action
* Excellent mobile design
* Fast loading
* Easy navigation
* Subtle animations where appropriate

I do NOT want a generic medical template.

The website should showcase Dr. Moe and the Moe Bodyworks team and make it extremely easy for visitors to understand our services and schedule an appointment.

IMPORTANT BUDGET / DESIGN STRATEGY

We are a small independent clinic with a limited budget.

I am specifically looking for a talented freelancer who can deliver excellent work at a reasonable fixed price.

We do NOT need 20 individually custom-designed pages.

Instead, create approximately:

* 1 custom homepage
* 1 reusable service-page template
* 1 team/provider template
* 1 podcast/media template
* 1 blog/article template
* Contact/New Patient pages

Then use these templates to create/populate the individual pages.

This is intended to keep development efficient and affordable.

WEBSITE PAGES

MAIN

Home – Strong visual homepage introducing Dr. Moe, clinic, major services and BOOK NOW calls to action.

About Dr. Moe – Biography, experience, credentials, philosophy, teaching and athletic background.

Meet the Team – Provider/staff profiles.

New Patients – What to expect, first-visit information, forms/info and scheduling.

Contact/Location – Phone, address, hours, Google Map and contact form.

Book Appointment – Links to our existing scheduling systems.

SERVICES

Each major service should have its own SEO-friendly landing page using a reusable service template:

Chiropractic Care
Spine and extremity chiropractic, sports care, injuries, mobility and wellness/maintenance care.

Functional Medicine & Lab Testing
Fatigue, digestive/metabolic health, nutrition, food sensitivities, gut health, cardiovascular/metabolic markers, lifestyle medicine and functional laboratory testing.

Clinical Nutrition

Massage Therapy

Acupuncture

Sports Performance & Injury Rehabilitation

Cold Laser / Photobiomodulation

Orthotics

Detoxification / Wellness Programs

Body Composition / InBody

X-Ray / Diagnostic Imaging

Existing useful content should be migrated from our current website whenever possible.

ANIMAL HEALTH

Animal chiropractic is an important part of our practice.

Create a strong Animal Chiropractic landing page covering dogs, horses/performance animals, older animals, mobility, musculoskeletal problems, injury/recovery and what to expect at an appointment.

Include clear scheduling/new-animal-patient CTAs.

DR. MOE’S PAWCAST

We are launching an animal-health podcast called Dr. Moe’s PAWCAST.

Create a page/template allowing us to easily add:

* Episodes
* Embedded YouTube/video
* Guest bios
* Episode descriptions
* Spotify/Apple/YouTube links
* Guest inquiry/application
* Animal-health consultation/service CTA

HAPPY, HEALTHY, WEALTHY PODCAST

Create a page introducing Dr. Moe’s Happy, Healthy, Wealthy Podcast with featured episodes, embedded videos, podcast links and links to its separate website/resources.

SPEAKING & MEDIA

Create a page positioning Dr. Moe for corporate/community health presentations, conferences, podcasts and media appearances.

Include a BOOK DR. MOE TO SPEAK inquiry form.

BLOG / RESOURCES

Create an easy-to-manage blog/resource section.

We need to be able to publish future articles ourselves without hiring a developer.

FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS

Website must be:

* Fully responsive/mobile optimized
* Fast loading
* SEO friendly
* SSL secured
* Easy for nontechnical staff to edit
* Clean and modern
* Compatible with current browsers
* Built on a widely supported CMS

WordPress is acceptable/preferred, but I am open to recommendations.

The site should include:

* Clear BOOK NOW buttons
* Existing scheduling integration/links
* Click-to-call on mobile
* Contact forms with spam protection
* Google Maps
* Social links
* Podcast/video embedding
* Blog
* Basic local SEO
* Analytics/Search Console capability

No custom scheduling software is required. We already have scheduling systems.

SEO / WEBSITE MIGRATION

This is an existing website, so we do NOT want to unnecessarily lose existing Google rankings.

Developer should:

* Review existing URLs
* Preserve important URLs where practical
* Create 301 redirects for changed URLs
* Set page titles/meta descriptions
* Use proper H1/H2 structure
* Optimize images
* Add appropriate alt text
* Create XML sitemap
* Ensure Google indexing
* Set up basic local SEO/schema where appropriate
* Preserve/connect Analytics and Search Console if currently available

CONTENT

Please review MoeBodyworks.com before bidding.

A substantial amount of content already exists.

Developer should migrate useful text/photos and reorganize them within the new design. We will provide updated photos, staff information and additional content when necessary.

Please do NOT assume we will manually recreate and provide every existing page.

OWNERSHIP – VERY IMPORTANT

Upon final payment, Moe Bodyworks must have complete ownership and administrator access to the website.

The domain and primary accounts will remain under our control.

We must receive:

* Full website administrator access
* Website/database/files
* Hosting access as applicable
* Theme/template access
* Plugin information
* Forms
* Analytics/Search Console access/configuration
* Any project-specific design files

Do not build the website on a proprietary system that prevents us from moving it to another developer or hosting provider later.

PAID SOFTWARE

Before using any paid plugin, theme or software, tell us:

1. Cost
2. Whether cost is one-time or recurring
3. Why it is needed

We strongly prefer free/low-cost solutions.

There should be no surprise monthly fees.

PROJECT COMPLETION

Before final payment, developer must test:

* Desktop/mobile/tablet
* Navigation
* Appointment links
* Forms
* Phone/email links
* Podcast/social links
* Page speed
* Redirects/404 errors
* Contact/location information

We would also like a short screen-recorded tutorial showing how to edit text/photos and add blog/podcast content.

MILESTONES

We prefer milestone payments:

15% – Homepage/design direction approved
25% – Templates/navigation completed
30% – Pages/content migrated
20% – Mobile, SEO, testing & revisions
10% – Launch, credentials transferred & final approval

Final payment is released after the website is functioning correctly and administrator access has been provided.

PLEASE INCLUDE IN YOUR BID

Please answer:

1. Total FIXED PRICE
2. Completion time
3. Recommended platform/CMS
4. 3 LIVE websites you personally designed/developed
5. Healthcare/wellness examples if available
6. Is content migration included?
7. Is mobile optimization included?
8. Is basic SEO included?
9. Are 301 redirects included?
10. Is page-speed optimization included?
11. Number of revisions included
12. Required paid themes/plugins
13. All ongoing costs after launch
14. Confirmation that I receive full admin access/ownership
15. Can I easily edit the website myself?
16. Is the short training video included?
17. List anything in this description that is NOT included in your price.

title: Rediseño elegante de sitio web
description:
Desearía realizar una renovación completa de mi página web profesional, deselys-psicologo.com, desarrollada actualmente en WordPress y alojada en Raiola Networks.

La web lleva años en funcionamiento y dispone de contenidos y URLs ya indexados y posicionados en Google. Por este motivo, no deseo simplemente crear una web nueva y sustituir la actual, sino realizar una renovación que preserve, en la medida de lo posible, el posicionamiento SEO adquirido.

Mi intención es modernizar completamente el diseño, mejorar la estructura y navegación, reorganizar y actualizar los contenidos y conseguir una web más limpia, actual, rápida y adaptada a dispositivos móviles, manteniendo WordPress como CMS. Me interesa también contar con su criterio y propuestas respecto al diseño, experiencia de usuario y arquitectura de la información, y no únicamente trasladar la estructura actual a una nueva apariencia.

Un requisito especialmente importante sería realizar, antes de modificar la estructura o efectuar la migración, una auditoría de las URLs actuales y de su valor SEO, que permita determinar qué contenidos y URLs conviene conservar, actualizar, fusionar o eliminar y establecer, cuando corresponda, las redirecciones 301 adecuadas.

Las URLs que tengan tráfico, enlaces externos, posicionamiento o autoridad deberían conservarse siempre que resulte razonable. Cuando una URL tenga que desaparecer o modificarse, debería establecerse la correspondiente redirección hacia el contenido equivalente, evitando pérdidas innecesarias de posicionamiento.

Preferiría que el trabajo se realizase inicialmente en un entorno de staging privado y no indexado, manteniendo mientras tanto la web actual completamente operativa. Mi hosting actual es Raiola Networks y dispongo de acceso a cPanel/Installatron.

Una vez finalizada la nueva versión y antes de pasarla a producción, considero importante revisar:

• URLs y redirecciones 301.
• Títulos SEO y metadescripciones.
• Enlaces internos.
• Sitemap e indexación.
• Google Search Console.
• Velocidad y Core Web Vitals.
• Adaptación responsive para móvil y tablet.
• Formularios de contacto.
• Cookies, privacidad y RGPD.
• Seguridad general de WordPress.
• Comprobación posterior a la migración para detectar posibles errores relevantes de indexación, rastreo o posicionamiento.

Respecto a la arquitectura de contenidos, estoy valorando diferentes áreas profesionales y una sección de Recursos. La estructura definitiva se concretaría antes de comenzar el desarrollo, ya que también quiero reorganizar y actualizar buena parte de los textos existentes.

Dentro de Recursos me gustaría integrar el blog/artículos, vídeos y publicaciones/libros, evitando que cada uno de estos contenidos ocupe innecesariamente una posición independiente en el menú principal.

También es importante para mí que, una vez finalizado el proyecto, pueda gestionar con facilidad los contenidos habituales de la web —modificar textos, publicar artículos, incorporar vídeos o nuevas publicaciones— sin depender necesariamente del desarrollador para estas tareas.

No busco únicamente un cambio estético. Me interesa especialmente que diseño, experiencia de usuario, arquitectura de contenidos y SEO técnico se contemplen conjuntamente y que la transición desde la web actual se realice de manera controlada.

Si este tipo de proyecto encaja con su forma de trabajar, agradecería que me indicaran:

– Cómo plantearían el proceso y sus diferentes fases.
– Si realizan la auditoría SEO y de URLs previa a la renovación.
– Cómo gestionan el entorno de staging y la posterior migración.
– Qué partes del proyecto realizan directamente y, en su caso, cuáles se realizan mediante colaboradores externos.
– Plazo aproximado de realización.
– Presupuesto orientativo y qué servicios quedarían incluidos.
– Si ofrecen mantenimiento y soporte posterior, qué incluiría y cuál sería su coste aproximado.

Puedo facilitarles información adicional sobre la web actual para que puedan valorar con mayor precisión el alcance del proyecto.

Muchas gracias por su atención.

Un cordial saludo,

# eCentral Marketplace — Website Redesign & SEO Project

**Website:** https://ecentralmarketplace.com/

We are looking for an experienced **WordPress designer/developer and SEO specialist** to redesign and optimize our entire website. The goal is to create a modern, professional, mobile-friendly website that is easy to navigate, SEO-optimized, and built to generate more leads.

## 1. Complete Website Redesign

* Redesign the entire website with a modern, professional look.
* Improve navigation, layout, typography, images, and overall user experience.
* Create a clean, mobile-friendly design for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
* Improve homepage and all existing service pages.
* Add stronger calls-to-action and quote/contact buttons.
* Improve forms, testimonials, FAQs, footer, and menus.
* Use professional, relevant images throughout the site.
* Optimize the design for conversions and lead generation.

## 2. SEO Content & Keyword Optimization

* Perform keyword research for all major insurance services.
* Identify primary, secondary, long-tail, and local keywords.
* Rewrite and improve existing website content for SEO and conversions.
* Make content professional, clear, original, and easy to read.
* Optimize content around search intent without keyword stuffing.
* Add relevant FAQs and calls-to-action where needed.

## 3. On-Page SEO

Optimize every important page for:

* SEO titles and meta descriptions
* H1, H2, and H3 headings
* Primary and secondary keywords
* URLs/slugs
* Image file names and alt text
* Internal linking
* Anchor text
* Breadcrumbs where appropriate

Make sure each page has a clear SEO focus and unique metadata.

## 4. Technical & Back-End SEO

Perform a complete technical SEO audit and fix issues involving:

* XML sitemap
* Robots.txt
* Indexing and crawlability
* Canonical URLs
* Redirects and broken links
* Duplicate content
* Mobile usability
* Website speed
* Core Web Vitals
* Image optimization
* Plugins and unnecessary scripts
* Schema/structured data
* WordPress SEO settings

Review Google Search Console if access is provided and correct applicable issues.

## 5. Create 4 New State-Specific Pages

Create four unique, SEO-optimized pages for:

* Florida
* Georgia
* North Carolina
* Texas

Each page should include:

* Unique state-specific content
* SEO title and meta description
* H1/H2/H3 structure
* Relevant insurance services
* State-specific keywords
* FAQs
* Internal links
* Images with optimized alt text
* Strong calls-to-action
* Quote/contact opportunities

Do not simply duplicate one page and change the state name. Each page should provide unique and useful content.

## Final Deliverables

The completed website must be:

* Professionally redesigned
* SEO optimized
* Mobile responsive
* Fast and functional
* Properly structured for search engines
* Optimized for lead generation
* Fully tested on desktop and mobile
* Free of broken links and major technical issues

**Please provide examples of websites you have designed and SEO-optimized, preferably for insurance, healthcare, financial, or other service businesses.**

This is not intended to be a generic dropshipping store. I want the website to look and feel like a **real, trustworthy pet brand**, with a clean design, strong product presentation, and a smooth customer experience.

## Project Scope

### 1. Pet Niche & Product Research

Before building the store, I’d like help researching and narrowing down suitable pet products for the UK market.

The focus should be on:

* Practical, problem-solving pet products
* Products with good customer demand/potential
* Healthy profit margins
* Products suitable for UK customers
* Avoiding random or oversaturated products where possible

You should also research suitable suppliers such as:

* CJdropshipping
* Spocket
* Syncee
* Other reliable UK/EU-friendly suppliers

Supplier research should consider:

* Product quality
* UK/EU shipping times
* Tracking availability
* Product costs
* Shipping costs
* Estimated margins
* Supplier reliability

### 2. Shopify Store Development

Once the product and supplier direction is established, you will build the Shopify store around the selected products.

The store should have a **clean, modern, professional pet-brand appearance**, rather than looking like a typical dropshipping website.

Required structure/pages include:

* Homepage
* Shop / Collections
* Product Pages
* About Us
* Contact Us
* FAQ
* Shipping & Delivery
* Returns & Refunds
* Privacy Policy
* Terms & Conditions

### 3. Product & Store Setup

Please properly configure:

* Products
* Product variants
* Collections
* Navigation/menu
* Product categories
* Cart
* Shipping settings
* Contact forms
* Email signup/newsletter
* Essential Shopify functionality
* Trust elements
* Calls-to-action
* Basic SEO structure

Product pages should be customer-focused and clearly communicate:

* Product benefits
* Key features
* How the product solves a problem
* Product specifications
* Shipping information
* Trust elements
* Clear Add to Cart/CTA sections

### 4. Responsive Design

The website must work properly across:

* Desktop
* Laptop
* Tablet
* Mobile

Mobile design is particularly important because a significant portion of e-commerce traffic is expected to come from mobile users.

### 5. Testing Before Launch

Before considering the project complete, I want the entire store tested from a customer's perspective.

Please test:

* Homepage navigation
* Collections
* Product pages
* Add to Cart
* Cart functionality
* Checkout flow
* Shipping settings
* Contact forms
* Newsletter signup
* All important links
* Mobile responsiveness
* Product images/content
* General store functionality

Any issues found during testing should be fixed before final delivery.

## What I’m Looking For

The ideal freelancer should have:

* Strong Shopify development experience
* Experience building e-commerce stores
* Good understanding of Shopify themes and customization
* Experience with dropshipping/supplier integrations
* Good understanding of UK e-commerce
* Strong eye for modern, professional design
* Ability to create conversion-focused product pages
* Attention to detail
* Good communication
* Ability to independently research and make practical recommendations

Please **do not apply if you only install a Shopify theme and import products**. I’m looking for someone who can contribute to the overall store structure, product/supplier research, user experience, and technical setup.

## To Apply

Please provide:

1. **2–3 Shopify stores you have built** that are relevant to this project.
2. Your experience with **pet stores or dropshipping stores**.
3. Which Shopify themes you would recommend for this type of brand and why.
4. Your experience with **CJdropshipping, Spocket, Syncee, or similar suppliers**.
5. Your estimated timeline.
6. Your fixed project price or pricing structure.
7. A brief explanation of how you would approach this project from research → store development → testing → launch.

I’m looking for someone who can take ownership of the project and help turn the initial idea into a **professional, launch-ready UK pet e-commerce store**.

I need to migrate my e-commerce data from BigCommerce to Shopify. The data includes:

- Products
- Customer information
- Order history

I prefer using an automated migration tool. No changes to product information are necessary during the migration. 

Requirements Summary – SoCalMotoGear BigCommerce to Shopify Migration

SoCalMotoGear requires a complete migration of its BigCommerce store to Shopify under the existing domain, www.socalmotogear.com. The store's full trading history and search presence come with it: 148 products across 12 categories and 8 brands, customer accounts, orders of history, 20 content pages, 17 News posts, and product reviews. It also includes a complete redirect map covering all 205 current URLs, among them 82 legacy product links carried over from the original Volusion store, so hard-earned SEO equity is preserved at cut-over.

The new store will emphasize clarity, fast fitment-led navigation, and strong product presentation. A streamlined homepage will introduce the Gold Wing, Harley and universal lighting ranges, highlight best sellers and new releases, and take riders straight to the right parts for their bike. Product pages will be optimized to show fitment, lens and colour options, required add-ons such as the LH40GW power hub, specifications, installation videos, warranty information and customer reviews.

With an established catalog, a loyal rider base and an active search presence, the migration will prioritize:

zero-loss data migration (products and options, customers, order history, reviews and gift certificates)
SEO continuity through complete redirect mapping, including legacy Volusion URLs
keeping Authorize.net as the payment gateway, with clear guidance on the most cost-effective Shopify plan and processing setup
fast product discovery and mobile-first performance
a lower, simpler ongoing cost of ownership now that BigCommerce's new plan caps and gateway fees apply
Navigation will mirror today's structure: Home, Shop (Gold Wing, Harley, Other Lighting, Accessories, Clearance), Image Gallery, FAQ, News, and Contact. Key notices such as the PAH60 stop-use directive, warranty guidelines and international shipping information will stay easy to find. The site will be styled consistently with the SoCalMotoGear brand and built to scale as new SKUs, bike models or dealer channels are added.

Overall, the objective is to launch a clean, modern Shopify store that carries over everything SoCalMotoGear has built (catalog, customers, orders, reviews and search rankings) while giving the team a platform with a lower, more predictable cost and the flexibility to keep their preferred payment setup.

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Experience with both BigCommerce and Shopify
- Proficient in automated migration tools
- Attention to detail to ensure data integrity

title: Global Digital Product Sales Funnel
description:
I’m launching a digital-only storefront aimed at customers worldwide and I need a streamlined funnel-style website that moves visitors smoothly from landing page to checkout. The core requirements are simple yet non-negotiable: every buyer must create an account or log in before paying, and the payment flow has to support international cards without a hitch. PayPal, Stripe or any comparable gateway that handles multi-currency transactions will work—as long as payouts reach me reliably.

Here’s what success looks like for me:  
• A modern, mobile-first funnel (landing, product details, checkout, confirmation) built on a platform such as Shopify.  
• Mandatory user registration/login with email verification and email OTP. Social logins are a plus but not essential.  
• Seamless payment gateway integration that processes international payments, issues receipts, and unlocks the download link instantly after a successful charge.  
• A secure file-delivery mechanism that limits each purchase to the rightful buyer (expiring links or account-based downloads).  
• Basic analytics hooks (Google Analytics or similar) so I can track conversion rates through each funnel step such as ads from different sources.  
• Clean, on-brand UI—nothing fancy, just professional, fast, and trustworthy.

I’ll supply copy, branding assets, and the first set of product files. You’ll spin up the site, configure the gateway, test the full purchase flow from sign-up to download, then hand off clear documentation on how to add new products and run refunds. Also, you will hand off all the code and everything you have developed source code completely

If that scope fits your skill set and timeline, let’s talk and get this funnel live.

title: Custom Laravel Shopify Multi-Step Checkout
description:
I need my existing Shopify store to hand shoppers over to a Laravel-powered custom checkout flow and then return the completed order data back to Shopify. The focus is a smooth, secure multi-step checkout, built in Laravel, that perfectly mirrors our brand’s look and feel—fonts, colours, spacing, icons, everything.

Key objectives  
• Pull the cart, customer and shipping data from Shopify in real time.  
• Walk the user through our tailored multi-step screens (address, shipping method, payment, confirmation).  
• Push the finished order—including any edits made during checkout—back to Shopify so fulfilment continues there as usual.  

Design & UX  
The checkout must match our current storefront style exactly; I will provide brand guidelines, Figma files and assets. Mobile responsiveness is essential.

Technical notes  
• Shopify Storefront API or Admin API for cart and order sync.  
• Laravel 10 (or latest LTS) for the checkout app, using Blade or your preferred component system.  
• Stripe and Apple Pay are already set up, so the payment step should integrate those gateways first; architecture must stay open for additional gateways later.  
• CSRF protection, rate limiting and PCI-compliant handling for payment tokens are mandatory.

Acceptance criteria  
1. User completes a full purchase through the Laravel flow without leaving the branded experience.  
2. Orders, line items and customer info appear in Shopify Admin instantly after payment.  
3. All steps load in under 1.5 s on 4G and pass Lighthouse performance audits (>90).  
4. Code is clean, well-commented and committed to a private Git repo I will provide.  

If you’ve built custom Shopify checkouts with Laravel (or similar frameworks) and can demonstrate solid API experience, let’s get started.

title: Interactive Clothing E-commerce website
description:
# Custom Clothing & Embroidery E-Commerce Website Developer Needed

**Budget: ₹1,50,000 INR**

I am looking for an experienced **full-stack web developer or small development team** to build a premium e-commerce website for my clothing/embroidery brand.

This is **not a basic clothing store or simple Shopify website**.

The main feature is an **interactive clothing customization system** where customers can upload their own logo, photo, artwork or text and visually choose exactly where they want the embroidery on the shirt before placing the order.

## Main Features Required

### 1. Customer Login

* Mobile number + OTP login
* Customer profile
* Saved addresses
* Order history
* Wishlist
* Saved customized designs
* Reorder previous products

### 2. Clothing Store

Products will include:

* T-Shirts
* Oversized T-Shirts
* Shirts
* Polo Shirts
* Hoodies
* Sweatshirts
* Jackets
* Future clothing categories

Product pages should include:

* Multiple images
* Product videos
* Size and color selection
* Fabric details
* Size chart
* Price
* Stock availability
* Reviews
* Wishlist
* Buy Now
* Add to Cart
* Customize Product

Customers must also be able to purchase a product **without customization**.

## 3. MOST IMPORTANT — CUSTOMIZATION STUDIO

When a customer clicks **"Customize This Product"**, an interactive customization editor should open.

Customer should be able to:

* Upload PNG/JPG/JPEG/SVG/PDF designs where technically suitable
* Upload logos
* Upload artwork
* Upload photos
* Add custom text
* Select embroidery location
* Move the design
* Resize the design
* Rotate the design
* Delete/reset the design
* Select embroidery/thread color
* Add multiple embroidery locations

### Embroidery locations should include:

* Left chest
* Right chest
* Center chest
* Back
* Sleeve
* Collar
* Pocket area
* Other supported areas

The customer should see a **visual preview of the shirt with their customization** before ordering.

## 4. LIVE CUSTOMIZATION PRICE

The system should automatically calculate customization charges.

Example:

Shirt = ₹999

Chest embroidery = ₹199

Sleeve embroidery = ₹149

Total = ₹1,347

Admin should be able to change customization pricing from the admin panel.

## 5. CUSTOMER APPROVAL

Before payment, show:

* Product preview
* Uploaded design
* Embroidery location
* Size
* Color
* Customization charges
* Product price
* Final total

Customer should confirm that they have reviewed the customization before placing the order.

## 6. CART & CHECKOUT

Cart should show:

* Product
* Size
* Color
* Customization preview
* Customization details
* Product price
* Customization fee
* Discount
* Shipping
* Final amount

Checkout should support:

* UPI
* Credit card
* Debit card
* Net banking
* Wallets
* COD if enabled

Use a reliable Indian payment gateway such as Razorpay/Cashfree or another suitable solution.

## 7. ORDER MANAGEMENT

Customer should be able to track:

Order Placed → Payment Confirmed → Design Review → Production → Embroidery Completed → Quality Check → Packed → Shipped → Delivered

## 8. ADMIN PANEL

Admin should be able to:

* Add/edit/delete products
* Manage categories
* Manage product images
* Manage sizes/colors
* Manage inventory
* Set product prices
* Set embroidery/customization prices
* Manage supported embroidery locations
* Manage thread colors
* View customer uploaded designs
* Approve/reject designs
* Manage orders
* Update production status
* Manage customers
* Manage coupons
* Manage reviews
* Manage banners
* View basic sales reports

## 9. PRODUCTION ORDER SHEET

For every customized order, generate a production sheet containing:

* Order ID
* Product
* Size
* Color
* Customer design
* Embroidery location
* Design dimensions
* Thread color
* Customization instructions
* Customer-approved preview

This will be used by my embroidery/production team.

## 10. MOBILE-FIRST DESIGN

The website must work extremely well on mobile phones.

Customers should be able to upload designs from their phone and use touch gestures to:

* Move
* Resize
* Rotate
* Zoom

The website should have a premium fashion/Gen-Z appearance.

I want an original design inspired by the convenience of platforms like Myntra and Flipkart, **not a direct copy of their UI**.

## 11. FUTURE SCALABILITY

The website should be developed so that I can later add:

* Android app
* iOS app
* Physical-store self-order customization kiosk
* 360° product viewing
* AI design assistance
* Multiple production locations
* Advanced shipping integration

These future features do not all need to be included in the ₹1.5 lakh MVP, but the architecture should allow future expansion.

# BUDGET

**Maximum initial budget: ₹1,50,000 INR**

I am looking for a developer who can build a **strong MVP within this budget**.

Please do not quote for unnecessary features that are not essential for Version 1.

# PLEASE INCLUDE IN YOUR PROPOSAL

1. Your total quotation
2. Development timeline
3. Technology stack
4. Previous e-commerce projects
5. Previous product customization projects, if any
6. Examples/links of your previous work
7. How you will build the customization editor
8. What features are included in ₹1.5 lakh
9. Any third-party/API/plugin costs
10. Hosting costs
11. OTP/SMS costs
12. Payment gateway costs
13. Maintenance/support period
14. Source-code ownership
15. Whether complete source code will be handed over
16. Milestone/payment structure

**Important:** I am specifically looking for someone who can actually develop the customization functionality. Please do not apply if you only build basic template-based e-commerce websites.

I am open to using Shopify/WooCommerce/custom development or another suitable technology, but please recommend the most practical solution for achieving the required customization experience within the budget.

The goal is to launch a professional MVP first and then expand it into a larger custom clothing platform.

title: E-commerce Growth Strategist Needed for Small Dog Treat Brand — Shopify + TikTok Shop + Creator/Affiliate Growth
description:
I’m the owner of Zoomies Pet Food, a small Colorado-based dog treat brand.

We already sell successfully through farmers markets and local events, and we have strong customer feedback and repeat interest. The challenge is that our online sales are still very limited, and I want to build a sustainable online sales channel.
I’m looking for someone who can help me figure out what will actually work for a small brand at our stage and then help execute the strategy.

What I’m NOT looking for

I’m not looking for someone who will immediately tell me to spend thousands of dollars on Facebook or TikTok ads.

I have a limited starting budget, so I want to build the foundation first, test what works, and scale from there.

I also don't need someone who only knows how to make ads. I need someone who understands the entire path from:
Content → discovery → product interest → purchase → repeat customer

What I’m hoping to build

I’m currently considering a combination of:
- Shopify optimization and conversion improvements
- TikTok Shop setup and growth
- Organic TikTok content strategy
- TikTok Shop creator/affiliate marketing
- UGC and creator partnerships
- Product bundles/offers that make sense for online orders
- Email/repeat-purchase strategy
- Paid advertising once we have proven what converts
I’m open to your recommendations. If you think something above is NOT the right approach for my business, I want you to tell me.
What I need help with
Initially, I’d like someone to:
1. Review my current Shopify store and online customer journey
2. Review my current content and social presence
3. Look at my products, pricing, bundles and offers from an e-commerce perspective
4. Help me determine which sales channels make the most sense
5. Help set up or improve TikTok Shop
6. Develop a realistic creator/affiliate strategy
7. Help me use the product videos and photos I already create
8. Establish a way to track what is actually generating sales
9. Recommend what we should test first
10. Eventually help scale the strategies that are producing actual purchases
About the business

Zoomies is a one-person business, so I need someone who is comfortable working with a small brand and a limited budget.
I currently handle the products, production, content, social media, website and local sales myself.
I already have a library of product photos and videos and am comfortable continuing to create content. I need help turning that content and our existing local success into online sales.
Ideal experience

You should have experience with at least several of the following:

- Shopify
- TikTok Shop
- TikTok Shop Affiliate
- Creator/influencer marketing
- UGC
- DTC/e-commerce
- Conversion optimization
- Email/repeat customer strategy
- TikTok content strategy
- Meta/TikTok advertising

Experience with pet products, food, treats, supplements, or other physical consumer products is a plus.
What I’d like to see in your application

Please tell me:

1. What would you focus on during the first 30 days if you were working with a small brand like Zoomies?
2. Have you helped a small e-commerce brand go from primarily offline/local sales to consistent online sales?
3. If you have TikTok Shop experience, please provide examples of actual results.
4. If you have experience with creator/affiliate marketing, tell me about one campaign you managed and what the results were.
5. Please provide 1–3 relevant case studies with actual numbers if possible.
I’m much more interested in realistic, measurable results than impressive-sounding claims.
Project structure

I’m open to starting with a paid audit/strategy/setup phase before committing to ongoing work.
If we’re a good fit, I’d be interested in ongoing help with implementation and growth.

Please don't apply if your primary recommendation is simply to increase the advertising budget. I’m looking for someone who can help me build the right sales system first and then scale what works.

title: WhatsApp-Based Lead Qualification System
description:
We are looking for an experienced freelancer to build a reliable and customizable WhatsApp lead qualification, routing and tracking system for our business.

We currently use/are evaluating platforms such as Interakt, but we are open to using n8n + WhatsApp Cloud API or another suitable low-cost platform if it provides better flexibility and reliability.

AI is NOT required for this project. The workflow will be based on predefined questions, options, conditions and rules.

What we need

The system should handle incoming WhatsApp enquiries and automatically identify whether the person is a new lead or an existing contact.

1. New Lead Detection
-Start the lead qualification workflow only when both conditions are met:
The WhatsApp number is not saved as a contact in our WhatsApp Business account; and
We have never previously received a message from that WhatsApp number.

If either condition is not met, the new-lead qualification workflow should not start.

Existing customers/contacts should NOT receive the new-lead welcome/qualification workflow unnecessarily.


2. Lead Qualification Workflow
We have a basic workflow design that we will provide.
The system should:

Send predefined questions/messages.
Provide selectable options where appropriate.
Capture customer responses.
Store the information collected during the conversation.
Move to the next step based on the customer's response.
Create a lead record once the required information is collected.

3. Important – Human Handover / Fallback

This is one of our most important requirements.

If the customer replies with something outside the predefined options or sends a message that requires human attention:

The automation should stop and hand the conversation over to a human/team member.

However, the conversation and lead information already collected must be preserved.

The workflow must NOT:

Restart from the beginning.
Send the welcome message again.
Create another duplicate lead.
Continue sending automated questions after human takeover.

Once handed over, the assigned team member should be able to continue the conversation normally.

If the customer sends another message after handover, it should remain with the human/team member .

4. Lead Assignment

Once a lead is captured, it should be assigned to the appropriate team member/partner based on predefined rules.

For example:

Product/requirement
Location
Lead type
Other criteria that we may define

The system should support automatic assignment and clearly show who owns the lead.

Platform / Technical Requirements

We are not fixed on Interakt.

We are open to:

n8n + WhatsApp Cloud API
Interakt
AiSensy
WATI
Another suitable WhatsApp API/CRM/automation platform

The priority is:

Reliability + easy customization + low ongoing cost + proper lead tracking.

We would prefer a solution where business rules can easily be changed later without rebuilding the entire system.

Important

We do NOT want a generic chatbot.

We need a proper state-based lead workflow where the system remembers the customer's progress and knows:

New lead vs existing customer
Which step the customer is currently at
What information has already been collected
Whether automation is active or stopped
Whether the conversation has been handed to a human
Who is responsible for the lead
What the current lead status is

The workflow should be designed to prevent duplicate messages, duplicate leads and accidental restarting of conversations.

What we will provide

We already have a basic workflow design and business requirements.

We will provide this to the selected freelancer and expect the freelancer to convert it into a technically robust workflow.

title: Bulk Excel-to-PDF Formatting
description:
I have a batch of more than ten Excel workbooks that must be turned into polished, press-ready PDFs. Before you generate each file, I need three specific customisations applied:

• Formatting changes – adjust column widths, fonts, margins and page breaks so every page sits neatly on standard A4/Letter.  
• Adding headers/footers – insert my logo on the left, the file name centred and the date on the right, mirrored on every page of the export.  
• Including charts/graphs – keep all embedded charts exactly where they belong and ensure they render sharply in the final PDF.

If you can automate the process with a reusable VBA macro, Power Query routine, or a reliable Python script (openpyxl, pandas, reportlab, etc.), that would be ideal; I want to be able to run the same workflow on future files without manual tweaking.

Deliverables:  
1. Individually named PDF files for each source workbook.  
2. The automation script or macro with brief step-by-step instructions.

title: Advanced Excel Automation & Analysis
description:
