The core of the job is twofold: build reliable data-cleaning routines (deduping, missing-value handling, consistent formatting) and embed a regression model that outputs coefficients, R-squared, residual plots and an at-a-glance summary sheet.  

Please code everything in native Excel VBA—no external add-ins—so that with one click I can process any file that follows the same column structure. Comment the code clearly, label formulas, and supply a short user guide so I can tweak inputs or thresholds later.  

Acceptance criteria  
• One macro-enabled workbook (.xlsm) containing all cleaning and regression procedures  
• Dynamic dashboard sheet with key statistics and charts automatically refreshed after each run  
• End-to-end execution in under 30 seconds on ~20 k rows  
• Solution passes tests on several unseen datasets I will supply before sign-off  

Once completed, we’ll do a brief walkthrough to ensure I can maintain or extend the script going forward. Looking forward to seeing how you optimise classic Excel tools—Power Query, structured references, VBA—to make this process seamless.

title: Python Bot for Audiobook TTS & Localization
description:
Job Post Title:
Python / Automation Expert Needed for Pocket FM-Style Multi-Voice TTS Audiobook Bot (Dialogue Aware)

Job Description:
Hi, I run a novel-publishing platform and create high-volume audiobooks daily. I am looking for an expert Python developer to build a dedicated Text-to-Speech (TTS) Automation, Translation & Content Editing Tool. 

Since I process large files daily, I need a robust, permanent solution. If you cannot deliver the core features within a free/stable architecture without crashing, please do not bid.

Core Project Requirements (Triple Input Mode):
1. Multi-Functional Modes: 
   * Mode A (Full Audiobook Pipeline): The bot takes an English TXT file, translates it to Hindi, applies Pocket FM-style localization, and exports to a Multi-Voice MP3.
   * Mode B (Direct Hindi TTS): If I upload a file that is already in Hindi, the bot must skip the translation step entirely and directly process the Hindi text for character/voice detection and MP3 export.
   * Mode C (Plain Text Translation): The bot must also function as a simple translator. If selected, it should take a 10 MB English TXT file and directly translate it into plain Hindi text WITHOUT any modifications, edits, or name alterations, and export it back as a plain .txt file (no audio generation).

2. Pocket FM-Style Localization & Editing (Bulk Replace): The tool must automatically Indianize the entire text without altering the core story or plot. It must accept a secondary configuration/mapping file (Excel or text) to bulk-replace content. For example:
   * Names: Xiao Chen Rohan, Lin Fan Lakhan
   * Currency/Terms: Yuan Rupees, Sect/Clan Ashram/Gharana
   * Locations: Chinese cities Indian cities (e.g., Delhi, Mumbai)

3. Dialogue-Aware Multi-Voice Output: The system must automatically scan the novel text file. Anything inside quotation marks ("...") must be rendered in a Female/Character Voice, and the standard text outside quotes must be rendered in a Male/Narrator Voice (using free Microsoft Edge-TTS or similar clear, natural Indian voices like Madhur/Swara).

4. No Code Formatting Needed From Me: I will NOT manually format text files with tags like "Narrator:" or "Rahul:". The code must be smart enough to parse native novel structures dynamically in both English and Hindi inputs.

5. Large File Handling (Up to 10 MB): The pipeline must easily handle text files up to 10 MB at once without freezing, hanging, or throwing memory/timeout errors. It should split the book into chapters/parts automatically and merge them cleanly into separate exported MP3s or text files.

6. No Hidden API Costs / 100% Free Execution: The system must utilize completely free, high-limit models or engines (e.g., Edge-TTS or zero-cost high-limit routing endpoints). I will not pay monthly API/hosting subscriptions.

7. Robust Deployment Interface: I prefer a stable, responsive web interface that features custom speed control (1.0x to 1.5x), volume boost, password protection, and a visual progress tracker (Part 1/120 processing...).

8. Dedicated "Generate Audio" Button (Separate Trigger): The system must NOT start generating audio automatically when a file is uploaded. After the file is successfully uploaded and processed by the system, the Multi-Voice audio conversion pipeline must ONLY start executing when I explicitly click a separate, dedicated "Generate Audio" action button on the interface.

Strict Terms & Conditions (Zero Excuse & Non-Dispute Policy):
* Cancellation & No-Dispute Agreement: By bidding on this project, the freelancer explicitly agrees that this is an "All-or-Nothing" delivery. If the tool fails to process a 10 MB file, crashes, or fails at multi-voice detection, the project will be cancelled. The freelancer strictly agrees NOT to file any dispute or claim partial payments upon cancellation of an incomplete/broken product.
* 100% Code Handover & Ownership: Upon completion, the freelancer must hand over the complete, clean source code (.py files), requirements.txt, and a full deployment guide. I will have 100% full ownership of the data and code.
* No Server/Environment Excuses: The developer must ensure the tool runs flawlessly on the final hosted platform. I will NOT accept post-award excuses regarding free cloud hosting sleep modes, Termux compatibility issues, mobile OS limitations, or continuous script time-outs. Finding a stable, working environment is fully the developer's responsibility.
* Single Milestone Payment Policy: The project budget will be kept in a single milestone locked until final delivery. No partial or mid-project payments will be released. 
* Pre-Award Working Sample: Before I award you this project, you must provide a short 2-minute MP3 audio sample generated from a sample text snippet I provide, demonstrating both Pocket FM-style word replacements and automated dialogue transitions.

title: Modern Data Stack ELT Pipeline
description:
END-TO-END MODERN DATA STACK (MDS) DATA ENGINEERING PIPELINE

Technology Stack:
AWS RDS (MySQL) → Fivetran → Snowflake → Power BI

PROJECT OVERVIEW

Designed and implemented an end-to-end cloud data engineering pipeline to ingest, transform, model, and visualize e-commerce data using modern data stack technologies.

Built a production-style ELT pipeline where transactional data is stored in MySQL hosted on AWS RDS and automatically ingested into Snowflake using Fivetran with incremental CDC-based synchronization.

DATA ARCHITECTURE

AWS RDS MySQL
↓
Fivetran – Incremental CDC Ingestion
↓
Snowflake RAW Layer
↓
Streams + Tasks + SQL Transformations
↓
Snowflake STAGING Layer
↓
Star Schema / Dimensional Modeling
↓
Snowflake ANALYTICS Layer
↓
Power BI DirectQuery Dashboard

KEY IMPLEMENTATION

• Configured AWS RDS MySQL as the transactional source system.

• Implemented Fivetran MySQL CDC / Binary Log replication for automated incremental data ingestion.

• Designed a multi-layer Snowflake data warehouse architecture.

• Created RAW, STAGING, and ANALYTICS layers for structured data processing.

• Used Snowflake Streams to capture incremental data changes.

• Used Snowflake Tasks to automate scheduled data transformations.

• Implemented SQL-based data cleansing, validation, and business transformations.

• Designed a Star Schema with FACT_SALES, DIM_DATE, DIM_CUSTOMER, DIM_PRODUCT, and DIM_REGION.

• Configured AWS S3 integration for secure bulk data staging and data movement.

• Connected Snowflake to Power BI using DirectQuery.

• Created KPI calculations and business dashboards using DAX.

DATA LAYERS

RAW Layer:
Stores source data ingested through Fivetran with minimal modification.

STAGING Layer:
Performs data cleaning, validation, standardization, and transformation using SQL.

ANALYTICS Layer:
Contains the dimensional Star Schema optimized for reporting and business analytics.

BUSINESS OUTCOME

The pipeline automates the movement of transactional data from the source database to the analytics layer, reducing manual data processing and enabling near-real-time reporting through Power BI.

This project demonstrates practical experience with cloud data integration, CDC, ELT architecture, Snowflake data warehousing, dimensional modeling, workflow automation, and business intelligence reporting.

Developer: Ramkumar G

AWS RDS | MySQL | Fivetran | Snowflake | AWS S3 | SQL | Snowflake Streams | Snowflake Tasks | Power BI | DAX

Commodity

title: Automated Property Deal-Sourcing System Creation
description:
Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced developer/automation specialist to build an automated property deal-sourcing and analysis system for a property flipping business.


The strategy is:

Find property → analyse comparable sales → estimate resale value → calculate maximum purchase price → calculate expected profit → track auction/offer → purchase → renovate → sell.

The system needs to reduce the amount of manual time spent searching property websites and analysing individual properties.

The system should be designed so additional suburbs can easily be added later.

Current Buy Box
Maximum purchase price: $650,000
Minimum required project profit: $80,000
Maximum renovation budget: $50,000
Holding cost allowance: $10,000
Finance assumptions should be configurable
The system must calculate a maximum purchase price / maximum auction bid rather than simply comparing against the asking price.


The system should capture, where available:

Sale type
Date found
Suburb
Address
Listing URL
Agent
Advertised/asking price
Auction date
Deadline date
CV/RV
Last sale date
Last sale price
Floor area
Land area
Bedrooms
Bathrooms
Property type
Ownership type
Year built
Listing description
Source

Important: Do not scrape websites or bypass restrictions where this is prohibited. Where direct API access is not permitted, use legitimate email alerts, APIs, feeds or other approved methods.

2. Sale Type

Sale Type must be the first field in the main database.

Include:

Auction
Asking Price
Price by Negotiation
Deadline Sale
Tender
Enquiries Over
Offers Over
By Negotiation
Set Sale Date
Other

Auction properties need additional fields for:

Auction date
Auction time
Auction location
Auction status
Maximum auction bid
Final auction result
Final sale price
3. Comparable Sales Database

This is a critical part of the project.

For each potential property, the system should allow recent sales of other properties in the same suburb or nearby area to be recorded.

Comparable sales should include:

Address
Suburb
Sold date
Sold price
CV/RV
Floor area
Land area
Bedrooms
Bathrooms
Property type
Condition
Renovation status
Distance from target property
Source
Source URL

The system should help identify relevant comparable properties based on factors such as:

Same/substantially similar suburb
Distance
Bedrooms
Bathrooms
Floor area
Land area
Property type
Renovated condition

Renovated comparable sales should be distinguishable from original/dated properties.

The purpose is to estimate the after-renovation resale value (ARV) of the property being considered.

4. Exact Property 10-Year Sales History

This is separate from comparable sales.

Once I identify a property I am seriously considering, I want the system to record the exact property's own sales history for approximately the last 10 years, including:

Sale date
Sale price
CV/RV
Floor area
Land area
Bedrooms
Bathrooms
Source
Previous sale
Price change
Percentage change

This data must not be confused with the comparable-sales dataset.

5. Deal Calculator

The system must calculate:

Maximum Buy Price =

ARV
− renovation
− renovation contingency
− holding costs
− finance costs
− purchase/legal costs
− selling costs
− required profit
= Maximum Buy Price

The calculation must also respect the hard purchase ceiling of $650,000.

For auctions:

Maximum Auction Bid = Maximum Buy Price

The system should clearly display:

MAXIMUM BID

so I know the absolute amount I should not exceed.

6. Renovation Calculator

Create a renovation estimate with line items such as:

Kitchen
Bathroom
Painting
Flooring
Electrical
Plumbing
Roof
Windows
Landscaping
Exterior
Heating
Insulation
Other
Contingency

The system should calculate total renovation cost and flag anything above the $50,000 renovation limit.

7. Deal Screening

Each property should automatically be classified based on the configured rules, for example:

Potential
Review
Reject

The system should explain the reason rather than simply giving a numerical score.

Example:

POTENTIAL

Expected profit above $80k
Purchase price below maximum buy
Renovation within $50k
ARV supported by comparable sales

or:

REVIEW

ARV requires more comparable sales
Renovation estimate incomplete
Due diligence pending
8. Dashboard

Create a clean dashboard showing:

Total listings
New listings
Potential deals
Auctions
Upcoming auctions
Deadline sales
Properties requiring review
Average asking price
Potential deal count by suburb
Auction count by suburb
Potential profit
Maximum purchase prices

Allow filtering by:

Suburb
Sale type
Price
Auction date
Deal status
Renovation budget
Expected profit
9. Deal Pipeline

I want to track the property from discovery through to purchase:

New Listing → Review → Comparable Sales → Renovation Estimate → Due Diligence → Ready to Bid/Offer → Offer/Auction → Purchased → Renovation → Listed → Sold

Include fields for:

Initial offer
Counter offer
Final agreed price
Auction result
Deposit
Settlement date
Conditions
LIM
Building inspection
Title
Finance
Due diligence
Purchase status

title: Automated Invoice Processor and Sender
description:
Project Title

Automate Invoice Reading and WhatsApp Invoice Sending from PC Folder

Project Description

I need a one-time automation setup for sending invoices to customers through WhatsApp.

Currently, invoices are generated as PDF files and saved in a specific folder on my Windows PC.

I want the following process to be automated:

1. Monitor a specific folder on my PC for new invoice PDF files.
2. When a new PDF is added, read the first page of the invoice using OCR/Python.
3. Extract important information from the invoice, such as:
   - Customer Name
   - Mobile Number
   - Invoice Number
   - Invoice Date
   - Invoice Amount
   - Any other required information available on the first page
4. Prepare a predefined WhatsApp message using the extracted information.
5. Send the message to the customer's WhatsApp number.
6. Send the same invoice PDF as a WhatsApp document attachment.
7. After successful sending, the system should record/mark the invoice as processed so that the same invoice is not sent twice.
8. If OCR fails or any required information is missing, the system should show/log an error instead of sending an incorrect message.

Example WhatsApp Message

Hi [Customer Name],

Your invoice [Invoice Number] dated [Invoice Date] for ₹[Invoice Amount] has been generated.

Kindly make the payment and share the successful payment screenshot on this same WhatsApp number.

Thank you!

The actual message format can be finalized during development.

Important Requirements

- Windows PC
- Invoice PDFs are stored in one specific folder.
- OCR should work with the existing invoice format shown in the attached examples.
- The system should be reliable and easy to use.
- Ideally, after the initial setup, I should not need to manually run the process for every invoice.
- Duplicate sending must be prevented.
- I need a simple error/log system to know if any invoice was not sent successfully.

WhatsApp

The solution should use the official WhatsApp Business/Meta WhatsApp API or another reliable compliant method.

Please clearly mention:

- What WhatsApp API/method you will use.
- Whether Meta/WhatsApp approval is required.
- Whether message templates are required.
- Any Meta/WhatsApp charges that I will have to pay separately.

3. Any software/service subscription charges separately.

Deliverables

I need the complete working automation, source code, setup/configuration instructions and a short handover/training session.

The automation should be installed and tested on my Windows PC using my actual invoice format before final delivery.

title: Urban Heat GIS Analysis Automation
description:

2. A short README with run instructions and any package versions  
3. The six figures and the model comparison table reproduced for each city  

Everything has to be parameterised so I can add new cities later by changing a few variables. Let me know if you need sample data or prefer alternative libraries; I’m open as long as the outputs and file names stay consistent with the list above.

# Introduction to Artificial Intelligence

## 1. What is AI?

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a branch of computer science that focuses on creating systems capable of performing tasks that normally require human intelligence. It includes areas like machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing and robotics.

## 2. Applications of AI

• Healthcare – disease prediction, medical imaging
• Education – personalized learning, smart tutoring
• Transportation – self-driving cars, traffic control
• Banking – fraud detection, customer support
• Robotics – industrial automation, smart robots

## 3. Benefits of AI

• Automates repetitive tasks
• Analyzes large amounts of data
• Improves decision making
• Increases efficiency and productivity
• Helps in solving complex problems

## 4. Challenges of AI

• High development cost
• Data privacy and security issues
• Lack of human emotions
• Job displacement

## Conclusion

In conclusion, AI has the potential to bring positive changes in many fields, but it also comes with certain challenges that need to be carefully managed.

title: CloudNC CAM Assist Expert Needed + Autodesk Fusion 360
description:
Autodesk Fusion 360 + CloudNC CAM Assist Expert Needed — Complete Machine Shop Setup
We are a working CNC machine shop looking for an experienced Autodesk Fusion 360 Manufacturing / CloudNC CAM Assist expert to properly configure our CAM environment from the ground up.
This is not simply a part-programming project. We are looking for someone who understands how to build and organize a professional Fusion manufacturing environment so that CloudNC CAM Assist produces reliable, repeatable programs using our actual machines, tooling, holders, materials, and shop preferences.
Our Goal
We want to be able to import a customer model, select the correct machine/material/setup, run CAM Assist, and have the resulting program already be reasonably close to the way an experienced machinist in our shop would program the part.
We understand CAM Assist will still require human review. The goal is to eliminate unnecessary editing caused by an incomplete or poorly configured tool library and CAM environment.
Current Machines to Configure
Initial focus will be on our CNC milling equipment:
    • 2023 15000rpm 30hp Okuma Genos M560-V
    • 2000 7500rpm 20hp Haas VF-6
    • Haas EC-400 12000rpm 30hp horizontal machining center
Additional equipment may be added later.
Scope of Work
We want the freelancer to help us:
1. Audit our existing Fusion/CAM Assist environment
Review our current Fusion setup, tool libraries, machine configurations, holders, cutting data, CAM Assist configuration, posts, and current programming workflow.
Identify what is missing, duplicated, incorrectly configured, or preventing CAM Assist from performing properly.
2. Build a clean Master Tool Library
Create or clean up our Fusion tool library using the actual tooling we run in the shop.
Tools must be properly assembled with the correct holders.
Library should include, as applicable:
    • Indexable face mills
    • Indexable end mills
    • Solid carbide end mills
    • Roughing end mills
    • Ball end mills
    • Chamfer mills
    • Spot drills
    • Carbide drills
    • Indexable drills
    • Thread mills
    • Taps
    • (WE ARE OPEN TO MOST BRANDS BUT WANT IT STANDARDIZED)
Tool geometry must be correct, including actual cutting diameter versus overall insert/holder diameter where applicable.
We would like a clean and consistent tool-numbering and naming system that is easy for programmers and operators to understand.
3. Build Accurate Tool Holder Assemblies
Model/select the holders we actually use and properly assemble tools in Fusion.
We want accurate:
    • Holder geometry
    • Gauge length
    • Stick-out
    • Shank dimensions
    • Cutting dimensions
    • Collision representation
4. Configure Materials and Cutting Parameters
Set up practical baseline cutting data for materials we commonly machine, including:
    • 1018 / mild steel
    • 4140 pre-hard / heat-treated
    • 316 stainless
    • Aluminum
    • Tool steels
We want the setup to work properly with CloudNC Cutting Parameters while still reflecting real-world shop experience and machine capability.
The freelancer should understand SFM, chip load, radial engagement, axial engagement, horsepower limitations, rigidity, tool stick-out, and appropriate roughing versus finishing parameters.
5. Configure Each Machine
Make sure each machine is properly represented/configured so that CAM Assist understands which machine is being programmed.
Machine-specific limitations and capabilities should be considered.
Where practical, tooling should be standardized between machines while still allowing machine-specific restrictions.
6. Configure CloudNC CAM Assist
Review and configure CAM Assist so it is properly using:
    • Correct machines
    • Correct tool libraries
    • Correct tool assemblies
    • Correct materials
    • Correct cutting parameters
    • Appropriate machining strategies
    • 3-axis machining
    • 3+2 machining where applicable
    • Shop-preferred tools and processes
We are particularly interested in getting CAM Assist to consistently select sensible tools and strategies instead of requiring extensive cleanup after every generation.
7. Establish Shop Programming Standards
Help establish reasonable defaults/preferences for:
    • Adaptive roughing
    • Pocketing
    • Facing
    • Contouring
    • Holemaking
    • Finishing
    • Chamfering
    • Rest machining
    • Steep/shallow machining
    • 3+2 machining
    • Tool engagement
    • Maximum stepdowns
    • Maximum stepover
    • Finishing stock
    • Minimum tool stick-out
    • Tool-selection priority
The purpose is consistency—not blindly forcing every job into the same strategy.
8. Validate the System on Real Parts
We want the final setup tested against several real parts that we have previously programmed and machined successfully.
We will compare:
    • Tool selection
    • Machining strategy
    • Feeds and speeds
    • Cycle time
    • Number of operations
    • Tool changes
    • Program safety
    • Amount of manual editing required
Settings should be adjusted based on these tests.
9. Documentation / Handoff
At completion we want:
    • Organized Fusion tool libraries
    • Machine configurations
    • Material configuration
    • CAM Assist configuration
    • Explanation of the library structure
    • Naming/numbering convention
    • Short written procedure explaining how we should add future tools
    • Short written procedure explaining how we should add/change cutting data
    • Remote walkthrough/training session
We do not want a system that only the freelancer understands.
Remote Access

title: AI Character Content Creator – Consistent, Photorealistic Images & Short-Form Videos
description:
I’m looking for someone experienced with AI image and video generation to create ongoing content for an existing adult male AI character I have already developed.

The character is a young adult college student with a handsome, attractive, masculine appearance. His persona and content are meant to feel aspirational, lifestyle-oriented, slightly provocative, and social-media friendly. The most important requirement is maintaining the same exact character identity, face, body proportions, and general appearance across all content.

Just as importantly, the final content needs to be extremely realistic and high quality. I am not looking for the generic, overly polished, obviously AI-generated content that is everywhere online now. The images and videos should look as close as possible to content captured with a real iPhone, mirrorless camera, or by an actual social-media creator.

Content Needed

The majority of the content will consist of:

- Short-form vertical videos suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels, etc.
- Lifestyle and social-media-style images
- SFW content for public social platforms
- More provocative / suggestive content
- Adult-only / NSFW image content where appropriate

The character should appear natural, attractive, and believable rather than artificial or obviously AI-generated.

Examples of content could include everyday college/lifestyle situations, fitness, swimming or beach content, masculine activities, travel, casual social-media moments, attractive outfits, swimwear, shirtless content, and other scenarios that fit the character's persona.

Some content should be more polished, while other content should intentionally feel like casual content that someone might naturally post to TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, etc.

Photorealism & Quality

This is one of the most important parts of the project.

I am specifically trying to avoid the typical signs of low-quality AI content: waxy skin, overly perfect lighting, strange anatomy, plastic-looking faces, distorted hands, inconsistent facial features, unrealistic muscles, unnatural backgrounds, excessive sharpening, bad depth of field, or strange video movement.

The content should have the small imperfections and visual characteristics that make real photography and video believable.

That includes things such as:

- Natural skin texture, pores, facial hair, and imperfections
- Realistic hair and body hair
- Correct anatomy, hands, fingers, teeth, eyes, and body proportions
- Natural lighting and shadows
- Realistic fabric, water, reflections, environments, and backgrounds
- Proper camera depth and perspective
- Natural motion blur
- Realistic phone-camera or camera-lens behavior
- Subtle facial expressions rather than exaggerated AI expressions
- Consistent body shape and facial structure between generations
- Realistic movement and physics in video
- No obvious AI artifacts or visual inconsistencies

For casual social-media content, I actually prefer something that feels authentically photographed rather than artificially perfect. Slightly imperfect framing, realistic lighting, natural poses, believable environments, and normal phone-camera characteristics are often better than something that looks like a heavily retouched advertisement.

The goal should be that, at first glance, the average viewer would assume they are looking at a real person and real social-media content.

Character Consistency

This is extremely important.

I already have the character and reference material, so I am not looking to create a new character from scratch.

You must be able to consistently reproduce:

- The same face
- The same hairstyle
- The same approximate body type
- The same age appearance
- The same skin tone and physical characteristics
- The same overall aesthetic and personality

The character cannot look like a slightly different person every time a new image or video is generated.

Experience with LoRAs, character models, reference-image workflows, face consistency, ControlNet, IP-Adapter, ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion, Flux, or similar tools would be very valuable.

Content References

There is a huge amount of existing social-media content that can be used as creative and stylistic reference for poses, camera angles, settings, video concepts, outfits, trends, and compositions.

I am looking for someone who can efficiently study successful creator content and produce original variations and concepts inspired by those formats, rather than simply generating completely random content.

The goal is to build a repeatable system where we can continuously generate new content while keeping the character recognizable and consistent.

Volume

I expect to eventually need approximately 100 pieces of content per month, potentially combining both images and short videos.

Because the volume is relatively high, efficiency is extremely important.

However, volume cannot come at the expense of quality. I would rather develop an efficient generation and quality-control process than receive a large amount of low-quality AI content that is obviously generated.

Cost / Workflow

One of the biggest priorities for this project is keeping generation costs as low as reasonably possible.

I am particularly interested in freelancers who understand how to build efficient workflows using:

- Open-source AI models
- Stable Diffusion / Flux
- ComfyUI
- Local generation when practical
- LoRAs
- Character-consistency workflows
- Open-source video models
- Efficient image-to-video workflows
- Batch generation
- Automation
- Upscaling and detail restoration where necessary
- Quality-control and artifact-correction workflows

I do not want a workflow that depends heavily on expensive per-generation platforms if the same result can be produced using open-source or lower-cost tools.

Being technically good at AI generation and knowing how to achieve highly photorealistic results without spending unnecessary money on generation credits will be a major advantage.

The ideal person understands that low-cost production does not mean low-quality output. I am looking for someone technically skilled enough to use efficient tools while still producing premium, believable results.

Video Requirements

Videos will generally be short-form social media content.

They do not necessarily need to be complicated cinematic productions. In many cases, simple realistic movement, expressions, body movement, walking, lifestyle activities, swimming, working out, interacting with environments, etc. will be enough.

Video quality is particularly important because AI-generated motion is often much easier to detect than AI-generated images.

I will be paying close attention to:

- Facial consistency from frame to frame
- Stable body proportions
- Natural walking and body movement
- Correct hands and limbs
- Realistic clothing movement
- Realistic physics
- Natural facial expressions
- Correct eye direction and blinking
- Background consistency
- Lack of morphing or flickering
- Realistic camera movement
- Natural speed and timing

The key priorities are:

1. Character consistency
2. Photorealism
3. Realistic movement
4. Attractive / engaging content
5. Natural social-media aesthetic
6. Minimal AI artifacts
7. Efficient production cost

Long-Term Opportunity

This can become ongoing work.

I would like to start with an initial batch to evaluate:

- Character consistency
- Photorealism
- Image quality
- Video quality
- Ability to avoid obvious AI artifacts
- Speed
- Creativity
- Cost efficiency

If the first round works well, I am interested in establishing a long-term working relationship with regular monthly content production.

When Applying

Please include examples of AI characters, influencers, realistic AI people, AI video, or character-consistency work you have done.

I am particularly interested in seeing work that is genuinely photorealistic, rather than heavily stylized AI imagery.

It would also be helpful if you explain:

- What tools/models you currently use
- How you maintain the same character across many generations
- How you achieve realistic skin and facial detail
- How you prevent the "AI-generated" look
- What image-generation workflow you recommend
- What video-generation workflow you recommend
- Whether you work primarily with open-source or paid models
- How you handle quality control and artifact correction
- How you would keep generation costs low at approximately 100 pieces of content per month
- Your expected pricing for an initial test batch and for ongoing monthly production

I already have the character and reference images ready to provide once we begin.

title: QA Tester for Design and Cabinet Planning Software
description:
# QA Engineer / Product Tester Needed for Interior Design & Cabinet Software (2D + 3D + Rendering)

We are developing an **interior design and cabinet planning software** that allows users to create a measured room in **2D**, automatically/semantically work with the room in **3D**, place furniture/cabinets/models, create interior designs, generate renders for customer approval, calculate pricing/costs, and eventually generate **engineering/manufacturing outputs**.

We are looking for an experienced **QA Engineer / Software Tester** who can deeply test the application from both a **functional and real-world interior-design workflow perspective**.

This is not a simple website testing project. We need someone who can think like both a **QA engineer and an end user/designer**.

## What the software will cover

The product is expected to support workflows such as:

* Create and edit rooms in 2D
* Draw walls and define room dimensions
* Add doors, windows and openings
* Modify wall geometry
* Add cabinets and furniture
* Create cabinet runs
* Handle fillers, corners and spacing
* Convert/view the design in 3D
* Place 3D models and interior elements
* Apply materials, finishes and textures
* Design kitchens, wardrobes and other interiors
* Add lighting
* Generate realistic renders
* Prepare designs for customer approval
* Calculate project/cabinet/material costs
* Generate quotations/proposals
* Generate engineering/manufacturing information
* Export project information and drawings

The product is still under active development, so the QA engineer will also help us identify **missing workflows, edge cases and usability problems**.

## What we need you to test

### 1. 2D Room/CAD Functionality

Test things such as:

* Room creation
* Wall creation/editing
* Wall split/join
* Wall dimensions
* Snapping
* Grid behaviour
* Doors and windows
* Openings
* Wall intersections
* Irregular/complex rooms
* Undo/redo
* Copy/paste
* Object movement and resizing
* Units and measurements
* Precision issues
* Boundary conditions
* Very small/large rooms

We want to find cases where the geometry becomes invalid or the application behaves unexpectedly.

### 2. 2D → 3D Consistency

This is a critical part of the project.

For example:

**If a user changes a wall in 2D, does the 3D model correctly update?**

Test:

* Wall dimensions
* Room height
* Openings
* Door/window positions
* Cabinet positions
* Furniture positions
* Materials
* Ceiling/floor
* Design changes
* Object deletion
* Object duplication

We need to identify any mismatch between the 2D representation and the 3D representation.

### 3. Cabinet & Interior Design

Test realistic design workflows such as:

* Base cabinets
* Wall cabinets
* Tall units
* Corner cabinets
* Fillers
* Panels
* Countertops
* Wardrobes
* Shelving
* Furniture
* Appliances
* Multiple cabinet runs
* Different cabinet dimensions
* Cabinet collisions
* Invalid configurations
* Snapping/alignment

Please test both normal and intentionally incorrect configurations.

### 4. 3D Models

Test:

* Model placement
* Rotation
* Scaling
* Alignment
* Snapping
* Collision/intersection
* Materials
* Textures
* Model visibility
* Large numbers of models
* Performance with complex scenes

### 5. Rendering

Test the rendering workflow including:

* Camera positioning
* Lighting
* Materials
* Shadows
* Reflections
* Interior lighting
* Different room configurations
* Render quality
* Render failures
* Large/complex projects
* Rendering performance
* Exported render quality

### 6. Pricing / Cost Calculation

Pricing is a critical business workflow.

Test:

* Cabinet pricing
* Material pricing
* Hardware
* Panels
* Accessories
* Labour
* Installation
* Quantity calculations
* Discounts
* Taxes
* Different price configurations
* Changes to dimensions affecting price
* Changes to materials affecting price
* Changes to quantity affecting price

Most importantly, verify that:

**Design → Quantity → Cost → Quote**

remains consistent.

### 7. Engineering / Manufacturing Output

As the product evolves, test engineering outputs such as:

* Dimensions
* Cabinet/component quantities
* Cut dimensions
* Panels
* Hardware
* Material information
* Drawings
* BOM
* Manufacturing information
* Exported files

The QA engineer should specifically look for discrepancies between the **visual design and engineering data**.

### 8. End-to-End Workflow Testing

We want real-world scenarios tested from beginning to end.

Example:

**New Project → Measure Room → Create 2D Room → Add Doors/Windows → Add Cabinets → Generate 3D → Apply Materials → Add Lighting → Render → Customer Approval → Pricing → Engineering Output**

The QA engineer should verify that information remains consistent throughout the entire workflow.

## Types of Testing Required

We expect a combination of:

* Functional testing
* Regression testing
* Exploratory testing
* Integration testing
* End-to-end testing
* UI/UX testing
* Cross-browser testing
* Performance testing
* Edge-case testing
* Data consistency testing
* 2D/3D synchronization testing
* Calculation validation
* Export/import testing

Automation experience is a strong advantage.

## Bug Reporting

Every bug should contain:

* Clear title
* Severity
* Priority
* Steps to reproduce
* Expected result
* Actual result
* Screenshots/video where useful
* Browser/OS
* Project/design used to reproduce it

We prefer **high-quality reproducible bug reports**, not simply a list of observations.

## Ideal Candidate

You should have experience with:

* Web application QA
* Complex SaaS/product testing
* Manual testing
* Regression testing
* End-to-end testing
* Browser testing
* Bug tracking

Strongly preferred:

* CAD software testing
* Interior design software
* 2D/3D applications
* Architecture/design software
* Cabinet design software
* Manufacturing/engineering software
* 3D visualization/rendering applications

Experience with tools such as **Cabinet Vision, SketchUp, AutoCAD, Planner 5D, Floorplanner, Homestyler, 2020 Design, or similar software** would be a major advantage.

## Important

We are looking for someone who can **think beyond predefined test cases**.

For example, don't just test:

> Create a wall → add a cabinet → save.

title: AI School Management System and EdTech ERP
description:
ATBIX AI School Management App and EdTech ERP
Introduction
Education institutions are increasingly using digital technology to simplify school administration, improve communication, and manage academic operations. ATBIX is an AI-first School Management App and EdTech ERP software designed to bring important school management activities together on a connected digital platform.
The platform is designed for school owners, directors, principals, teachers, administrators, parents, and students who need a more organized approach to modern school management.
What Is ATBIX?
ATBIX is a School Management App and EdTech ERP that helps educational institutions manage different areas of their daily operations from a centralized platform.
The solution can support activities such as student information management, attendance, admissions, fees, examinations, timetables, communication, staff management, reporting, and academic administration.
By bringing these functions together, schools can reduce dependence on disconnected manual processes and create a more connected digital environment.
AI-Powered School Management
Artificial intelligence is becoming an important part of modern education technology. ATBIX focuses on combining AI, automation, cloud technology, and digital school management to support educational institutions.
AI-powered systems can help schools organize information, automate repetitive activities, generate useful reports, and provide data that can support administrative decision-making.
The goal is not simply to digitize existing processes but to create a smarter and more connected approach to school administration.
Key Features of an AI School Management System
Student Management
Schools can maintain and organize student information digitally, helping administrators access relevant records more efficiently.
Attendance Management
Digital attendance management can help schools record attendance, monitor patterns, and maintain organized student records.
Admission Management
A digital admission system can help schools organize enquiries, applications, student information, and admission-related processes.
Fee Management
Schools can manage fee-related information digitally and provide a more convenient experience for administrators and parents.
Examination Management
Academic examination information can be organized through a centralized system, helping schools manage examination-related activities and records.
Parent and Teacher Communication
Effective communication between schools, teachers, and parents is an important part of modern education. A connected school management platform can help improve communication and information sharing.
Reports and Data
Digital reports can help school management teams understand operational and academic information and use data when planning improvements.
Why Schools Are Moving Toward EdTech ERP Software
Traditional school administration often involves multiple systems, spreadsheets, documents, and communication channels. As schools grow, managing these processes separately can become increasingly difficult.
An integrated EdTech ERP can bring important functions into one digital environment. This can help institutions organize information, streamline workflows, improve communication, and support more efficient administration.
ATBIX is positioned around this approach by combining school management functionality with AI and technology-focused capabilities.
ATBIX for Modern Educational Institutions
Modern schools need technology that can adapt to changing educational requirements. School management is no longer limited to maintaining student records. Institutions also need digital communication, automation, reporting, academic management, and technology-supported decision-making.
ATBIX is designed to support this broader digital transformation by connecting different parts of school administration within one platform.
The Future of AI in School Management
AI and automation are creating new possibilities for education technology. Future school management platforms are likely to focus increasingly on intelligent automation, data-driven insights, personalized communication, and simplified administrative workflows.
For school leaders, adopting the right technology can be part of a broader digital transformation strategy.
Conclusion
ATBIX AI School Management App and EdTech ERP brings together school administration, education technology, AI, automation, and digital communication in a connected platform.
For educational institutions looking to modernize their operations, an integrated school management system can provide a structured foundation for managing students, teachers, parents, administration, academics, and institutional data.
ATBIX aims to support the transition from traditional school administration toward a more connected and technology-enabled education ecosystem.

title: Clay AI Development for Vendor Recruitment System
description:
Clay AI Automation & Lead Generation Specialist — Build Automated Vendor Recruitment System

Project Type: One-time setup + potential ongoing development
Platform: Freelancer.com
Experience Level: Expert
Preferred: Someone with proven experience building systems in Clay

About the Project

Our Financial Health (OFH) is building a nationwide network of qualified financial-service and professional-service providers who can serve clients in our financial wellness and Pathway to Homeownership programs.

We are looking for an experienced Clay developer / AI automation specialist to build an automated prospecting, verification, qualification, and outreach system.

The goal is to create a system that can continuously identify qualified professionals online, research and verify them, organize them into the appropriate category, and automatically initiate personalized email and SMS outreach.

What We Need the System to Do
1. Find Qualified Professionals

The system should be able to identify businesses and professionals such as:

Insurance agents and independent insurance brokers
Life insurance professionals
Financial-service professionals
Credit repair companies and credit specialists
Estate planning attorneys
Wills & trusts attorneys
Elder-law / estate-planning professionals
Mortgage professionals
Other financial and professional-service providers we may add later

The system should be able to search the web and relevant business/data sources to identify potential vendors.

2. Research & Verify Prospects

The AI should research each prospect and determine:

Business name
Contact person's name
Professional/company type
Website
Business location
Email address
Phone number
Services offered
Whether the business appears legitimate/active
Whether they fit OFH's vendor requirements
Other relevant information needed for qualification

We want the system to verify information before adding prospects to an outreach campaign whenever possible.

3. AI Qualification

We want AI to review the information it finds and categorize prospects.

For example:

Category: Insurance
Type: Life Insurance Agent
Website: Verified
Email: Verified
Phone: Verified
OFH Vendor Fit: Yes
Reason: Offers financial products/services relevant to OFH clients.

The qualification criteria should be adjustable so our team can change the requirements without rebuilding the entire system.

4. AI-Personalized Outreach

Once a prospect is verified and qualified, the system should be capable of generating personalized outreach based on information found about that particular business.

The system should support:

Personalized email
Follow-up emails
SMS outreach where legally permitted and appropriately consented/handled
Different messaging for different vendor categories
Different campaigns for insurance, credit repair, estate planning, etc.

The outreach should not look like generic mass spam.

5. Automated Follow-Up

We want an automated sequence such as:

Day 1: Initial email
Day 2–3: Follow-up
Day 5: Additional follow-up
Day 7+: Final follow-up / appropriate closeout

The exact sequence should be configurable.

SMS should also be configurable separately with appropriate opt-out and compliance controls.

6. Response Handling

We would like the system to identify responses and categorize them where possible:

Interested
Wants more information
Wants to schedule a meeting
Not interested
Wrong person
Unqualified
Do not contact
No response

Interested prospects should be moved into the appropriate CRM/workflow for our OFH team.

7. Appointment Booking

Ideally, interested prospects should receive a link to schedule a Zoom meeting with our team.

We currently use tools such as Calendly and are open to recommendations for better integrations.

8. CRM / Data Management

The system should maintain a clean database of prospects and prevent duplicate outreach.

We need to be able to see:

Prospect
Category
Contact information
Verification status
Qualification status
Outreach status
Last contact
Response
Appointment status
Notes
Source of the prospect

We are open to using Clay's native capabilities and/or integrating Clay with another CRM or database.

Ideal Technical Experience

You should have demonstrated experience with:

Clay
Clay Tables
Claygent / Clay AI research
Web research and lead generation
Data enrichment
Email verification
Lead qualification
AI personalization
API integrations
Zapier or Make
CRM integrations
Email sequencing platforms
SMS platforms
Calendly or similar scheduling platforms
Webhooks
Google Maps/business data
Domain/email verification
Automation workflows

Experience with Smartlead, Instantly, Twilio, Telnyx, HubSpot, Zoho, GoHighLevel, or similar platforms is a plus.

Important: We Are NOT Looking for a Basic Lead Scraper

We do not simply want someone to scrape thousands of names and emails.

We want an intelligent vendor recruitment system that can:

Find → Research → Verify → Qualify → Personalize → Contact → Follow Up → Categorize Responses → Book Appointments

The system needs to be designed for scalability.

Initial Goal

We would like to build the system so our team can eventually enter something like:

"Find 500 qualified independent life insurance professionals in New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania."

The system should then perform as much of the process as possible automatically:

Prospecting → Enrichment → Verification → Qualification → Campaign Assignment → Personalized Outreach → Follow-Up → CRM

We should also be able to change the search criteria and vendor category without requiring a developer to rebuild the system.

Deliverables

The selected freelancer will be expected to:

Design the overall automation architecture.
Set up our Clay environment.
Build the prospecting workflows.
Build AI research/qualification workflows.
Set up data enrichment and verification.
Create vendor-category qualification criteria.
Create personalized email generation.
Integrate email outreach.
Integrate SMS where appropriate.
Build automated follow-up sequences.
Connect the system to our CRM/workflow.
Create duplicate prevention.
Create response categorization.
Connect appointment scheduling.
Create documentation explaining how the system works.
Train our team on how to operate and modify the system.
Provide recommendations for scaling the system.
Security & Compliance

The system must be designed responsibly and should include appropriate:

Email verification
Opt-out handling
Do-not-contact/suppression lists
Duplicate prevention
Rate limits
Sender reputation protection
Data-quality controls
Applicable email/SMS compliance considerations

We do not want an uncontrolled system that simply sends thousands of unsolicited messages.

What We Want From Applicants

Please do NOT send a generic proposal.

In your proposal, answer these questions:

How many Clay automation projects have you completed?
Please provide examples of Clay systems you have built.
Have you built automated prospecting systems using Clay?
Have you integrated Clay with email sequencing platforms?
Have you integrated SMS into an automated lead-generation system?
What tools would you recommend for email verification?
What tools would you recommend for SMS?
How would you prevent duplicate prospects?
How would you have AI determine whether an insurance agent or professional is actually qualified for our program?
What CRM/database would you recommend for this project?
How would you structure the system so we can add new vendor categories later?
What would you estimate the initial development cost to be?
What would you estimate the monthly software/API costs to be?
How long would you expect the initial build to take?
Preferred Candidate

We are looking for someone who can think beyond individual automations and build a complete scalable AI prospecting and vendor-recruitment infrastructure.

If you have experience building Clay-based systems that find, research, enrich, qualify, personalize, and automatically contact prospects, please apply.

Potential for ongoing work after the initial system is successfully completed.

title: AI-Powered Verification Copilot Development
description:
We want to develop an *AI-powered Verification Copilot for GSCS INTERNATIONAL* to assist qualified verifiers throughout the complete SLCP/FSLM verification process on Worldly.

### Core Concept

This is *not a general chatbot and not an autonomous verifier*.

> *AI prepares. AI checks. AI alerts. Verifier decides.*

### How It Will Work

The verifier selects the *country and verification/assessment period. The Copilot then supports and checks the **entire verification across all applicable FSLM questions*, not only a fixed number of questions.

For each question and across the verification as a whole, the AI will:

* Suggest appropriate responses based on GSCS methodology and available evidence
* Apply applicable country laws and regulations
* Check mandatory and unanswered questions
* Identify potential flags
* Check evidence against responses
* Identify contradictions and inconsistencies between questions
* Cross-check worker, management and document information
* Identify potential legal conflicts
* Highlight areas requiring verifier attention
* Draft verification comments where required
* Perform a complete final verification-readiness check

### GSCS Knowledge Base

GSCS will provide question-by-question:

* Accurate/inaccurate examples
* Other response options
* Verification guidance
* Evidence expectations
* Flagging logic
* Explanations
* Approved QA/historical examples

This will form the *GSCS Verification Knowledge Base*.

### Country Legal Intelligence

The Copilot must be *country-specific and version-controlled*.

For example, selecting *Bangladesh* will load the applicable Bangladesh requirements covering labour, wages, working hours, leave, employment, OHS and other relevant legislation.

The legal database should contain:

* Law/regulation
* Section/article
* Requirement
* Effective date/version
* Source
* Related FSLM questions

The AI must not invent laws or legal references.

### Full Verification Review

The most important requirement is that the Copilot must understand the *verification as one complete system*, rather than treating each question independently.

It should identify relationships and inconsistencies across the entire verification, such as:

*Question Evidence Interview Other Questions Country Law Flags Final Verification*

### Human Control

The verifier can *accept, edit, reject or override* every AI recommendation.

The AI must never:

* Make the final verification decision
* Automatically approve/reject a facility
* Automatically finalize a flag
* Invent evidence or laws
* Override the verifier
* Automatically submit the verification

### Initial Prototype

The first prototype should demonstrate a complete end-to-end verification workflow:

*Country Selection → Full FSLM Verification → GSCS Knowledge → Country Legal Overlay → AI Assistance → Continuous Cross-Checking → Flag Alerts → Verifier Review/Edit → Final AI Quality Check*

The architecture should be designed from the beginning to support *multiple countries and future changes to FSLM requirements*.

### Final Vision

The Copilot should feel like an *experienced senior SLCP/FSLM verification expert sitting beside the verifier*, continuously reviewing the entire verification, identifying gaps, inconsistencies, legal issues and potential flags.

The AI assists throughout.

*The verifier remains fully responsible for the final decision.*

I’m building a multi-tenant SaaS platform that blends classic business management tools with practical, AI-driven intelligence. The first release will centre on two pillars—Customer Relationship Management and Project Management—so companies can track leads, nurture clients, assign work, and follow progress inside a single workspace.

AI should be woven in from day one. I need automated data analysis that surfaces trends and performance insights without manual digging, plus an embedded chatbot or virtual assistant that can answer user questions, guide them through workflows, and even trigger common actions. title: Develop Scalable E-Commerce Marketplace App
description:
E-Commerce Marketplace App Development – Meesho-Like Platform

Project Overview

We are looking for an experienced mobile app and e-commerce development team/freelancer to build a marketplace platform similar in concept to Meesho.

The platform will allow sellers/vendors to list and sell products, while customers can browse products, place orders, make payments, and track deliveries.

We are looking for someone who can develop the complete solution including Customer App, Seller Panel/App, Admin Panel and Backend/API.

1. Customer App

The customer should be able to:

- Register/Login using mobile number and OTP
- Browse products by category
- Search and filter products
- View product images, videos, description, price and variants
- Add products to cart
- Add/manage multiple addresses
- Place orders
- Choose Cash on Delivery / Online Payment
- Apply coupons/discounts
- View order history
- Track order status
- Cancel orders according to defined rules
- Request returns/refunds
- Receive push notifications
- Rate and review products
- Share products through WhatsApp/social media
- Create/share product links
- Manage profile and account

2. Seller/Vendor Panel

Sellers should be able to:

- Register and submit KYC/business details
- Login securely
- Add/edit/delete products
- Upload product images/videos
- Manage product categories and variants
- Set selling price, MRP and inventory
- Manage stock
- Receive and manage orders
- Accept/process orders
- Update order status
- View cancellations and returns
- View sales reports
- View earnings/payouts
- Manage bank/payment details
- View customer/order information required for fulfilment
- Receive notifications

3. Admin Panel

A comprehensive web-based admin dashboard is required.

Admin should be able to:

- Manage customers
- Manage sellers/vendors
- Approve/reject seller registrations
- Manage KYC
- Approve/manage products
- Manage categories/subcategories
- Manage banners and promotions
- Manage coupons
- Manage orders
- Manage cancellations and returns
- Manage refunds
- Manage commissions
- Manage seller payouts
- Manage COD orders
- View sales/revenue reports
- Manage users and permissions
- Send push notifications
- Manage customer complaints/support tickets
- View overall business analytics
- Block/suspend sellers or customers when required

4. Payment Integration

The application should support:

- UPI
- Debit/Credit Cards
- Net Banking
- Wallets where applicable
- Cash on Delivery

Payment gateway should be integrated securely using a reputed Indian payment provider such as Razorpay, Cashfree, PhonePe PG, etc.

5. Logistics & Order Management

The system should be designed so that logistics partners can be integrated later.

Required order statuses may include:

Order Placed → Confirmed → Packed → Shipped → Out for Delivery → Delivered

Also support:

- Cancellation
- Return
- Replacement
- Refund
- Failed delivery

The architecture should allow future integration with third-party logistics APIs.

6. Notifications

Integration required for:

- Push notifications
- SMS/OTP
- Email where required
- Order status notifications
- Promotional notifications

Firebase Cloud Messaging can be used for push notifications.

7. Technology Requirements

The freelancer can suggest the technology stack, but it should be:

- Scalable
- Secure
- Fast
- Easy to maintain
- Suitable for future expansion

We are open to technologies such as:

Mobile: Flutter / React Native / Native Android & iOS

Backend: Node.js / Laravel / Django / equivalent

Database: MySQL / PostgreSQL / MongoDB

Admin: React / Next.js / equivalent

The freelancer should clearly explain the proposed technology stack before development.

8. MVP First

We want to start with an MVP (Minimum Viable Product) rather than building every advanced feature from day one.

The freelancer should provide:

1. MVP feature list
2. Development timeline
3. Fixed project cost
4. Technology stack
5. Hosting/server requirements
6. Third-party API costs
7. Post-launch maintenance cost

Advanced features can be developed in Phase 2.

9. Deliverables

The selected freelancer/team must provide:

- Android application
- iOS application (if included in agreed scope)
- Seller panel/app
- Admin web panel
- Backend/API
- Database
- Complete source code
- UI/UX design files
- API documentation
- Database documentation
- Deployment assistance
- Production build
- App Store/Google Play publishing assistance

10. Ownership & Intellectual Property

Very important:

All source code, UI designs, database structure, APIs, documentation and other project-related intellectual property developed specifically for this project will belong to the client after agreed payment.

The freelancer must not lock the project to their own server, account or proprietary system.

All important accounts should be created in the client's/company's name, including:

- Google Play Console
- Apple Developer Account
- Firebase
- Payment Gateway
- Domain
- Hosting/Cloud
- SMS/WhatsApp API accounts

11. Security Requirements

The application must include:

- Secure authentication
- OTP verification
- Role-based access
- Secure API authentication
- Payment security
- Password/data encryption where applicable
- Protection against common web/API vulnerabilities
- Secure admin access
- Regular database backup capability

12. Development Process

Development should be divided into milestones:

Milestone 1 – Requirement & UI/UX

Finalise requirements, user flow and UI/UX.

Milestone 2 – Backend & Database

Develop APIs, database and authentication.

Milestone 3 – Customer App

Develop customer-facing application.

Milestone 4 – Seller Panel

Develop seller functionality.

Milestone 5 – Admin Panel

Develop complete admin dashboard.

Milestone 6 – Integrations

Payment, OTP, notifications and logistics integrations.

Milestone 7 – Testing

Complete functional, security and performance testing.

Milestone 8 – Deployment

Production deployment and app store submission.

13. Freelancer Requirements

Please apply only if you have experience developing:

- E-commerce applications
- Marketplace platforms
- Multi-vendor applications
- Payment gateway integration
- Seller/vendor dashboards
- Admin dashboards
- Scalable backend systems

Please share:

1. Your previous e-commerce/marketplace projects
2. Portfolio/demo links
3. Proposed technology stack
4. Estimated development timeline
5. Fixed project quotation
6. Team size
7. Post-launch support terms
8. Any recurring/third-party costs
9. Examples of similar applications you have developed

Important

We are not looking for a simple shopping app. This is intended to become a scalable multi-vendor marketplace, so the backend architecture and database should be designed with future growth in mind.

Please quote separately for:

A. MVP Development

B. Advanced Features / Phase 2

C. Annual Maintenance & Support

Budget and final scope will be discussed after reviewing proposals and technical approaches.

title: Tiffin Ordering & Payment Platform
description:
I run a daily-meal (tiffin) service and today every order arrives by phone or WhatsApp, then gets typed into an Excel sheet where a VBA macro creates end-of-month invoices. As the volume grows, calls are missed, a few meals go unrecorded, and irregular customers sometimes slip past our payment checklist. I’m ready to replace this patchwork with a single, automated system that works everywhere my customers are.

Here’s what I need built:

• A customer-facing experience that works both as a lightweight web link and as an installable mobile app. From either interface a customer should be able to see the daily or weekly menu, select quantity or subscription type, and place the order in a couple of taps.

• Invoice generation that mirrors (or improves on) my current VBA output. Ideally invoices are created on the fly and also collated into a monthly PDF batch I can mail or download.  
• An admin panel where I can glance at today’s orders, outstanding payments, stock alerts and simple sales analytics. The panel should also let me adjust prices, pause items, or apply discounts without needing a developer.  
• A migration path for my existing Excel data so that long-time customers keep their history and any unpaid balances remain visible.  
• Reminder logic that nudges irregular customers for payment or lets me trigger a single-click WhatsApp follow-up.  

I’m happy for you to choose the stack—Flutter, React, Kotlin, Firebase, MySQL, anything stable and secure—as long as the final product is smooth, fast and easy for a non-technical owner to run. Once delivered I’ll need basic documentation and a quick hand-over call so I can handle routine tasks myself.

title: Online Architect Hiring: Market Research
description:
Market research via chat: homeowners who hired an architect/designer online (by any Freelance Platform)

GOAL
Collect short written answers from homeowners about their experience hiring an architect or residential designer for a home project. This is exploratory customer research, not a sales activity. No product may be pitched to respondents.

WHO TO REACH (strict screening)
- Owner of a residential project (new build, renovation, or extension)
- Hired an architect or designer ONLINE/remotely within the last 24 months
- Located anywhere except Southeast Asia
- Target: 20 qualified respondents (20 total). Record each respondent's country.
- Not acceptable: friends, family, or people you know personally; the same person counted twice.

HOW IT WORKS (written chat, no calls)
Contact respondents through chat (WhatsApp, Instagram DM, email, forums/communities, etc.). Do not mass-message or spam. At the start, tell them their answers are for business research, will be anonymized, and that the conversation will be screen-recorded and shared with me. Proceed only with their consent.

1. First collect: country, project type (new build/renovation/extension), approximate date, and what type of professional they hired.
2. Then ask ONLY these 3 open-ended questions, in order:
   Q1. Tell me about the last time you hired an architect or designer for a home project. What options did you consider, and why did you choose the one you did?
   Q2. During that project, how did you keep track of what was happening and why design decisions were made? Tell me about a moment you felt unsure, worried, or out of the loop.
   Q3. What did you do about that? And if you could change one thing about how the process worked, what would it be?
3. If an answer is very short or generic, send ONE neutral follow-up only (e.g., "Can you tell me more about that moment?"). Do not suggest answers, do not mention time zones or any specific problem, and do not pitch anything.
4. Answers must be the respondent's own words. No AI-generated answers, no answers written by you.

DELIVERABLES (required for every respondent)
A. SCREEN RECORDING of the full conversation:
   - One continuous, unedited recording per respondent (no cuts, no blurring, no pausing)
   - Starts at the top of the conversation (your first message) and scrolls through every message to the end
   - The date/time of messages and the app/platform interface must be visible
   - Briefly show the respondent's profile page or contact at the start
   - Share via cloud link (Google Drive/Dropbox) with viewing access
B. SPREADSHEET, one row per respondent: respondent ID, country, project type, approximate project date, professional hired, date of conversation, and typed answers to Q1, Q2, Q3 exactly matching the recording.
C. Verification: I may contact up to 3 randomly chosen respondents (with their permission) to confirm they really took part.

PRIVACY
I will keep respondent identities confidential and anonymize them in any report. Do not collect any sensitive data beyond what is listed above.

QUALITY & PAYMENT
- Payment only for respondents that pass my quality check. Duplicates fabricated or edited evidence, leading questions, AI-written answers, or mismatches between recording and spreadsheet will be rejected and unpaid.
- No summaries or interpretations until the raw recordings and spreadsheet are delivered.

IN YOUR PROPOSAL, PLEASE TELL ME
1. Your experience with customer interviews or surveys
2. Exactly how and where you will find qualified respondents

title: B2B Ground Reality Market Research in Kenya
description:
Task-Based | Ground Reality Market Research | B2B Sales & Marketing | Potential Long-Term Opportunity

About Us

We are ZAM ZAM ENTERPRISES, an India-based apparel manufacturer and exporter, and the manufacturer of 5BROS brand.

We manufacture T-shirts, polos, oversized T-shirts, hoodies, sportswear garments for wholesale, private-label, OEM and institutional customers.

We are currently exploring expansion into East African markets, particularly Kenya, Uganda and Ethiopia.

Before making significant steps in these markets, we want to understand the real market situation on the ground.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for local sales/market research agents who are physically based in Kenya, can conduct genuine field-level research.

This is NOT a desk-research-only project.

You should be able to visit local markets, wholesalers, distributors and potential business customers and collect information directly from the market.

Initial Task – Ground Reality Market Research

The selected agent will be assigned a specific city/market and a defined research task.

Your responsibilities may include:

1. Market Mapping

Identify major T-shirt and apparel wholesale markets
Identify important retail markets
Identify wholesalers, distributors and importers
Identify promotional apparel suppliers
Identify uniform suppliers
Identify institutional apparel buyers

2. Product Research

Identify fast-moving T-shirt styles
Round-neck T-shirts
Polo T-shirts
Oversized T-shirts
Sportswear
Hoodies
Plain/basic T-shirts
School/company/uniform T-shirts

3. Standard Size and Price Research
Collect actual Size Chart and market selling prices for relevant products.

Where possible, RECORD:

Product type
Fabric composition
Approximate GSM
Quality level
Wholesale price
Retail price
Country of origin
Popular brands
Minimum order quantities

4. Buyer Research

Identify genuine potential B2B buyers such as:

Garment wholesalers
Clothing distributors
Retail chains
Apparel shops
Uniform suppliers
Schools and institutions
Corporate uniform suppliers
NGOs
Sportswear dealers

5. Ground Verification
We want real information, not copied internet data.

The agent may be required to:
Visit markets physically
Speak with sellers/buyers
Take permitted photographs of market/product displays
Collect business cards/contact details
Record WhatsApp/phone/email information
Ask basic questions about sourcing and demand
Verify whether a business is genuinely active

6. Competitor Research

Identify:
Local brands
Imported brands
Chinese suppliers
Turkish suppliers
Indian suppliers
Other major sources

Understand what products they sell and their approximate price positioning.

Required Deliverables

At the end of the task, you must provide:
Market Research Report
List of verified potential buyers
Product and price comparison
Competitor information
Photos/evidence from field visits where permitted
Contact details of relevant businesses
Key market observations
Recommendations for our 5BROS brand
Potential opportunities and challenges
Suggested next steps for entering the market

The information should be submitted in Google Sheets/Excel + a concise written report.

Important: This Is a Ground-Level Assignment

We are specifically interested in freelancers who can provide first-hand local market information.

Please do not apply if you intend to complete the entire assignment through Google, social media or online directories without visiting the market.

We want someone who can actually go PHYSICALLY into the market and tell us:

What is selling? Who is buying? At what price? From whom? What quality do they expect? And where is the opportunity for an Indian manufacturer like us?

Preferred Candidate

You should:

Be physically located in Kenya.
Have good knowledge of your local apparel market
Have experience in sales, business development or market research
Be comfortable visiting markets and businesses
Have good communication skills
Be able to communicate in English
Have a smartphone for calls, WhatsApp and photographs
Be comfortable using Google Sheets/Excel
Be honest and accurate with collected information
Be able to work independently

Previous experience in apparel, textiles, uniforms, wholesale, distribution or FMCG sales is a strong advantage.

Compensation

This is a task-based paid project.

The initial assignment will have a clearly defined scope and milestone.

We are open to discussing the budget based on:

Number of markets covered
Number of verified businesses identified
Number of field visits
Quality of research
Depth of information collected

Strong performers may be offered additional paid assignments and a longer-term Sales & Business Development role.

The long-term opportunity may involve:

Buyer development
Lead generation
Distributor identification
Customer meetings
Sample coordination
Sales follow-up
Order generation
Local market representation

How to Apply

Please answer the following questions in your proposal:

1. Which country and city are you currently based in?
2. Are you physically available to visit wholesale/retail markets?
3. Have you previously worked in apparel, textiles, fashion, uniforms or B2B sales? Explain briefly.
4. Which major apparel/garment markets can you access?
5. How many potential wholesalers/distributors/retailers can you realistically identify and verify during the assignment?
6. Have you previously conducted field market research? Please provide an example.
7. Are you interested in continuing as a sales agent after the research phase?

Please Start Your Proposal With:
“I am physically based in [COUNTRY/CITY] and I can conduct ground-level market research.”

Applications that do not clearly mention your current country and city may not be considered.

Potential Long-Term Opportunity

This first assignment is intended to evaluate the freelancer's local knowledge, field capability, and quality of research and business development skills.

If the research is successful, we would like to build a longer-term relationship with selected agents in Kenya, Uganda and Ethiopia for the expansion of our apparel business.

We are looking for local market knowledge — not just online research.

**Serious inquiries only.**

# Freelancer para generación de leads y agendamiento de demos – Sistema Contact Center

## Descripción del proyecto

Estamos buscando un freelancer con experiencia en **ventas B2B, generación de leads y prospección comercial** para ayudarnos a conseguir potenciales clientes para un **sistema de Contact Center** dirigido a empresas que manejan atención al cliente, ventas, soporte telefónico o equipos de agentes.

El objetivo principal del proyecto es **identificar empresas potencialmente interesadas, contactar a los responsables de la toma de decisiones y conseguir reuniones/demos comerciales** para presentar nuestra solución.

No buscamos únicamente una base de datos de empresas. Buscamos una persona que pueda realizar activamente la prospección y generar oportunidades comerciales reales.

## Responsabilidades

* Investigar y construir bases de datos de empresas potencialmente interesadas.
* Identificar responsables de áreas como:

  * Servicio al cliente
  * Contact Center / Call Center
  * Tecnología / IT
  * Operaciones
  * Ventas
  * Gerencia
* Conseguir datos de contacto profesionales.
* Realizar contacto mediante los canales disponibles:

  * Email
  * LinkedIn
  * WhatsApp Business
  * Llamadas telefónicas
  * Otros canales de prospección B2B
* Presentar brevemente la solución siguiendo un guion comercial.
* Identificar necesidades y nivel de interés.
* Calificar los prospectos.
* Gestionar seguimiento.
* Agendar demostraciones con nuestro equipo comercial/técnico.
* Registrar la actividad y resultados de cada prospecto.

## Perfil de cliente objetivo

Buscamos principalmente empresas que puedan tener necesidades relacionadas con:

* Atención telefónica a clientes.
* Servicio al cliente.
* Ventas telefónicas.
* Call Centers.
* Contact Centers.
* Soporte técnico.
* Cobranza.
* Telemercadeo.
* Inmobiliarias
* Equipos comerciales que realizan llamadas.
* Empresas que actualmente utilizan soluciones de Contact Center y puedan estar buscando una alternativa.

Se valorará especialmente experiencia vendiendo soluciones SaaS, software empresarial, telecomunicaciones, tecnología, CRM, Contact Center o servicios B2B.

## Objetivo del proyecto

El KPI principal será la generación de **oportunidades comerciales calificadas y demos agendadas**.

Buscamos medir el trabajo mediante métricas como:

* Número de prospectos identificados.
* Número de contactos realizados.
* Prospectos que responden.
* Prospectos calificados.
* Demos/reuniones agendadas.
* Demos efectivamente realizadas.
* Oportunidades comerciales generadas.

La calidad de los leads será más importante que simplemente entregar una gran cantidad de contactos.

## Qué proporcionamos

Proporcionaremos:

* Información sobre el producto.
* Material comercial disponible.
* Características y beneficios de la solución.
* Guion o argumentos comerciales iniciales.
* Acceso a la información necesaria para realizar las demostraciones.
* Definición del perfil de cliente objetivo.
* Acompañamiento durante el proceso inicial.

## Experiencia requerida

Buscamos personas con experiencia demostrable en:

* Lead Generation.
* Cold Calling.
* Telemarketing.
* Ventas B2B.
* LinkedIn Prospecting.
* Email Outreach.
* Appointment Setting.
* Venta de software o servicios tecnológicos.

Se valorará experiencia en mercados de **Colombia y Latinoamérica**.

## Para aplicar

Por favor incluir:

1. Experiencia realizando prospección B2B.
2. Tipo de productos o servicios que han vendido anteriormente.
3. Experiencia en software, SaaS, Contact Center o tecnología.
4. Países/mercados donde han realizado ventas.

**Importante:** En la propuesta indicar claramente si tienen experiencia realizando contacto en frío y agendando reuniones con empresas.

Inicialmente buscamos comenzar con un proyecto piloto y, dependiendo de los resultados, continuar con una relación comercial de largo plazo.
