title: Bureau De Change Platform
description:
need a complete, professional bureau-de-change and money-transfer platform consisting of a responsive website plus iOS and Android apps.

The goal is one unified fintech experience where customers can view live FX rates, calculate exchanges, buy/sell or send money, complete KYC, make payments, receive notifications, and track transactions in real time.

The platform must be suitable for a Canadian/Québec regulated money-services business, with strong KYC/AML, transaction monitoring, audit trails, security and reporting. It must also be designed for future physical bureau-de-change locations, cash transactions and multiple branches.

1. Website & Mobile Apps
Responsive web application
iOS app ready for App Store submission
Android app ready for Google Play
Shared secure backend/API
Fast, modern fintech UX
French primary language, English support, Arabic-ready architecture
Mobile-first design
SEO-friendly public pages
Secure customer portal
Real-time FX calculator
Apps should feel native, not simply wrapped websites
2. Customer Accounts

Customers must be able to:

Register/login securely
Reset passwords and use MFA/2FA
Manage personal information
Complete KYC
Upload ID documents
Complete selfie/liveness verification where supported
View KYC status
Add/manage beneficiaries
View transaction history
Download receipts
Track transactions
Receive email/SMS/push notifications
Contact support

Clearly distinguish customer, beneficiary, payer and recipient and include controls against unauthorized third-party transactions.

3. Exchange & Transfer Flow

Customer flow:

Select service
Select currencies
Enter amount
Display live FX rate
Display fees
Display amount received
Confirm transaction
Complete KYC/compliance requirements
Select payment method
Submit payment
Confirm payment
Compliance/operations review when required
Approve/reject
Process transaction
Notify customer
Complete transaction

Show rate, fees, amount sent, amount received, reference number and status clearly.

4. FX Rate Engine

Create one centralized rate engine used by web, iOS, Android, calculator and transactions.

Admin must be able to:

Set buy/sell rates
Configure spreads/margins and fees
Enable/disable currencies
Schedule rate changes
Override rates
Set minimum/maximum amounts
Configure online/branch rates
Configure volume or customer-specific pricing

Architecture must support future FX market-rate, liquidity and pricing-provider integrations.

5. Calculator

Professional live calculator with:

Currency selection
Amount input
Live buy/sell rate
Fees and FX margin
Final amount received
Configurable pricing tiers
Copy/share results
Email/WhatsApp sharing

Calculator and actual transactions must use the same pricing engine.

6. Payments

Support secure integration with:

Interac/payment providers
Payment gateways
EFT/bank payment providers
Future card payments
Future in-person payments

Use APIs/webhooks for payment status and reconciliation. Do not unnecessarily store sensitive payment credentials.

7. KYC / AML / Compliance

Support:

Identity and ID-document verification
Selfie/liveness verification
Beneficiary information
Source-of-funds
Purpose of transaction
Risk flags
Transaction and velocity limits
High-value transaction review
Additional document requests
Compliance holds
Manual approval/rejection
Compliance notes
Complete audit trail

Compliance rules must be configurable and updateable without rebuilding the platform.

8. Transaction Management

Every transaction requires a unique reference and complete history.

Statuses should include:
Draft, KYC Required, Awaiting Payment, Payment Received, Under Review, Compliance Hold, Approved, Processing, Completed, Rejected, Cancelled and Refunded.

Every status change must be timestamped and linked to the responsible user or automated process. Confidential compliance information must remain internal.

9. Admin Dashboard

Administrators must operate the platform without touching code.

Customers: search, profiles, KYC status, documents, transactions, account status, notes.

Transactions: search/filter, review, approve/reject, hold, request documents, refund, timeline, export.

Rates: rates, spreads, fees, currencies, limits and scheduled changes.

Compliance: KYC queue, AML/risk alerts, high-value reviews, source-of-funds reviews, beneficiary reviews, notes and audit logs.

Reports: transaction volume/count, fees, revenue, FX spread revenue, currency volumes, customer activity, pending/completed/rejected transactions, refunds and CSV/Excel export.

10. Future Physical Bureau de Change

The architecture must support future physical locations with:

Cash buy/sell
Cashier accounts
Branch accounts
Till management
Vault management
Currency inventory
Cash reconciliation
End-of-day closing
Cash deposits
Printed receipts
In-person KYC
Branch-specific rates/limits
Branch reporting
Multiple branches

Online and physical transactions should use the same customer, transaction, compliance and reporting infrastructure while remaining identifiable by channel.

11. Security

Use current security best practices:

MFA/2FA
Role-based access control
Encryption in transit/at rest
Secure document storage
API authentication
Secure sessions
Rate limiting
Input validation
OWASP protections
Secure secrets/environment management
Audit logs
Backups/recovery
Monitoring/error tracking

Changes to rates, fees, transactions, refunds, customer accounts, compliance decisions and permissions must be auditable.

12. User Roles

At minimum:

Super Admin
Compliance Officer
Operations/Admin
Customer Support
Branch Manager
Cashier
Customer

Permissions must be granular.

13. Notifications

Support email, SMS, push and optionally WhatsApp for registration, KYC status, document requests, transaction creation, payment received, review/hold, approval, completion, rejection and refunds.

14. Technical Architecture

You may choose the stack, such as React/Next.js, React Native, Flutter, Node.js, Python or another suitable technology.

Priorities:

Secure
Scalable
Fast
Maintainable
API-first
Modular
Well documented
Easy to deploy
Easy to integrate with third parties

Web and mobile must use the same centralized backend for customers, transactions, rates, compliance, payments and notifications.

The architecture should support thousands of transactions per month and substantially higher volumes later.

15. Infrastructure

Provide separate development, staging/sandbox and production environments with:

Database
Secure API
Document storage
Monitoring/logging
Backups
SSL
Domain configuration
CI/CD where appropriate

Never hard-code passwords, API keys or secrets. Provide an environment-variable template.

16. Deliverables
Production-ready web application
iOS and Android apps
Backend/API
Admin dashboard
Database/schema/migrations
FX engine
Transaction engine
KYC/AML integration
Payment integration hooks
Notifications
Role-based permissions
Audit logs
Reporting
Source code
Environment configuration
API documentation
Deployment/setup documentation
Sandbox/test credentials
Automated tests for critical functions
17. MVP Acceptance Criteria

The MVP must demonstrate:

Correct live FX rates across web/iOS/Android
Customer registration/login
Sandbox KYC
Complete end-to-end exchange/transfer
Correct payment webhook/status handling
Admin approval/rejection
Rate changes without code changes
Consistent fee/rate calculations
Transaction history
Compliance audit logs
Notifications
Working permissions
Shared backend
Critical automated tests
Successful installation on a clean machine
Adequate deployment documentation
No critical security vulnerabilities
18. Development Phases

Phase 1 — MVP: Website, accounts, FX calculator, live rates, KYC, payments, transactions, admin dashboard, reporting, notifications and mobile apps.

Phase 2 — Advanced: Advanced AML/risk rules, KYB/corporate accounts, advanced reporting, automated reconciliation, additional payment providers, advanced pricing and accounting integrations.

Phase 3 — Physical Bureau: Cash transactions, till/vault management, currency inventory, cashier accounts, branches, in-person KYC and multi-branch reporting.

19. Proposal Required

Please provide:

Recommended technology stack and architecture
Database design
Security approach
KYC/AML and payment integration approach
Required third-party services
Fastest realistic MVP timeline
Development phases and cost
Estimated hosting/third-party costs
App Store/Google Play requirements
Information/access required from me on day one
Exact MVP scope
Features recommended for Phase 2
How the architecture will support the future physical bureau

Priority: Launch a secure, functional MVP as quickly as realistically possible while creating a scalable foundation for a complete online and physical bureau-de-change platform.

title: Automatización CRM y campañas inmobiliarias
description:
Trabajo como agente inmobiliario independiente y me apoyo en el CRM Mobilia; sin embargo, buena parte de mi jornada sigue siendo manual. Busco a alguien que diseñe y ponga en marcha un agente de IA que elimine el máximo de tareas repetitivas dentro de mi flujo de trabajo.

Objetivos esenciales  
• Volcado automático de todos los datos de clientes y propiedades en Mobilia.  
• Grabación de llamadas (entrantes y salientes), anexado al registro correspondiente del CRM e indexación para búsquedas futuras.  
• Transcripción de cada llamada y generación inmediata de un resumen accionable que cree recordatorios o tareas dentro del propio Mobilia.  

Campañas y comunicación  
Manejo campañas de mailing, WhatsApp y, a veces, Facebook. El nuevo sistema debe:  

• Filtrar contactos según comportamiento y etiquetas.  
• Programar y lanzar envíos automatizados.  
• Analizar las respuestas para clasificar leads y detonar acciones (por ejemplo, actualizar etapas en el CRM o programar un follow-up).  

Puntos clave de la implementación  
– Integración nativa o vía API con Mobilia.  
– Posible uso de Twilio, WhatsApp Business API, Mailchimp, Zapier/Make o soluciones equivalentes; estoy abierto a la propuesta que resulte más estable y escalable.  
– Transcripción a través de Whisper, Google Speech o la tecnología que garantice la mejor precisión en español.  
– IA generativa (GPT u otra) para los resúmenes y la creación de recordatorios.  

Entregables mínimos  
1. Flujo totalmente operativo que muestre un lead entrando por cualquier canal y apareciendo completo en Mobilia con nota, llamada grabada, transcripción y tarea generada.  
2. Panel o dashboard donde pueda ajustar reglas de filtrado, horarios de envío y plantillas para mailing/WhatsApp.  
3. Documentación breve con las credenciales, pasos de mantenimiento y vídeo demo.  

La solución debe llegar instalada, probada y lista para usarse; si requiero licencias adicionales, indícame cuáles y su coste estimado antes de implementarlas. Estoy disponible para pruebas piloto y feedback rápido durante todo el desarrollo.

Busco un freelancer de ventas / comercial B2B para una colaboración a largo plazo enfocada en vender servicios de diseño y desarrollo de páginas web profesionales.
Actualmente ofrecemos páginas web de hasta 5 secciones por $1,300 USD, dirigidas principalmente a agentes y empresas inmobiliarias, clínicas dentales y contratistas/empresas de remodelación, especialmente en México y Estados Unidos.
¿Cuál será tu trabajo?
Busco una persona que pueda encargarse del proceso comercial: investigar y encontrar prospectos de calidad, contactar a los responsables del negocio, realizar prospección por WhatsApp, correo, llamadas u otros canales disponibles, dar seguimiento a los interesados y cerrar la venta.
No buscamos únicamente listas de leads o personas que agenden citas. El objetivo de la colaboración es conseguir clientes reales que contraten y paguen el servicio.
Nuestra oferta al cliente incluye: página web profesional de hasta 5 secciones, diseño adaptable a celular/tableta/computadora, estructura orientada a conversión, botones de WhatsApp y llamada, formularios de contacto, SEO básico e integraciones necesarias según el proyecto. El tiempo estimado de entrega es de 4 a 9 días hábiles.
Forma de pago al cliente: 50% al comenzar ($650 USD) y 50% al finalizar el proyecto.
Modalidad de colaboración: actualmente busco trabajar 100% por comisión, sin tarifa fija inicial. Ofrezco $100 USD por cada cliente cerrado y pagado. La comisión se paga cuando se confirme el pago inicial del cliente.
Una vez cerrada la venta, me compartirás los datos del cliente y yo me encargaré de la comunicación relacionada con el desarrollo, recopilación de información y ejecución de la página web.
Busco preferentemente una persona que hable español, tenga experiencia real en ventas B2B, prospección, llamadas en frío, seguimiento y cierre; que sea constante, profesional y esté cómoda trabajando inicialmente bajo un esquema por resultados.
Mi intención no es contratar para una sola venta. Busco construir una colaboración a largo plazo y, conforme consigamos un flujo constante de clientes, podremos revisar y ampliar las condiciones de trabajo.
Al enviar tu propuesta, indícame: tu experiencia cerrando ventas, qué canales utilizas para prospectar, cómo realizarías el proceso para conseguir los primeros clientes y si estás de acuerdo con trabajar inicialmente por una comisión de $100 USD por cliente cerrado y pagado.

title: Implementación de ReservaIA en Negocio
description:
Para configurar ReservaIA en un negocio real, el propietario seguiría un asistente inicial. El proceso completo sería este:
1. Crear la cuenta del negocio
Abrir ReservaIA.
Pulsar Entrar como negocio.
Seleccionar Registrarme.
Introducir:
Nombre y apellidos.
Email profesional.
Contraseña.
Confirmar el correo electrónico.
Activar opcionalmente la verificación en dos pasos.
2. Registrar el establecimiento
Introducir:
Nombre comercial.
Categoría: taller, dentista, óptica, restaurante, hotel, etc.
Dirección.
Teléfono.
Página web.
Número de sucursales.
CIF o NIF.
Persona responsable.
El negocio tendría que verificar su identidad mediante email, llamada o documentación antes de aparecer públicamente.
3. Crear los servicios
Por cada servicio se configura:
Nombre.
Descripción.
Precio o “precio desde”.
Duración.
Tiempo de preparación posterior.
Profesionales que pueden realizarlo.
Si necesita depósito.
Condiciones de cancelación.
Ejemplo para un dentista:
Servicio
Duración
Precio
Primera consulta
30 min
Gratis
Limpieza dental
45 min
50 €
Revisión
20 min
30 €
Ortodoncia
30 min
Consultar

4. Añadir profesionales o recursos
El negocio registra:
Nombre de cada empleado.
Especialidad.
Horario.
Servicios asignados.
Vacaciones.
Descansos.
Sala, gabinete, mesa o puesto utilizado.
En un taller también se pueden añadir recursos como elevadores; en un restaurante, mesas; y en una clínica, gabinetes.
5. Configurar horarios
El propietario indica:
Horario de apertura.
Días cerrados.
Festivos.
Vacaciones.
Duración de los turnos.
Antelación mínima para reservar.
Tiempo máximo para reservar con anticipación.
Periodo permitido para cancelar.
Ejemplo:
Reservar hasta 60 días antes.
No aceptar citas con menos de 2 horas.
Cancelación gratuita hasta 24 horas antes.
Recordatorio automático 24 horas y 2 horas antes.
6. Conectar la agenda existente
ReservaIA podría conectarse con:
Google Calendar.
Outlook Calendar.
Agenda propia del negocio.
Software de clínica, taller u hotel mediante integración.
Las horas ocupadas quedarían bloqueadas para evitar reservas duplicadas.
7. Conectar WhatsApp Business
El negocio autoriza su número de WhatsApp para que la IA pueda:
Contestar preguntas.
Mostrar servicios disponibles.
Crear, cambiar o cancelar citas.
Enviar confirmaciones.
Mandar recordatorios.
Solicitar una valoración después de la visita.
El cliente hablaría con el número del negocio, no con un número desconocido de ReservaIA.
8. Configurar las llamadas con IA
El negocio puede:
Conectar su número actual.
Utilizar un número nuevo.
Desviar únicamente las llamadas no atendidas.
Activar la IA fuera del horario comercial.
Permitir que la IA atienda todas las llamadas.
Después se define qué llamadas debe transferir a una persona:
Emergencias.
Reclamaciones.
Presupuestos complejos.
Problemas médicos.
Clientes que pidan hablar con un empleado.
9. Personalizar el asistente
El propietario selecciona:
Nombre de la asistente, por ejemplo, Alba.
Voz femenina o masculina.
Idioma.
Tono cercano, formal o directo.
Saludo inicial.
Preguntas que debe realizar.
Información que puede proporcionar.
Situaciones que requieren intervención humana.
En clínicas médicas, dentales y psicológicas, la IA debería limitarse a gestión administrativa y nunca realizar diagnósticos.
10. Conectar Google y las reseñas
El negocio autoriza su Perfil de Empresa de Google. Entonces ReservaIA podrá:
Detectar reseñas nuevas.
Redactar respuestas personalizadas.
Avisar de valoraciones negativas.
Permitir aprobar la respuesta.
Publicarla automáticamente si el propietario lo autoriza.
11. Configurar pagos
Si el establecimiento lo necesita:
Conectar una cuenta bancaria o plataforma de pago.
Decidir qué servicios necesitan señal.
Establecer importe fijo o porcentaje.
Configurar devoluciones.
Descargar facturas.
Ejemplo: pedir 20 € para reservar una sesión de tatuaje o una mesa para un grupo grande.
12. Hacer una prueba completa
Antes de activarlo:
Crear una reserva como cliente.
Comprobar que aparece en la agenda del negocio.
Modificar la cita.
Cancelarla.
Simular una llamada.
Probar WhatsApp.
Confirmar que llegan los recordatorios.
Comprobar el bloqueo del horario.
Generar una respuesta de prueba para una reseña.
13. Publicar el negocio
Después de superar la prueba, se pulsa Activar establecimiento. Desde ese momento:
Aparece en las búsquedas de clientes.
Muestra servicios y horarios disponibles.
Recibe reservas en tiempo real.
La IA comienza a atender consultas.
El propietario recibe avisos de nuevas citas.
La configuración debería poder completarse en aproximadamente 20–30 minutos, aunque conectar llamadas, WhatsApp y sistemas externos puede requerir verificaciones adicionales.
El siguiente cambio lógico del prototipo es añadir este asistente de configuración empresarial paso a paso, que aparezca inmediatamente después de registrar una cuenta de negocio.

title: Comercial telefónico para concertar videollamadas · Solo España · A comisión
description:
QUIÉNES SOMOS

Nexodia es una empresa española que trabaja con negocios que funcionan con agenda de clientes: centros sanitarios, clínicas de fisioterapia, dentistas, ópticas, centros de estética, peluquerías y barberías, veterinarios, psicólogos, centros de nutrición y gimnasios con entrenamiento personal.

Les ayudamos a conseguir más clientes y a no perder los que ya tienen. Les montamos la web y un sistema con inteligencia artificial que funciona solo:

--Gestor de agenda para organizar todas las citas del negocio.
--Confirmación y recordatorio de citas por WhatsApp.
--Aviso a cada cliente cuando le toca volver.
--Petición de reseñas en Google.
--Avisos al dueño de lo que de verdad importa.

QUÉ HARÁS

--Llamar a los negocios de la lista que te damos. No tienes que buscarlos. Tendrás todos los que necesites y la lista no se acaba.
--Conseguir hablar con el propietario, no con cualquier trabajador.
--Contarle en un par de minutos qué gana su negocio con Nexodia.
--Agendar con él una videollamada con Víctor, el fundador, que le enseña todo en detalle y le entrega el presupuesto.

QUÉ NO HARÁS

--Vender. La demostración, el presupuesto y todo el seguimiento posterior los lleva Víctor, que es quien conoce la herramienta a fondo. Tu trabajo termina cuando el propietario llega a la videollamada.

REQUISITOS IMPRESCINDIBLES

--Hablar español de España.
--Tener número de teléfono español desde el que llamar (residas en España o no).
--Soltura al teléfono y no venirte abajo con el primer no.

CUÁNTO SE GANA

Comisión por cada venta de un negocio que tú hayas llevado a la videollamada:

--Web + sistema (completo): 500 €
--Solo sistema: 350 €
--Solo web: 150 €

--SOLO SE PAGA POR VENTA REALIZADA. No hay fijo, ni pago por llamada, ni por videollamada.
--Estimamos una tasa de cierre en videollamada del 20%. Es decir, de cada 5 propietarios que lleves a la videollamada, estimamos que saldrá una venta: hasta 500 €.
--Sin tope: cuantas más videollamadas consigas, más ventas.

title: PREMIUM INTERNATIONAL FAMILY RELOCATION & CONCIERGE WEBSITE
description:
PREMIUM INTERNATIONAL FAMILY RELOCATION & CONCIERGE WEBSITE

We are looking for an experienced web developer/designer, UX/UI designer and SEO specialist to build a premium international family-support platform.

This is NOT a generic immigration or travel website. We want a modern, elegant, feminine, trustworthy, secure, mobile-first and international brand that converts visitors into consultation clients.

BRAND: GLOBAL FAMILY RELOCATION
SLOGAN: Your Family. Your Home. Your Future.

BUSINESS

We help international families plan, relocate, settle and manage life abroad.

Main services:
• Family relocation
• Birth abroad support
• Birth abroad & nationality information
• Fertility/IVF abroad
• International surrogacy coordination
• Visa & residency coordination
• Global family housing
• Airport/arrival assistance
• Family concierge
• Childcare/nanny coordination
• Healthcare concierge
• Translation/interpreters
• Local appointments and logistics

The website should answer questions such as: How can my family move abroad? Which country suits us? How do we find housing? How do we arrange healthcare, schools, childcare, birth abroad, fertility treatment or residency?

DESTINATIONS

The system must support many countries and make new countries easy to add.

Initial regions: Europe, USA/Canada, Latin America, Asia, Middle East and Africa, including Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Portugal, Spain, Italy, Greece, USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines, Singapore, UAE/Dubai and South Africa.

LEGAL POSITIONING

We must NEVER promise guaranteed citizenship, passport, visa, residence, surrogacy or medical results.

Clearly state that nationality, immigration, parentage, fertility, medical and residency matters depend on local law and individual circumstances.

We provide information, coordination, concierge services, appointment assistance, local logistics, document checklists and partner introductions. Legal/medical/immigration advice is referred to qualified professionals.

KEY SERVICES

Birth Abroad: destination/clinic research, appointments, accommodation, transport, interpreters, documentation, registration, consular coordination and post-birth planning.

Fertility/IVF: clinic research, IVF, IUI, egg donation/freezing, consultations, international patient coordination, accommodation, transport and translation.

SEO examples: IVF abroad, IVF treatment abroad, fertility treatment abroad, fertility clinic abroad, IUI abroad, egg donation abroad.

German SEO: IVF im Ausland, Künstliche Befruchtung im Ausland, Kinderwunschbehandlung im Ausland, Kinderwunschklinik im Ausland, Eizellspende im Ausland.

Surrogacy: country/program research, medical/legal partner introductions, clinic coordination, travel, accommodation, translation and documentation. Clearly explain that laws vary by jurisdiction and provide NO guarantees regarding parentage, citizenship, immigration, visas, pregnancy or medical outcomes.

Visa & Residency: family reunification, work permits, residence permits, business relocation, investor/entrepreneur options, digital nomad and second residence information.

GLOBAL FAMILY HOMES

Property section for furnished apartments, houses, villas, condos, executive/luxury apartments, serviced apartments and temporary/long-term housing.

Property database should support photos, videos, location, bedrooms, bathrooms, furnishing, security, internet, parking, facilities, availability, price and minimum stay.

ARRIVE WITH A SUITCASE

Flagship package coordinating airport pickup, temporary/furnished housing, SIM/internet, transport, orientation, government/bank/healthcare appointments, school/daycare research, nanny, cleaning, shopping, translation and concierge.

Goal: “Everything important has already been organized.”

DESTINATION FINDER

Interactive tool: users select purpose, family size, children, budget, region and timeframe.

Purposes: relocation, birth abroad, fertility, surrogacy research, extended stay, work, business, investment or second residence.

CTA: Speak With a Family Coordinator.

BOOKING + CRM

Integrated consultation booking with service, country, family size, timeframe and consultation type: video, phone, WhatsApp or email.

Automatic confirmations/reminders.

CRM should manage leads, clients, consultations, countries, properties, partners, services, appointments, documents, follow-ups and payments.

Pipeline:
New Lead → Consultation → Planning → Proposal → Deposit → Active Client → Relocation → Ongoing Concierge

Lead routing:
Apichaya: family clients, birth abroad, fertility, surrogacy, childcare and concierge.

Gerd: housing, landlords, developers, property, furnishing, facilities, security and relocation logistics.

SEO

SEO must be built from the beginning:

Keyword research, search intent, competitor research, technical SEO, on-page SEO, clean URLs, metadata, schema.org, sitemap, robots.txt, canonicals, breadcrumbs, internal linking, image optimization, Core Web Vitals, mobile speed, Search Console, Analytics and reporting.

No unrealistic #1 Google guarantee. We want long-term organic visibility through a technically excellent and useful website.

COUNTRY PAGES

Each country needs an SEO page such as /destinations/brazil/.

Sections: Overview, Relocation, Birth Abroad, Nationality, Healthcare, Housing, Family Life, Visa/Residence, Costs, Documentation, Local Services, FAQ and Consultation CTA.

MULTILINGUAL

Initial: English + German.
Future: Thai, Spanish, Portuguese and French.

Use proper translated URLs/content/metadata, not only automatic translation.

DESIGN

Premium international family aesthetic.

Colors: deep forest green, ivory, warm beige, champagne gold, white and charcoal.

Modern, elegant, feminine, warm, minimal, premium, sophisticated typography, high-quality photography, subtle animation and excellent whitespace.

Avoid cheap immigration-agency styling, excessive gold, generic stock images and aggressive sales language.

TRUST + SECURITY

Use real company/founder information, genuine reviews, clear services, privacy policy, terms, legal disclaimer and secure booking/payment.

Never invent reviews, awards, certifications, government approvals, partnerships or success rates.

SSL, secure hosting, GDPR-compliant architecture where applicable, secure forms, data minimization, 2FA where available, backups and spam protection.

REQUIRED PAGES

Home, About, Services, Relocation, Birth Abroad, Nationality Information, Fertility/IVF, Surrogacy, Visa/Residency, Global Family Homes, Family Concierge, Childcare, Healthcare, Destinations, Country Pages, Family Care, Partners, Reviews, Blog, FAQ, Contact, Booking, Privacy, Terms, Legal Disclaimer and Cookie Policy.

FUTURE VISION

This must be a scalable platform, not a brochure website.

Future phases: Global Family Homes → Secure Family Residences → International Partner Network → Full Family Relocation Platform.

Architecture should support future secure residential communities for international families, executives and professionals.

REQUIRED DELIVERABLES

Logo/branding • Responsive UX/UI • CMS • Booking system • CRM • Property database • Multilingual architecture • WhatsApp • Blog • Analytics • Search Console • Technical/on-page SEO • Schema • Sitemap • Speed optimization.

FREELANCER APPLICATION

Please provide:

1. Premium international websites you built.
2. Relevant relocation/immigration/healthcare/property/family examples.
3. Recommended technology/CMS.
4. SEO approach.
5. Booking/CRM and property database approach.
6. Scalability plan.
7. Timeline.
8. Fixed price/milestones.
9. Maintenance cost.
10. SEO/content options.
11. Mobile-first examples.

We want a long-term development partner, not just someone building a template.

Final website must be premium, fast, trustworthy, mobile-first, conversion-focused, SEO-ready, multilingual-ready and internationally scalable.

title: Edutech Monitor Sales Partner__Commission Basis (India ONLY – Educational Institutions Market)
description:
Sales Partner (Commission)  ·  Field / Remote · India · Uncapped earnings

We don't sell school software. We sell schools a way to grow — more admissions, safer transport, parents who stay. If you can walk into a school and show a Principal how to fill more seats, this pays you like almost nothing else in edtech: ₹15,000 on your very first ₹1.5L school, and the rate climbs the more you close in a month. No cap. No ceiling. You get paid on real, collected business.



WHAT YOU'RE SELLING

EMonitor is a modern, AI-based school ERP built for Indian schools that want to grow, not just keep records. One platform: admissions funnel, fee management, live GPS transport tracking, at-risk-student alerts, a school community wall, AI question-paper & quiz generation, and parent communication — with unlimited users and unlimited branches on every plan.
The line that closes rooms: "Cheaper software records your school. EMonitor grows it."



WHAT A SCHOOL PAYS (SO YOU ALWAYS KNOW YOUR NUMBER)

Plan	Price to school / year	Best fit
Basic	₹1,20,000	Small schools, ≤250 students
Standard	₹1,50,000	Growing schools wanting the full suite
Premium	₹1,80,000	Larger / multi-branch schools

Prices are GST-inclusive (what's quoted is what the school pays) and billed yearly. Larger schools add a small per-student charge above 250 students. There's also a percentage-of-fee model for smaller schools — the office tells you which to offer per school; you never have to invent a price.



HOW YOU GET PAID — THE SLAB LADDER

Your commission is a percentage of what your schools actually pay in a calendar month. The more you collect in one month, the higher the rate — and it applies to your whole month's collection, not just the top slice. This is the accelerator: crossing a slab re-rates everything below it.
Your collected sales in the month	Commission rate
Up to ₹1.5 L	10%
₹1.5 L – ₹3 L	20%
₹3 L – ₹6 L	25%
₹6 L – ₹10 L	25%
₹10 L – ₹15 L	30%
Above ₹15 L	35%



WHAT THAT MEANS IN RUPEES

Standard schools (₹1.5L each) in a month	You collect	Slab	Your commission
1 school	₹1.5 L	10%	₹15,000
2 schools	₹3.0 L	20%	₹60,000
3 schools	₹4.5 L	25%	₹1,12,500

7 schools	₹10.5 L	30%	₹3,15,000
10 schools	₹15.0 L	30%	₹4,50,000

Look at the jump from 1 school to 2: one extra deal takes you from ₹15,000 to ₹60,000 because your whole month re-rates to 20%. That's the game — close the next one before the month ends. Earnings are uncapped: keep going and you hit 35%.



PAYOUT TERMS
•	You're paid after the school pays us — on the company's payout days. You earn on real money in the door, so there are no clawbacks and no chargebacks eating your income.
•	Slab is calculated on each calendar month's collections.

WHAT WE GIVE YOU — FREE

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

•	You follow up relentlessly. School deals close on the 4th call, not the 1st.
•	You're comfortable being paid for outcomes, not attendance. This is for closers, not clock-watchers.
•	Own phone, and a two-wheeler / travel for your area.



HOW TO APPLY
Tell us your target territory. If you can sell, we'll make sure you're paid for it — from your very first school.


Earnings figures are illustrations based on the current commission structure and depend on schools you close and collections received. Not a guarantee of income.

title: Custom Python LLM Creation for PositoAI
description:
Project Title
Machine Learning Engineer to Build and Train Custom Python LLM for PositoAI.com
Project Description
We run PositoAI.com, an AI-powered stock research and screening platform. We want to move away from commercial APIs (like OpenAI or Anthropic) and build, fine-tune, and deploy our own custom Large Language Model (LLM).
We are looking for an experienced Machine Learning / Deep Learning Engineer to build a Python-based pipeline that trains a custom open-source model to auto-generate structured, accurate financial stock summaries.
1. Scope of Work (What We Need Done)
• Model Selection & Architecture: Help us select the best open-source base model (e.g., Llama 3, Mistral, Phi-3, or a financial variant like FinGPT) to host and train locally or on our cloud infrastructure.
• Dataset Preparation: Build Python pipelines to clean, structure, and tokenize our financial data (ratios, metrics, text-based disclosures) into training datasets.
• Fine-Tuning / Training: Implement fine-tuning strategies—such as LoRA, QLoRA, or Full Parameter Fine-Tuning—using Python to teach the model to reliably interpret financial metrics and generate natural summaries.
• Deployment & Inference: Set up a highly optimized self-hosted inference pipeline (using tools like vLLM, Ollama, or Hugging Face TGI) to serve predictions efficiently with low latency.
• Guardrails & Evaluation: Implement strict Python guardrails to evaluate text generation and minimize hallucinations to ensure strict alignment with financial domain data.

title: Nexora AI Ecosystem: Full Stack Developer Needed
description:
AI / Full-Stack Developer Needed — Nexora Personal AI + Connected Device Ecosystem MVP (£800/Month)

Budget: £800 GBP per month
Initial contract: 3 months
Potential: Long-term development relationship
Work: Remote
Project: Early-stage consumer technology / AI ecosystem

Job description:

I am the founder of an early-stage UK consumer technology company called Nexora Technologies.

I am developing a connected technology ecosystem consisting of AI software, headphones, a compact AI desktop computer, monitor and eventually a smartphone.

I have attached original concept images showing the proposed Nexora ecosystem, products and user interface. These images are concept references and should be used to understand the direction of the project.

I am NOT asking for all hardware to be engineered for £800/month.

This Freelancer project is specifically for development of the first working Nexora Personal AI software MVP and the software foundation that could eventually connect the wider ecosystem.

My development budget is approximately £800 GBP per month, so the project must be developed in clearly defined stages.

The Nexora vision

The eventual ecosystem is intended to include:

Nexora Personal AI — permission-based personal AI assistant
Nexora Hub — account, preferences and connected-device layer
Nexora Core — compact AI desktop
Nexora Pulse — future ANC/AI headphones
Nexora E1 — wired in-ear headphones
Nexora Display — monitor
Nexora One — future AI smartphone

The long-term idea is that a customer’s Personal AI can eventually follow them across Nexora devices while the customer controls what information is remembered and what devices the AI can access.

Phase 1 — Personal AI MVP

The first deliverable should be a polished desktop application demonstrating the Nexora concept.

The main dashboard should include:

Ask Nexora
Conversational Personal AI interface.

Listen
Audio/music section and future headphone integration area.

Learn
Educational assistant where users can ask questions, receive explanations and eventually access lessons.

Create
AI-assisted creative workspace.

Communicate
Future communication tools.

My Day
Tasks, reminders and daily information.

Focus
Focus timer and distraction-reduction interface.

Devices
Device-management screen showing Nexora Core, Pulse, One and other future devices.

The application should have an original Nexora visual identity based on the attached images.

Do not copy Apple, Microsoft, Google, OpenAI or another company’s UI.

Personal AI

The developer should integrate an established LLM API initially rather than attempting to train a foundation model from scratch.

The architecture should make it possible to change AI providers later.

Required functionality:

• Natural-language conversations
• Conversation history
• Streaming responses
• New conversation
• Search conversations
• Rename/delete conversations
• User preferences
• Permission-controlled Personal AI memory
• Basic tool/function calling architecture
• Error handling
• Usage controls
• Secure API-key handling

The AI should have a configurable Nexora system/personality layer.

Personal AI Memory

Privacy and user control are extremely important.

Create a dedicated:

AI Memory & Privacy

screen.

Users should eventually be able to:

• See what the Personal AI remembers
• Add preferences manually
• Edit remembered information
• Delete individual memories
• Clear memories
• Disable memory
• Decide which categories can be remembered
• Control whether information synchronises between devices

The software should never secretly collect information.

Nexora Hub

Build the initial Hub/database architecture for:

User account
Profile
Preferences
AI settings
AI memories
Devices
Device permissions
Conversations
Learning progress
Notification preferences

For Phase 1, physical devices can be represented using simulated/demo devices.

Example:

Nexora Core — Connected
Nexora Pulse — Demo Device
Nexora One — Future Device

I want the investor demonstration to show how the ecosystem could eventually operate without falsely claiming that unfinished hardware already works.

Headphone software demonstration

Create a simulated Nexora Pulse control interface based on the attached product concept.

Controls can include:

ANC

Transparency

Normal

Sound Profile

EQ

Battery

Connected Devices

Personalised Audio

Head Tracking — Future Feature

For the MVP these controls can operate against a software simulator/mock device.

Actual Bluetooth/ANC firmware integration will be a separate engineering project once functional hardware exists.

Accessibility

Accessibility is central to the Nexora concept.

Please include:

• Adjustable text size
• High-contrast option
• Reduced animation/motion
• Keyboard navigation
• Clear navigation
• Simple interface mode
• Adjustable notification intensity
• Optional reduced sensory interface
• Screen-reader-friendly controls where practical

Do not make medical-treatment or diagnostic claims.

Suggested technical architecture

I am open to recommendations, but one possible architecture is:

Desktop
TypeScript
React
Tauri

System/native functionality
Rust

Backend
Python
FastAPI

AI/ML
Python

Database
PostgreSQL for cloud/server
SQLite locally where appropriate

Authentication
Secure OAuth/OIDC-compatible architecture

API
REST/WebSocket where appropriate

The code should be modular so future Android, web and hardware applications can communicate with the same backend.

Future Android smartphone

Do NOT build a complete smartphone operating system during Phase 1.

Instead, structure the backend/API so a future Android application can connect to:

Nexora account
Personal AI
Memory
Preferences
Learning
Connected devices
Nexora Hub

Future Android development will likely use Kotlin/Jetpack Compose.

Future headphones

Do NOT attempt to develop ANC DSP algorithms without the actual headphone hardware/chipset/SDK.

Future Nexora Pulse development may require:

C/C++ firmware
Bluetooth SDK
DSP
ANC algorithms
EQ
OTA firmware
Device protocol

That will be a later hardware/software engineering project.

Investor demonstration mode

I specifically want an attractive Demo Mode suitable for investor presentations.

Demo Mode should demonstrate:

User signs into Nexora
→ Personal AI welcomes user
→ user asks Nexora something
→ AI responds
→ AI recalls an approved preference
→ user opens Devices
→ Pulse appears connected
→ user changes simulated ANC mode
→ user opens Focus
→ starts Focus Mode
→ user opens Learn
→ asks an educational question
→ Nexora answers
→ user views AI Memory
→ user can see/delete stored preferences.

The demonstration should look polished enough to record for an investor pitch video.

Intellectual property

Before starting, I will require an NDA/IP agreement.

All custom work paid for under the project should be delivered to me, including where applicable:

Source code
UI files
Database schema
API documentation
Build instructions
Design assets created specifically for the project
Technical documentation

The developer must not reuse confidential Nexora materials or proprietary project assets for unrelated customers without permission.

Please identify any third-party/open-source components and their licences.

£800/month budget

Please do not bid if you expect £800/month to deliver the complete final ecosystem immediately.

I am deliberately developing this incrementally.

A possible first three-month structure is:

Month 1 — £800

Application foundation
Nexora UI/design system
Login/profile
Main dashboard
Ask Nexora
LLM integration
Conversation interface

Month 2 — £800

Personal AI memory
Privacy controls
Nexora Hub backend
Device management
Simulated Nexora Pulse
Focus Mode

Month 3 — £800

Learn
Create
Accessibility controls
Investor Demo Mode
Bug fixing
Documentation
Packaged desktop demonstration build

Initial software budget: £2,400 across three months.

If development goes well, I would like to continue at approximately £800/month and progressively add functionality.

Please answer these questions:

1. What AI applications have you previously built?
2. Have you built desktop applications using React/Tauri/Electron?
3. Have you worked with Python/FastAPI?
4. Which LLM APIs or local models have you integrated?
5. Have you implemented AI memory/RAG/vector databases?
6. Have you developed Bluetooth or consumer-electronics companion applications?
7. Have you worked with Android/Kotlin?
8. Have you worked with embedded hardware or IoT devices?
9. Can you work within £800/month using milestone-based development?
10. What would you realistically complete during the first three months?
11. Please provide GitHub/code examples or previous applications where possible.
12. Are you willing to sign an NDA and IP-assignment agreement?

Important: Please do not send a generic AI-generated proposal. Start your application with the words:

NEXORA ECOSYSTEM

and briefly explain how you would architect the first MVP.

Project Overview: [Face Image/Mask Creation]
We are seeking participants for a large-scale, moderated, in-person video data collection study designed to support the development and evaluation of AI technologies.

This is a paid indoor and outdoor study where participants will record short selfie videos while performing simple, natural actions such as sitting, standing, lying down, and moderate/brisk walking. All recordings will be completed using secure, client-provided devices under the guidance of trained moderators.

As part of this study, participants will also be asked to have their photos taken. These photographs will be used to create physical and digital facial replicas, including 3D-printed, latex, silicone, paper, and digital face masks, which will be used to create anti-spoofing videos and develop anti-spoofing technologies.

The purpose of this research is to help improve AI systems in a responsible, inclusive, and representative manner.



What You'll Be Asked To Do

Live Session
Participants will:
- Have a photo taken of them.
- Record a short selfie video (under 30 seconds).
- Perform simple head movements and introduction prompts [Introduction Videos]
- Pick up the device from a pocket, bag, table, or chair to begin recording. [Natural Action Videos]
- Record multiple videos at different distances from the device.


All Sessions
Participants will:
- Follow specific positioning and lighting instructions.
- Use secure, client-provided devices.
- Be guided by trained moderators throughout the session.


Key Requirements
Participants should be:
- Comfortable being recorded in structured indoor and outdoor environments.
- Comfortable performing activities while sitting, standing, moderately or briskly walking, and lying down.
- Comfortable wearing accessories during designated sessions.
- Available to attend an in-person session.

Diversity & Demographic Representation

- All 4 age groups (18-24, 25-44, 45-64, 65+)

Participants may select multiple ethnic identities if applicable.
Authentic and balanced representation is essential for this study.


Application
As part of the screening process, applicants may be asked to provide a recent selfie or photograph.


Location
This is an in-person indoor and outdoor study in Russian Hill, San Francisco, CA.


Compensation
$150 via PayPal within 10 days after completion of the study.


Compliance & Safety
- All participants must sign an Informed Consent Form (ICF).
- Sessions are moderated and supervised.
- Participation is voluntary, and participants may withdraw at any time prior to completing the study, subject to the terms outlined in the consent documentation.

Thank you!

title: Worldwide Everyday City & Local Life B-Roll — Ongoing Paid Work
description:
I’m looking for people around the world who can record simple, natural everyday B-roll footage in their local area using a smartphone.

This is not professional filmmaking.

You do not need expensive equipment, editing skills, cinematic camera techniques, or professional videography experience.

The goal is to slowly observe everyday life in different cities and places around the world.

I want footage that feels calm, natural, stable, and comfortable to watch for a long time.


FILMING STYLE

You do not need to keep moving continuously.

Please take your time and observe the area slowly.

A good filming rhythm is:

1. Move slowly through an area
2. Stop when you find something visually interesting
3. Hold the camera steady for a while
4. Slowly show the surroundings
5. Move again when there is another useful viewpoint

For example, if you see an interesting street, building, storefront, market, shopping area, waterfront, park, public square, neighborhood, city view, or architecture, you can stop and show it slowly.

There is no need to rush through the location.

It is often better to stay still for a while than to keep moving and create unnecessary camera shake.


ACCEPTABLE CAMERA MOVEMENT

You can mix different filming styles in the same batch.

・slow movement through streets or public areas
・standing still and slowly looking around
・stable fixed shots
・short movement between viewpoints
・slowly focusing on interesting buildings, streets, markets, shops, parks, waterfronts, or local details

You can stand in one place and slowly show the surroundings.

You can also keep the camera mostly still if the scene itself has natural movement.

For example:

・people walking
・cars passing
・shoppers
・trees moving
・water moving
・normal street activity

Walking is only one option.

The most important thing is stable, useful footage that is comfortable to watch.


LOCATIONS I’M LOOKING FOR

I’m interested in normal everyday environments such as:

・city streets
・commercial areas
・shopping areas
・markets
・business districts
・residential neighborhoods
・parks
・walking areas
・waterfronts
・seaside areas
・public squares
・tourist or landmark areas
・attractive architecture
・university surroundings
・commuting areas
・normal local everyday life

Clean and modern areas are useful, but they are not the only type of footage I want.

Ordinary local streets, markets, neighborhoods, and places with a strong sense of local character can also be very useful if the footage is visually clear and usable.

You do not need to make a special trip just for this project.

Places you already visit during:

・shopping
・commuting
・studying
・work
・sightseeing
・errands
・normal daily outings

are completely fine.


TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Please record:

・horizontal / landscape 16:9
・1080p or higher
・raw / unedited
・original camera files
・no watermark
・no captions
・no filters
・no color grading
・no transitions
・no unnecessary re-export
・no unnecessary compression

Built-in camera stabilization is fine.

Please keep the camera reasonably level.


PLEASE AVOID

・strong vertical bouncing
・strong side-to-side sway
・fast left-right movement
・sudden pans
・sudden tilts
・excessive shaking
・aggressive digital zoom
・filming mostly toward the ground
・fast camera movement when changing subjects

When changing what you are showing, please do it slowly.

You do not need to constantly pan the camera.

If something is interesting, it is completely fine to hold the shot steady and let the viewer look at it for a while.


VIDEO FILES AND USABLE FOOTAGE

Multiple separate video files are completely fine.

You do not need to record one long continuous video.

For example, 15 usable minutes can be delivered as:

・3 separate 5-minute clips
・5 separate 3-minute clips
・several different continuous clips from different locations

The total usable footage simply needs to add up to the agreed usable duration.

Payment is based on usable footage, not simply total recording time.

A clip does not need to be absolutely perfect from beginning to end.

Short moments with:

・strong shake
・sudden movement
・bad framing
・accidental obstruction
・strong reflection
・other obvious problems

can be excluded from the usable total.

However, each continuous clip should be mostly usable overall.

Please send the original continuous camera files without trimming, combining, or editing them.

I will do the final trimming myself.


AUDIO

Audio does not matter because I will not use the original audio.

The following are all fine:

・traffic noise
・conversations
・wind
・ambient sound
・music playing naturally in the environment


PEOPLE IN THE FOOTAGE

People do not need to be present.

Natural pedestrians, shoppers, commuters, and normal street activity are welcome.

Please do not closely follow individual people or make one person the main subject.

Wide or medium everyday views are preferred.


SMARTPHONE FOOTAGE

Smartphone footage is the main focus of this project.

Drone footage is not required.

You may record the footage yourself or work with someone who is directly helping you.

If someone else helps you record, you are responsible for making sure:

・the footage is original
・the quality stays consistent
・the footage meets the same technical requirements
・you have the right to license the footage for commercial use


DO NOT SUBMIT

・stock footage
・downloaded videos
・YouTube videos
・social media videos
・AI-generated footage
・footage for which you do not control the necessary rights


COMMERCIAL RIGHTS

After payment, I need a worldwide, perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free commercial license.

I may:

・use the footage in multiple monetized YouTube videos
・reuse it in different videos
・trim it
・crop it
・mute it
・loop it
・re-edit it
・add narration
・add subtitles
・add illustrations
・add graphics

The original copyright can remain with the creator.


PAID TEST AND ONGOING WORK

I normally start with a small paid test of around 10–15 usable minutes.

If the footage works well, I may later order:

・30 usable minutes
・60 usable minutes
・recurring batches

This can become ongoing work.


WHEN APPLYING

Please tell me:

1. Your country and city
2. The exact smartphone model you would use
3. What types of locations you can regularly access
4. Whether you can regularly reach urban, commercial, shopping, residential, waterfront, park, market, or other visually interesting everyday areas

I want to create a simple, cute, friendly and easy-to-use language learning app.

The main idea is to help people learn a language through very short and simple stories.

IMPORTANT:
I do NOT want any AI features in this app.
No AI conversation, no AI-generated content and no AI tools.

The app should be simple, lightweight and easy to use.

MAIN STRUCTURE:

The app should have 6 language levels:

Level 1 – Very Beginner
Level 2 – Beginner
Level 3 – Elementary
Level 4 – Intermediate
Level 5 – Upper Intermediate
Level 6 – Advanced

STORIES:

Each level should contain 6 very short stories.

Total:
6 levels × 6 stories = 36 stories.

The stories should be short, cute, interesting and easy to understand.

The style should feel friendly and similar to simple children's stories, but the app should be suitable for adults as well.

Each story should include:

- Story title
- Short story text
- Audio narration
- Play / Pause / Replay
- Translation
- New vocabulary
- Useful sentences

Flashcards should contain:

- New word
- Translation
- Pronunciation
- Example sentence
- Audio pronunciation

There should also be flashcards for useful new sentences.

The user should be able to mark a flashcard as:
"I know it"
or
"Review again"

QUIZ:

After each story, include a very simple quiz with 3–5 questions.

For example:

- Multiple choice
- Vocabulary questions
- Simple comprehension questions
- Fill in the blank

PROGRESS:

The app should remember the user's progress.

- Completed stories
- Completed levels
- Flashcards learned
- Quiz results
- Overall progress

- Cute

I want a simple MVP with the lowest reasonable development cost.

I do not want unnecessary complicated features.

title: Development of a Comprehensive Logistics ERP
description:
Logistics ERP System – Import & Export Operations

A complete ERP system designed for logistics and freight forwarding companies to manage their import and export operations from one centralized system.

The system will manage the full logistics workflow, starting from customer and shipment details through to documentation, cargo handling, customs-related information, payments, expenses, and final delivery.

Main Modules

* Customer Management – Manage customers, companies, contacts, billing details, and customer history.
* Import Management – Create and manage import shipments, containers, cargo details, shipping information, arrival details, customs information, and delivery status.
* Export Management – Manage export shipments, cargo, containers, shipping schedules, booking details, documentation, and shipment status.
* Shipment Management – Track each shipment from booking through arrival/departure, customs clearance, and final delivery.
* Container Management – Manage container numbers, sizes, types, loading/unloading information, dates, and container status.
* Documentation – Upload and manage invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, airway bills, customs documents, permits, and other shipment-related documents.
* Supplier & Agent Management – Manage shipping agents, suppliers, transport companies, customs-related parties, and other service providers.
* Transport & Delivery – Manage vehicles, drivers, pickup, delivery, transport charges, and delivery status.
* Quotation & Job Management – Create quotations and convert approved quotations into logistics jobs or shipments.
* Billing & Invoicing – Generate customer invoices based on freight, handling, transport, customs, storage, and other charges.
* Payments & Receipts – Record customer payments, supplier payments, receipts, outstanding balances, and payment methods.
* Expenses & Cost Management – Record shipment-related expenses and compare shipment revenue against costs.
* Accounts & Financial Reports – Track income, expenses, receivables, payables, and profitability.
* Inventory / Warehouse Management – Manage cargo or goods stored at the company’s warehouse where required.
* User & Permission Management – Different user roles with permissions for administration, operations, accounts, documentation, and management.
* Reports & Dashboard – Management dashboard with shipment statistics, pending shipments, revenue, expenses, outstanding payments, and operational reports.
* Search & Tracking – Quickly search shipments using shipment number, customer, container number, BL/AWB number, invoice number, or other references.
* Notifications & Status Tracking – Track important shipment milestones and pending actions.

The ERP should provide a complete end-to-end workflow for both import and export operations, while keeping all customer, shipment, documentation, financial, and operational information connected within a single system.

The system should be developed as a web-based ERP, allowing authorized staff to access the system from computers and other supported devices according to their assigned permissions.

title: Web News Curation PDF Exporter
description:
I am building a Python-based tool that emulates the core experience of Dow Jones Factiva, but focused exclusively on articles that surface through Google. The application must be a web-based UI with clear multi-page navigation: one page for searching, another for reviewing results, and a final page for assembling and downloading a hyperlinked PDF.

1. Users enter a query and optional Boolean operators (AND / OR).

2. Results display in a tidy table with checkbox selection. Live filters (date, source, keyword, etc.) should refine the list in real time.  
3. Selected articles are compiled into a single PDF in which every headline links back to the original URL. Pagination, basic styling, and clickable hyperlinks are non-negotiable.

No use of http extraction/any api whatsover even if google news etc 

Acceptance criteria  
• Search page accepts plain and Boolean queries and returns accurate Google article metadata (title, snippet, source, date, link).  
• Navigation is intuitive between search, results, and export pages with no page refresh glitches.  
• PDF download triggers within a few seconds for 25 articles or fewer, retaining all hyperlinks and respecting article order chosen by the user.  
• Codebase is clean, commented, and ready to run locally via a single requirements.txt and README.

Hand-off deliverables  
• Complete source code in a Git-ready folder structure  
• requirements.txt and README with setup instructions  
• Deployed demo on any free tier hosting (Heroku, Render, etc.) so I can test instantly

If you have prior experience with news scraping, search interfaces, or PDF generation, that will make collaboration smoother, but quality code and clear communication matter most. title: Property to Cabin Crew CV Rewrite
description:

I need a fresh, professionally written CV that moves employers’ attention away from bricks and mortar and toward the customer-focused, safety-minded, team-oriented person I am.

I’d like those capabilities to stand out immediately—ideally within the top third of the page—so recruiters at airlines can see the direct value I offer without digging.

Experience translation

These activities map neatly to cabin-crew duties such as passenger assistance, inflight service, safety briefings and crew communication. I need those parallels made crystal-clear, using airline terminology where appropriate and keeping the tone warm, service-oriented and confident.

Qualifications  
I hold several non-aviation certifications (details on hand) that reinforce my professionalism and commitment to continuous learning. Please weave them in naturally—perhaps in a concise “Training & Certifications” section—so they complement rather than overpower the narrative.

Formatting & delivery  
• Modern, clean design optimised for ATS screening and quick human skim  
• Two file formats: editable Word (.docx) and print-ready PDF  
• UK English spelling throughout (I’m London-based)  

Acceptance criteria  
The final CV should:  
1. Showcase customer service, collaboration and problem-solving within the first half page.  
2. Translate at least three property achievements into airline-relevant results or scenarios.  
3. Fit on two pages max with consistent styling and keyword alignment for major European carriers.  
include my photo

Once we’re happy with the CV, I may ask for a matching cover letter as a follow-up task.

title: Telegram-Based Production Tracker Upgrade
description:
Printflow V2.3 — Simplified Specification
Version 2.3 · Purpose: Telegram-based production tracking, material control and reporting for one printing / paper-bag manufacturer.
1. Principles
	•	PostgreSQL is the system of record. The LLM only extracts and answers; it never writes SQL or changes data directly.
	•	Every extraction and every operator entry is confirmed by a human with Edit / Approve / Reject before it is saved.
	•	Never invent missing data. Anything the PO does not state stays blank/UNKNOWN until a person fills it in. Colours stay free text.
	•	History is append-only: corrections are new events, never silent overwrites.
	•	No features beyond this document. Simple, deterministic, auditable.
2. Architecture
Telegram (long polling) → ONE LLM → typed Python tools → validation → PostgreSQL (+ event log).
No web UI, no agents, no OCR, no webhooks.
3. Tech
Python 3.12 · PostgreSQL · python-telegram-bot (long polling) · one LLM · PDF text extraction (digital PDFs only) · ReportLab · Docker Compose (app + Postgres).
4. Roles (allow-list of Telegram IDs)
Owner: uploads PDFs, types orders, approves extractions, records deliveries, asks questions, requests reports, assigns operators to stations, corrects operator entries.
Operator: no PDFs, no questions, no reports, no inventory balances. Only the production entry flow for their assigned station. About 6–10 operators; several can share a station.
Stations: printing, laminating, foiling (optional), die cutting, finishing (finishing includes gluing).
Every action is logged with the user's name.
5. Universal confirmation pattern
	1.	Input arrives (PDF, typed order, operator entry, delivery).
	2.	LLM extracts to a draft (status PENDING).
	3.	Bot replies with a readable summary and Edit / Approve / Reject.
	4.	Approve saves and logs an event. Reject discards and logs. Edit asks which field, takes the new value, redraws the summary.
	5.	Drafts expire after 7 days.
Customer/supplier matching: MATCH (shown), POSSIBLE MATCH (pick a candidate or New), NO MATCH (button New customer / New supplier, created from extracted details after one more confirm). Never merge silently.
6. Owner flows
Customer PO PDF or typed order → extract customer, quantity, dimensions, lamination type, printing, foiling, handle type, handles per bag (usually 2, sometimes 3), unit price, delivery time, VAT no., and every material the PO states for each station → match customer → confirm → creates one Job per product line (each with its own Job ID, stations and planned materials, all sharing the PO number) and sends one Work Order PDF per job (A4: Job ID, customer, product, quantity, tolerance, order date, due date, specs). A PO with one product creates one job. Source recorded as CUSTOMER_PO or TELEGRAM_TYPED_ORDER. Line value = quantity × unit price; no VAT/discount assumed.
The job's station list and order come from the PO (e.g. plain job: printing → die cutting → finishing; laminated: printing → laminating → die cutting → finishing; foiled: add foiling). The owner can edit stations and planned materials at the confirm step.
Planned handles = bags × handles per bag (calculated by the app, shown for confirmation).
Supplier delivery note / waybill PDF → extract (supplier, VAT, number, date, material lines) → match supplier → confirm → goods-received record that adds to inventory.
Supplier invoice PDF → extract → confirm → stored for reporting only. No matching, payables workflow or payments.
Customer invoice PDF → extract → link to job → confirm → stored for reporting.
Duplicate check on document number + supplier/customer before the buttons appear. One file at a time.
7. Operator production flow
	1.	Operator sends a Job ID. Bot checks the job exists and includes the operator's station.
	2.	Bot asks one at a time: Starting quantity? Good quantity? Waste quantity? (whole numbers, sheets or bags as applicable).
	3.	App checks start = good + waste. On failure: message and re-ask.
	4.	Materials step (skipped if the station has none): the bot shows the planned materials for this job and station and asks "Is this correct?" with Correct / Edit. Edit changes a quantity or picks a different inventory item from the list allowed for that station. If nothing was planned, the operator types the quantities (flagged for the owner).
	5.	Summary (job, station, operator, numbers, materials) with Edit / Approve / Reject. Approve saves a production entry.

title: Automated Ant Colony Monitoring & Content Generation
description:
Python / Computer Vision Developer for Multi-Camera Raspberry Pi 5 & Windows Dashboard System

Project Overview

We are looking for an experienced Python and Computer Vision developer to build an automated, scalable ant colony monitoring and content generation system.
The architecture consists of multiple independent Raspberry Pi 5 stations (each monitoring one colony) capturing continuous multi-camera video, running local YOLOv8 AI object tracking, and syncing highlight clips to a central Windows PC hosting a local web dashboard.
The edge architecture must be completely modular: you will build one master Raspberry Pi application that can be cloned onto multiple independent Raspberry Pi 5 units. Each Pi will run the exact same codebase, with its specific behavior (bitrates, camera indices, padding, schedule) dictated entirely by a local JSON configuration file.
Hardware Environment
Edge Compute (Per Station)
Compute: Raspberry Pi 5 (8GB) running Raspberry Pi OS (Bookworm 64-bit).
AI Hardware: Raspberry Pi AI HAT+ (Hailo-8 / 8L) or CPU-fallback TFLite.
Storage: External USB SSD mounted at /media/ssd/footage/.
Cameras (3 Simultaneous Streams per Pi):
cam0 (CSI): Arducam IMX219 NoIR (24/7 IR night vision)
cam1 (CSI): Arducam IMX519 (Outworld feed)
cam2 (USB): Standard UVC Camera (/dev/videoX)
Central Server
Server: Windows PC on the local network with SMB/CIFS file sharing enabled and dual 8TB storage drives.
Detailed Software Deliverables
1. Modular Edge Application (Raspberry Pi 5)
A. Dynamic Configuration (colony_config.json)
The code must never contain hardcoded paths, IPs, or camera ports. All variables must be pulled from this local file, allowing cloning of the Pi SD card for new colonies by simply updating this file:
colony_id, species name, and central PC backup IP address.
Camera port mappings, locked FPS, bitrates (e.g., 4M or 6M), and locked auto-exposure/white balance.
Upload modes (highlights_only vs full_footage), clip padding in seconds, and local retention hours.
Staggered network sync start times and network bandwidth limits (kbps).
B. Parallel Stream Recorder Daemon (record.py)
A Python daemon managed by systemd (antcam.service).
Asynchronously captures 2x CSI + 1x USB camera streams using Python multiprocessing without dropping frames.
Features a non-blocking shared memory or temporary snapshot hook (/tmp/live_frame_camX.jpg) updated continuously so the AI script can sample frames without triggering a "Device Busy" camera lock.
C. AI Detection & Event Tracking Engine (ai_tracker.py)
Inspects shared frame buffers using YOLOv8-nano (exported to HailoRT or TFLite for hardware acceleration).
Detects classes: worker, queen, brood, and major.
Logs timestamped counts, spatial coordinates, and activity spikes (e.g., foraging departures) into a local SQLite database (antcam.db).
Thumbnail Harvester: Automatically saves high-confidence detection frames (e.g., Queen + 10 workers in clear focus) to a /media/ssd/thumbnails/ folder for YouTube use.
Database Maintenance: Runs an automated weekly VACUUM and index optimization routine to keep antcam.db fast and lightweight.
D. Highlight Clipper & Timeline Marker Export (extract_highlights.py)
Scans antcam.db for activity spikes above a baseline threshold.
Uses FFmpeg to extract lossless, trimmed MP4 highlight clips based on the padding variables in colony_config.json.
Generates a daily .csv or .edl timeline marker file formatted for DaVinci Resolve, containing precise timecodes of peak activity.
E. Fail-Safe Network Sync (nightly_backup.sh)
Bandwidth-Capped Sync: Executes via cron. Uses rsync --bwlimit to push footage, highlight clips, and databases to the Windows PC without saturating the local network.
Verified Purge: Verifies file integrity (checksum/size) on the Windows share before purging local Pi footage older than the configured retention window (e.g., 48 hours).
Disk Space Emergency Loop: If the Pi's local SSD free space drops below 10%, the script must halt raw continuous recording, switch to capturing low-resolution time-lapse snapshots (1 frame / 5s), and output an emergency system log to prevent a fatal OS crash.
2. Central Web Dashboard (Windows PC)
Build a lightweight, local web dashboard (using Flask or Streamlit) hosted on the Windows PC and accessible via local browser (http://localhost:8500).
A. Central Colony Grid & Live Status
Auto-refreshing snapshot tiles for all cameras across all registered Raspberry Pi stations on the network.
Visual system status indicators (Green/Red dots) showing real-time ping connectivity, Pi CPU temperature, and available Pi SSD storage space.
B. Interactive Analytics & Reporting
Reads the synced SQLite databases from each colony.
Renders interactive line charts plotting 24-hour activity trends, population counts, and foraging spikes per colony.
Generates a downloadable daily text summary report and a 4-quadrant summary image grid (daily_summary.jpg) combining morning, noon, evening, and night snapshots.
C. Highlight Reviewer & Editor Integration
A media panel listing the automatically extracted AI highlight clips for the day.
Features an inline video player to preview clips and a direct export button that pushes the clips and DaVinci Resolve marker files directly into an active video editing directory.
D. New Colony Onboarding Tool
A UI form to onboard a new Raspberry Pi.
Inputs the new Pi's IP address and target colony_id, then auto-generates the correct colony_config.json file to deploy to the new Pi.
Candidate Qualification Screening
To ensure you have thoroughly reviewed our technical specifications, please include short answers to these 3 technical questions in your proposal:
How will you structure frame sampling for the AI pipeline during active recording without triggering a "Device Busy" camera lock on the Pi 5?
How will you prevent network saturation when multiple Raspberry Pis sync data to the central Windows PC?
How will settings like bitrate, upload mode, and clip padding be dynamically managed across different Pis without modifying Python source code?
Required Skills
Languages & Core: Python 3 (multiprocessing, SQLite)
Computer Vision & AI: OpenCV, YOLOv8, HailoRT / TFLite
Raspberry Pi OS: Bookworm 64-bit, systemd, rpicam-apps / Picamera2
Web Frameworks: Streamlit or Flask
Networking & Tools: FFmpeg, rsync, SMB/CIFS, DaVinci Resolve .edl/.csv export workflow

title: 12NM Mobile App Development
description:
12NM – Build a New Professional Mobile App + Web Platform
We are looking for an experienced developer or small development team to build a new professional version of our 12NM platform for iOS, Android and Web.
12NM already exists as a working PWA prototype. It was created quickly and in a simplified way because the first version was developed by someone without professional programming experience. Because of this, the current version has many limitations, bugs, performance problems and things that are difficult or impossible to change.
We do NOT want to simply convert the current PWA into a mobile application.
We want to build a new and much better 12NM platform based on the existing concept, features and experience we already have.
The current PWA is only a reference/prototype. It does not have to be copied 1:1. We are open to completely redesigning the UI/UX, architecture and individual functions and rebuilding them properly.
The final product should be a modern, fast, reliable and visually attractive mobile application for iOS and Android together with a full Web version, all connected to the same backend, accounts and data.
What is 12NM?
12NM combines a private community, communication, poker, games, gamification and collectible content in one ecosystem.
The main idea is:
Community + Chat + Poker + Games + XP + Challenges + Characters + Pets + Cards + Dice + Inventory + Shop + Events + Rewards
Users should have a reason to return to the application regularly, communicate with other members, play games, compete, earn XP, unlock items and participate in events.
Community / “Plachta”
A major part of 12NM is Plachta, our internal community and communication system.
Conceptually, it should work similarly to Discord, but with additional features that Discord does not provide for our community.
We want channels, posts, replies, reactions, mentions, private messaging, unread counters, online status, typing indicators, realtime communication and push notifications.
The community should also have a strong voting system. Users should be able to create and participate in polls, including different voting methods such as normal polls and D21-style decision/voting systems.
The exact voting logic will be defined in more detail during development.
Plachta should feel like a real modern community platform, not simply a comment section.
Poker
12NM has a dedicated Poker section.
The actual poker games are played on ClubGG, while 12NM provides the community and management layer around the poker club.
The Poker section should include tournament information, schedules, results, player profiles, statistics, league standings, points, rankings and tournament history.
Results should be automatically imported from ClubGG where technically possible.
The imported results should be usable by the 12NM system for league points, statistics, XP, achievements and rewards.
Games
12NM should contain multiple games and mini-games.
Examples include Solitaire and other casual or competitive games.
Games should be connected to the 12NM ecosystem instead of being isolated features.
Games can provide XP, achievements, rewards, challenges, event points and collectible items.
The architecture should make it possible to add new games in the future without rebuilding the whole application.
XP and Gamification
XP is one of the core systems of 12NM.
Users earn XP through activity throughout the platform.
Examples include creating posts, replying, participating in the community, playing games, participating in poker tournaments, winning, completing challenges, participating in events and other activities.
XP should have a complete history so the system can show why XP was earned or removed.
Users progress through levels and can unlock new content and rewards.
The system must also prevent abuse and unlimited XP farming.
Challenges
Users should be able to challenge other users for XP.
For example:
User A challenges User B for 500 XP.
User B accepts the challenge and they compete in a supported game or activity.
The winner receives the agreed XP reward.
The system should manage challenges, invitations, acceptance/rejection, status, XP stakes, results, automatic XP transfer, history and notifications.
Challenges should be designed so they can later be connected to different games and activities.
Characters, Pets and Collectibles
A major part of the 12NM concept is a collection of unique visual characters and items.
Users should be able to collect:
Characters, Pets, Cards, Dice, Avatars, Cosmetic Items and Special/Limited Items.
We create the artwork ourselves.
The visual style should be approximately 2.5D, between modern 2D and 3D, with the possibility of animations, effects and different visual states.
Characters and items can have rarity, special editions, seasonal versions and event versions.
They can be earned through XP, levels, poker results, games, challenges, events, achievements or purchased in the shop.
Inventory
Every user should have a personal inventory containing everything they own.
Users should be able to view, filter and organize their items and select/equip them where appropriate.
The inventory must be designed to support additional item types in the future.
Shop
12NM should have an internal Shop where users can acquire or purchase characters, pets, cards, dice, avatars, cosmetic items, special items, bundles and limited/event content.
The shop must be dynamic.
Administrators should be able to create and edit products, images, descriptions, prices, rarity and availability without requiring a new application release.
Events
The platform should support temporary and seasonal events such as Halloween, Christmas, summer events, poker championships, community events and anniversaries.
An event can contain special games, challenges, XP, rewards, characters, pets, cards, dice, shop items, announcements and a special visual theme.
Events should have start/end dates and be fully configurable.
Dynamic Themes
A very important feature is dynamic visual themes.
We want to be able to change the appearance of the application without publishing a new iOS or Android version.
For example, Halloween could change the colors, backgrounds, banners, artwork and other visual elements.
Themes should ideally be schedulable with start and end dates.
Admin Panel / CMS
We need a powerful web-based Admin Panel through which the whole platform can be managed.
Administrators should be able to manage users, roles, community channels and content, tournaments, ClubGG results, league settings, games, XP rules, levels, achievements, challenges, characters, pets, cards, dice, inventory, shop products, events, themes, banners, rewards and push notifications.
The goal is that normal changes to content and game systems can be made without needing a developer every time.
Mobile + Web
The final solution must include:
iOS application + Android application + full Web version.
All platforms must share the same accounts, backend, database, XP, inventory, achievements, results and user progress.
We are open to technologies such as Flutter, React Native or another appropriate cross-platform solution. We care about quality, speed, stability and maintainability rather than a specific technology.
Quality Requirements
The new application should be:
- Fast
- Reliable
- Scalable
- Secure
- Modern
- Easy to maintain
- Easy to expand
- Optimized for real mobile devices
Push notifications, realtime communication, loading, synchronization and database performance are especially important because these are major problems in the current prototype.
Most Important
The existing 12NM PWA is not the final product.
It is a prototype and reference showing the concept and some existing functionality.
We want a developer who can take the idea and build it properly as a new professional product, with a better architecture, better UI/UX, better performance and much greater flexibility.
We are not looking only for someone to fix the current PWA and we are not looking only for someone to wrap it into a mobile application.
We want to build the next version of 12NM properly for iOS, Android and Web.
We can provide the current 12NM application, source code and a demo/reference version so interested developers can understand the current concept and functionality.
Please include your experience with mobile applications, Web applications, realtime communication, push notifications, gaming/gamification, social/community platforms, admin systems and cross-platform development, as well as examples of similar work.
