title: AI-powered Outbound Call Bot/Platform
description:
B2B AI Outbound Calling Platform /bot — Freelancer.com Project Brief Page 1
PROJECT PROPOSAL
B2B AI Outbound Calling Platform
VICIdial Integration • AI Voice Agent • Meeting Booking
Project type AI voice calling platform and web dashboard
Target market United States — business agencies
Call language English
Primary goal Qualify prospects and book meetings
Dialer integration VICIdial (version to be assessed)
Deployment Self-hosted backend with managed AI voice services
Project objective
Build a functional, tested, and deployable B2B AI outbound calling platform. The AI agent will contact eligible
business leads in the United States, communicate naturally in English, qualify prospects, book meetings, and
save call outcomes in a central dashboard and VICIdial.
This document is intended as a project brief for posting on Freelancer.com. The final architecture and scope will be confirmed
after reviewing the existing VICIdial/Asterisk environment.
B2B AI Outbound Calling Platform — Freelancer.com Project Brief Page 2
1. Scope of Work
A. AI Voice Agent
• Natural, professional English-speaking AI voice for outbound business calls.
• Configurable sales scripts, qualification questions, and conversation flows.
• Meeting booking when a prospect expresses interest.
• Call outcome classification, summaries, and transcripts.
• Recording support only where legally permitted and properly configured.
• Handling of interruptions, silence, voicemail, poor audio, and call failures.
• Immediate opt-out handling and suppression of future promotional calls.
B. VICIdial Integration
• Assess the installed VICIdial and Asterisk versions before selecting the integration approach.
• Synchronize leads, call statuses, outcomes, and external call identifiers through a verified integration method.
• Implement error handling, retries, and duplicate prevention.
• Evaluate two architectures: managed provider originates calls with results synced to VICIdial, or
VICIdial/Asterisk originates calls and connects to the AI agent through verified SIP/media integration.
• Do not assume provider compatibility; validate the chosen call path with a proof of concept.
C. Backend and Database
• Preferred backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, and Alembic.
• PostgreSQL database for leads, campaigns, calls, appointments, consent records, suppression lists, and audit
logs.
• Secure REST APIs, webhooks, background jobs, structured logs, and health checks.
• Idempotent event processing and safe retry behavior.
D. Web Dashboard
• Responsive dashboard with campaign and calling analytics.
• Lead management, CSV import, search, filters, and call history.
• Campaign creation, configuration, start, pause, and stop controls.
• Call status, duration, outcome, summary, transcript, and permitted recording playback.
• Appointment management, integration health, usage/cost tracking, and audit logs.
• Do-not-call/suppression list and campaign approval controls.
E. Calendar Integration
• Google Calendar integration with availability checks.
• Correct time-zone handling and prevention of double booking.
• Book only confirmed, genuinely available meeting slots.
• Save appointment details and booking status in the platform.
B2B AI Outbound Calling Platform — Freelancer.com Project Brief Page 3
2. Preferred Technology Stack
Layer Preferred technology
Frontend React / Next.js / TypeScript
Backend Python / FastAPI
Database PostgreSQL
AI voice Vapi or another suitable managed voice platform
Telephony Compatible US telephony provider
Calendar Google Calendar API
Deployment Docker / Docker Compose; self-hosted backend
Developers may propose alternatives with a clear explanation of technical compatibility, operating costs, and maintenance
implications.
3. Suggested Milestones
Milestone 1 — Technical assessment / proof of concept
Inspect VICIdial/Asterisk, confirm the call architecture, identify dependencies and third-party costs, and
demonstrate a basic test call.
Milestone 2 — Working AI calling MVP
Configure the voice agent, implement the backend/database foundation, place controlled test calls, and receive
call webhooks.
Milestone 3 — Dashboard and calendar
Implement lead/campaign management, call history, dashboard analytics, and Google Calendar meeting
booking.
Milestone 4 — VICIdial integration
Implement the verified integration path, synchronize call outcomes, and test retries and duplicate prevention.
Milestone 5 — Testing and deployment
Run end-to-end tests, fix issues, deliver deployment documentation, and demonstrate the complete workflow.
4. Required Deliverables
• Complete source code and agreed intellectual-property/source-code handover.
• Working frontend, backend, database schema, and migrations.
• AI voice agent configuration and editable scripts.
• VICIdial integration and documentation of the verified architecture.
• Google Calendar integration.
• API documentation, automated tests, and test results.
• Docker/deployment configuration and .env.example containing placeholders only.
• Setup, maintenance, troubleshooting, backup/recovery, and security documentation.
B2B AI Outbound Calling Platform — Freelancer.com Project Brief Page 4
• Compliance launch checklist and a working end-to-end demonstration.
5. Security and Compliance Requirements
• Secure authentication, role-based access, secret management, HTTPS, and audit logs.
• Webhook signature verification where supported; protect credentials and redact secrets from logs.
• No public exposure of database credentials or Asterisk management interfaces.
• Build controls for lead authorization/consent records, calling windows, suppression, opt-outs, campaign limits,
and auditability.
• Review applicable US federal and state requirements, provider/carrier rules, and recording/transcription
requirements before live campaigns.
• Do not assume B2B status or a publicly listed number automatically makes every AI-generated call lawful.
Human approval is required before production calling.
6. Testing and Acceptance Criteria
• A test lead can be called through the agreed architecture and the call result is saved.
• Call webhooks are authenticated where supported and processed idempotently.
• Lead/campaign/call data appears correctly in the dashboard.
• Meeting availability is checked and confirmed bookings appear in Google Calendar.
• VICIdial synchronization is demonstrated in the agreed test environment.
• Opt-out requests suppress future promotional calls.
• Failure paths, retries, duplicate prevention, time zones, and emergency campaign stop are tested.
• No real campaign is launched without explicit client approval.
7. Developer Qualifications
• Demonstrated AI voice-agent or conversational AI development experience.
• Experience with Vapi, Retell AI, Bland AI, or comparable voice platforms.
• VICIdial, Asterisk, SIP, RTP, or telephony integration experience is especially important.
• Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React/Next.js, webhooks, and API integration experience.
• Ability to deliver tested code, documentation, and a deployable application.
8. Questions to Answer in Your Proposal
• Share relevant projects, demos, or portfolio examples.
• Have you integrated AI voice agents with VICIdial or Asterisk? Describe the architecture.
• Which voice and telephony providers do you recommend, and why?
• What information do you need from the existing VICIdial installation?
• What is your timeline for each milestone?
• Provide a fixed-price estimate per milestone.
• Estimate recurring third-party costs and explain what is included/excluded.
• Describe your testing, security, and compliance approach.
B2B AI Outbound Calling Platform — Freelancer.com Project Brief Page 5
9. Budget and Engagement
Please submit a fixed-price proposal broken down by milestone. The initial priority is a reliable MVP with a clear
path to production. Third-party subscriptions, telephony usage, hosting, and other recurring charges must be
listed separately from development fees.
A paid technical assessment/proof of concept may be awarded first. Full implementation will proceed after the
architecture and proof of concept are approved.
Do not submit a generic proposal. Explain the actual technical approach for connecting AI outbound calling with
VICIdial and provide evidence of relevant experience.

b) Un servicio gestionado cuyos términos acepten explícitamente procesar contenido adulto, sin riesgo de suspensión o cierre de cuenta.

ALTERNATIVAS
No exigimos un modelo, servicio ni proveedor específico. Presenta al menos DOS alternativas (por ejemplo, modelos autoalojados en CPU, en GPU o un servicio gestionado). Para cada una indica: modelos o servicio, licencia, requisitos de hardware, política de contenido adulto, costo mensual por escenario, ventajas, desventajas y cuál recomiendas y por qué.

INTEGRACIÓN
La plataforma ya está en producción. La implementación debe mantener el contrato actual del módulo de moderación y adaptarse al modelo de datos y los flujos existentes, sin reescribirlos.

STACK ACTUAL
Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js, React, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Docker Compose, Nginx, GitHub Actions y GHCR.

USO ACTUAL
DetectModerationLabels para imágenes, StartContentModeration/GetContentModeration para videos y MediaConvert para extraer fotogramas. La moderación se usa en publicaciones, adjuntos de chat, el panel de administración y un script de reprocesamiento.

VOLUMEN (escenarios de diseño)
- Inicial: 500 imágenes/día y 50 videos/día
- A 12 meses: 5.000 imágenes/día y 500 videos/día

DECISIONES REQUERIDAS
Cada archivo produce dos decisiones independientes, con confianza por categoría:
- Contenido explícito (+18): desnudez o actividad sexual clara. No se bloquea; se muestra solo a usuarios que activaron el contenido adulto
- Contenido dañino: violencia, gore, símbolos de odio, extremismo y autolesiones. Se marca para revisión o bloqueo
El contenido sugerente leve (traje de baño, escote, desnudez parcial) no se marca.

ALCANCE
- Un servicio de inferencia (API interna) que mantenga el contrato actual del módulo de moderación
- Para video: extracción de fotogramas con FFmpeg y procesamiento asíncrono con cola, fuera de la petición de publicación
- Umbrales configurables por categoría. La prioridad es que no se escape contenido sin marcar; los falsos positivos son un costo menor
- Un conjunto de validación, una comparación de precisión y exhaustividad contra Rekognition, y umbrales propuestos
- Soporte de JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF y HEIC
- Despliegue automatizado, monitoreo y manejo de fallas
Opcional (cotizar aparte): moderación de transmisiones en vivo por muestreo de fotogramas.

ENTREGABLES
- Arquitectura: diagrama, componentes, versiones y licencias de modelos
- Código integrado al repositorio mediante PRs, con pruebas
- Infraestructura como código y CI/CD
- Informe de precisión y exhaustividad por categoría frente a Rekognition
- Costo mensual de infraestructura por escenario
- Runbooks y una sesión de traspaso de conocimiento

CONTRATACIÓN
Precio fijo. Plazo objetivo: 1 a 2 semanas; indica la duración que propones. Se aprueba con una demostración en un entorno de pruebas (staging) y evidencia de pruebas.
No se dará acceso al repositorio ni se escribirá código hasta aceptar una propuesta a precio fijo. Tras la preselección compartiremos la especificación técnica bajo un acuerdo de confidencialidad (NDA).

PERFIL REQUERIDO
- Experiencia desplegando modelos de visión por computadora (PyTorch/ONNX) como servicio en producción
- FFmpeg, colas de procesamiento asíncrono y evaluación de modelos (precisión/recall)
- TypeScript, Node.js, Docker y automatización de implementaciones

DOCUMENTO DE PROPUESTA (OBLIGATORIO)
Adjunta un PDF o Word con: descripción de la solución y cómo se integra a la plataforma, alternativas (mínimo dos) con licencias y política de contenido adulto, precio fijo, opcionales aparte, costo mensual de infraestructura por escenario, duración y cronograma, entregables y criterios de aceptación.
Las postulaciones sin documento no serán consideradas.

VALIDACIÓN DE POSTULANTE REAL

2. Responde con tus propias palabras, refiriéndote a este proyecto (no aceptamos textos genéricos ni plantillas).
3. Indica tu disponibilidad para una videollamada breve (15–20 min) antes de la adjudicación, con cámara, con la persona que ejecutará el trabajo.
Las postulaciones que no cumplan estos puntos serán descartadas.

PARA POSTULAR, RESPONDE EN TU MENSAJE:

title: Ibuprofen Formulation Development
description:

3. Development plan: small-scale batch size calculations, required analytical tests (dissolution, assay, degradants, content uniformity), and indicative timelines.  
4. Risk & mitigation table covering drug-excipient interactions, scale-up factors, and regulatory touchpoints (ICH, USP, FDA/EMA guidelines).  
5. Concise tech report (Word + Excel) with references that will plug straight into a CMC dossier.

Acceptance criteria
• All data and recommendations are traceable to peer-reviewed references, pharmacopeial monographs, or prior validated work.  
• Prototype formula is mass-balanced and manufacturable with commonly available excipients.  
• Development plan includes at least two contingency pathways should the primary approach fail dissolution or stability targets.

If you’ve taken an oral NSAID from ideation to clinic—or helped rescue a troubled formulation—tell me how you’d tackle this project and the tools you’ll use (e.g., Design-Expert, Minitab, WinNonlin, LC-MS).    - State management choices and widget tree optimization
   - Test coverage and overall maintainability
   - Dependency management and library versions
   - Technical debt and refactoring priorities

**2. Security Vulnerabilities**
   - Insecure storage and data handling
   - Improper network calls and API security
   - Weak authentication and authorization logic
   - Leaked keys, credentials, or sensitive data
   - Exploitable packages or outdated libraries

**3. Performance Issues**
   - Jank, frame rate drops, and rendering inefficiency
   - Memory leaks and excessive heap usage
   - Unnecessary widget rebuilds and overdraw
   - Build size optimization (APK bloat)
   - App startup time and responsiveness

**4. Backend & API Integration**
   - API design and endpoint security
   - Data synchronization and offline handling
   - Error handling and resilience

---

DELIVERABLES:

1. **Written Audit Report (PDF or Markdown)**

   - Clear, actionable remediation steps
   - Quantified performance metrics where applicable (e.g., FPS drops, build times, memory usage)
   - Production-readiness assessment

2. **Code Annotations**
   - Highlighted code snippets or annotated comments showing exact problem areas
   - References to specific files, functions, or widgets

3. **Brief Correspondence**
   - Follow-up answers to clarification questions (if needed)

---

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:

✓ Every major function, package, and critical feature is inspected

✓ Performance findings are quantified (not just "could be faster")

description:
Role Title: Salesforce / HubSpot Administrator - Revenue Systems (SaaS)



Role Type: Contractor



Location: Remote



micro1 is engaging Salesforce / HubSpot Administrator - Revenue Systems (SaaS) experts to contribute to a dynamic customer project focused on operational excellence in CRM and revenue systems.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

You'll work inside a SaaS company's revenue stack where the operational logic has drifted out of alignment: rules that contradict each other, automations still firing against policy that was retired two years ago, the same customer sitting under two different legal names, permissions that don't match what the documentation says, and grey areas.



Scope of Work

Audit CRM and integrated revenue systems for contradictions, obsolete policies, duplicate records, and operational inconsistencies.
Analyze and resolve policy conflicts, deciding which business rules should take precedence and documenting clear, actionable reasoning.
Draft precise operational prompts outlining best practices for handling complex, real-world SaaS data scenarios.
Assess and reconcile underlying data to clarify the intended state across platforms and ensure consistency.
Document recommended changes as well as areas deliberately left unchanged, supported by sound operational judgment.
Evaluate and articulate the impact of proposed changes on connected tools such as billing, CPQ, ticketing, or integration platforms.
Contribute insights on system design, optimization, and sustainable CRM governance in a SaaS context.


Preferred Qualifications

4–6 years of hands-on CRM administration or implementation with Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or comparable platforms.
Proven track record of real-world CRM build-outs, including implementations, migrations, consolidations, or rollouts led independently.
Extensive experience configuring fields, flows, validation rules, objects, and permission sets; certifications are appreciated but practical build experience is prioritized.
Working knowledge of at least two related revenue or operational systems (e.g., billing, subscription management, CPQ, ticketing, project tracking, integration middleware).
Comfort working in the data layer: SQL, APIs, system data models, and cross-system data reconciliation.
Background in SaaS environments, with a preference for regulated industries or multi-product complexity.
Excellent professional English communication skills, both written and verbal, especially in documenting technical reasoning and operational policy decisions.
